Experiments: 在8个医学影像数据集上验证，显示分类性能一致提升，且注意力更聚焦于解剖相关区域。摘要未说明与哪些基线方法对比，未提供消融实验细节。

Limitations: 1. 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向完全无关，无法直接借鉴；2. 依赖预训练分割基础模型，可能引入额外计算开销，与轻量化目标相悖；3. 仅在医学影像上验证，未在遥感图像上测试。

Ideas for my research: 弱相关，借鉴价值有限。但"利用预训练基础模型引导注意力"的思路在遥感场景中可能有潜在参考：例如利用遥感预训练模型（如基于SAM的遥感变体）引导检测模型关注舰船/飞机等目标区域，但需注意该方法会增加计算负担，与轻量化目标冲突。

Abstract: Medical image classification models are ideally expected to identify diagnostically relevant regions while making predictions, yet standard classification losses rarely provide spatial supervision. Explicit supervision via anatomical shape information, such as segmentation masks of task-relevant anatomy, has been shown to guide the network toward regions relevant to the target prediction. However, obtaining such masks incurs substantial manual annotation effort and computational overhead. With the advent of segmentation foundation models that exhibit strong localization of anatomical structures across diverse imaging modalities, we leverage this capability to extract anatomical shape priors without the burden of training a dedicated segmentation model. In this paper, we propose a new framework, Locus, an anatomical attention regularization framework that leverages pretrained segmentation foundation models to guide a classifier's attention toward diagnostically meaningful anatomical structures across diverse imaging modalities. Instead of enforcing pixel-wise alignment with the foundation-model-derived mask, we introduce a regularization term that adaptively balances attention between anatomical (foreground) and background regions, penalizing the classifier when background attention dominates. We validate Locus on eight diverse medical imaging datasets spanning dermoscopy, X-ray, histopathology, and cardiac MRI, showing consistent gains in classification performance alongside improved anatomically grounded attention.

</details>

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。论文未讨论参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗、实时性等部署指标，也未涉及星上或边缘部署场景。

Datasets and metrics: 摘要未说明具体数据集。评价指标涉及样本质量（sample quality）和条件保真度（condition fidelity），但未给出具体数值或标准基准。

Abstract: Diffusion models faithfully reproduce their training distribution, but also inherit its imbalances and leave rare or under-represented modes hard to reach. A natural inference-time remedy is to sample from the high-temperature target $p^{(γ)}_0(x) \propto p_0(x)^γ$ for $0 < γ< 1$, which flattens dominant modes and lifts rare ones. However, naive score scaling while correctly reweighting modes also inflates the per-mode variance, breaking the reverse diffusion process and degrading sample quality. We introduce variance-corrective time shifting, a training-free fix that queries the network at a shifted timestep and scales the resulting score by $γ$, canceling the variance inflation while preserving the mode reweighting. The correction turns simple temperature sampling into a practical diversity knob for pretrained diffusion and flow-matching backbones with no retraining, and we demonstrate consistent gains at minimal cost to sample quality and condition fidelity across DiT, Stable Diffusion and Motion Diffusion models. We further show that the timing of the temperature intervention enables coarse-to-fine control: high-noise stages drive compositional diversity across modes, while low-noise stages drive local appearance variation under a fixed composition.

</details>

Abstract: Micro-expression recognition is limited by the small scale, narrow demographic coverage, and restricted emotion labels of existing datasets. We introduce EquiME, a synthetic micro-expression dataset built from AU-guided image-to-video generation. EquiME contains 75K videos generated from 15K source face images across five target emotions, together with automatically inferred demographic metadata and video-quality measurements. We evaluate EquiME using frame-pair similarity, spatial variation, and no-reference perceptual-quality metrics, together with cross-dataset MER experiments on SAMM and CASME II. Models trained on EquiME achieve competitive cross-dataset performance on SAMM and CASME II and show comparatively low variation across the four evaluated architectures. This paper focuses on the dataset design, the structured AU-conditioning pipeline used for video generation, and the empirical evidence needed to assess EquiME as a synthetic MER resource. Project page: https://kirito-blade.github.io/me-vlm/

### [104] [Design Choices in Splitting-Based Self-Supervised Sparse-View CT Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10898)
*Nadja Gruber,Lukas Neumann,Ander Biguri,Gyeongha Hwang,Markus Haltmeier,Johannes Schwab*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一个统一框架，将基于自监督数据分割的稀疏CT重建分解为分割策略、预处理和推理三个组件，并引入多分割分割和替代推理策略两种增量扩展，实验表明最优分割策略依赖于测量噪声结构。

Experiments: 实验对比了不同分割策略（lattice-based splitting vs angular masking）在不同噪声结构下的表现。Lattice-based在独立噪声下表现更好，angular masking在相关噪声和真实数据下更鲁棒。Multi-partition splitting在多个设置中优于纯投影级分割。LPIPS和HaarPSI揭示了PSNR和SSIM不易察觉的差异。

Limitations: 1. 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化完全无关；2. 研究的是医学CT重建而非目标检测；3. 不涉及任何模型压缩或加速方法；4. 不涉及边缘/星上部署场景。

Ideas for my research: 该论文与"在轨遥感目标检测模型轻量化"课题无直接可借鉴点。唯一可能间接相关的思路是：自监督方法在数据不完整场景下的训练策略（如self-supervised data splitting），但遥感目标检测通常有标注数据，且CT重建与目标检测任务性质差异巨大，借鉴价值极低。

Abstract: Self-supervised data splitting has emerged as a promising paradigm for sparse-view CT reconstruction, enabling training from incomplete measurements without fully sampled ground truth. However, the influence of key design choices, including partitioning strategy, preprocessing, and inference, remains insufficiently understood. In this work, we introduce a unified framework that decomposes splitting-based reconstruction into these three components, enabling controlled comparison of existing methods and two incremental extensions: multi-partition splitting and an alternative inference strategy. Experiments on simulated LoDoPaB-CT data under independent and correlated noise, together with validation on the real-world 2DeteCT dataset, show that the optimal partitioning strategy strongly depends on the measurement noise structure. Lattice-based splitting performs favorably under independent noise, whereas angular masking is more robust under correlated noise and real measured data. Multi-partition splitting consistently improves over pure projection-wise splitting in several settings. Complementary perceptual and structural metrics, including LPIPS and HaarPSI, reveal differences between masking strategies that are less apparent from PSNR and SSIM alone. These results provide practical guidelines for designing self-supervised sparse-view CT reconstruction methods and highlight the limitations of common independence assumptions in realistic imaging environments.

</details>


### [105] [DP-Splat: Bayesian Nonparametric Complexity Control for Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10912)
*Aqi Dong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出用截断stick-breaking狄利克雷过程先验替代固定混合权重，使3D高斯泼溅的组件数量自适应场景复杂度，并给出闭式坐标上升更新的变分推断方法。

Research relevance: 1分，与本研究方向基本无关。该论文聚焦于3D场景表示（3D Gaussian Splatting）的贝叶斯非参数建模，不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱/多光谱等遥感场景，也不涉及目标检测任务，更不涉及轻量化、剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、边缘部署等模型压缩方法。

Reading priority: 1分。与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关，不建议优先阅读。除非对贝叶斯非参数方法在视觉任务中的应用有特别兴趣，否则可忽略。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：3D场景表示与渲染（novel view synthesis）；应用场景：3D计算机视觉、图形学；传感器类型：摘要未说明（通常为RGB相机）；目标类别：无目标检测，仅场景级3D重建。

Model architecture: 基于3D Gaussian Splatting的变分贝叶斯框架，用截断stick-breaking狄利克雷过程先验（DP prior）或稀疏过拟合有限狄利克雷先验替代固定混合权重，实现组件数量自适应。

Lightweight method: 不涉及轻量化方法。论文核心是自适应组件数量选择（复杂度选择），而非模型压缩或加速。虽然减少组件数量（5.9-7.6x fewer components）有间接的模型精简效果，但方法本身是贝叶斯非参数建模，不是剪枝/量化/蒸馏/NAS等轻量化技术。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗、实时性等部署相关信息。虽然组件数量减少可降低存储和计算开销，但论文未从部署角度进行量化评估。

Datasets and metrics: 合成数据（well-separated synthetic data）和3D场景数据（3D scenes）；评价指标：PSNR（+2.7 dB）、held-out color prediction、posterior-predictive color variance calibration。

Experiments: (i) 有效复杂度K̂自适应场景复杂度，在合成数据上恢复真实K±1；(ii) DP先验贡献是复杂度选择而非组件效率，DP拟合超过单次固定K的VBGS +2.7 dB，与同等收敛的固定K基线持平，在3D场景上以5.9-7.6x更少组件达到或超过VBGS；(iii) 后验预测颜色方差在模型匹配的合成数据上校准良好；(iv) 在均值场坐标上升下DP先验抵抗过分割，稀疏有限混合饱和截断。

Limitations: (1) 与遥感/卫星/目标检测/轻量化完全无关；(2) 方法针对3D场景渲染，非2D图像目标检测；(3) 未讨论推理速度、参数量、FLOPs等部署指标；(4) 未在遥感数据集上验证；(5) 变分推断的收敛开销可能较大，不适合星上实时推理。

Ideas for my research: 弱相关，但有以下间接启发：(1) 自适应复杂度选择的思想可用于遥感目标检测模型的动态网络设计（如根据场景复杂度动态调整网络深度或宽度）；(2) 贝叶斯非参数方法可借鉴到遥感小样本检测中的模型不确定性估计；(3) 组件数量自动确定的思想可类比于目标检测中anchor的自适应设计或NMS阈值自适应。但整体而言，该论文对"在轨遥感目标检测模型轻量化"课题的直接借鉴价值有限。

Abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting represents scenes as finite mixtures of anisotropic Gaussians whose number of components $K$ is set by heuristic density control or user caps. Variational Bayes Gaussian Splatting (VBGS) recast splat fitting as conjugate variational inference, but $K$ remains fixed. We replace the finite symmetric Dirichlet over mixture weights with a truncated stick-breaking Dirichlet-process prior -- and, as a theory-backed alternative, a sparse overfitted finite Dirichlet -- so that the number of occupied components adapts to the data while every update remains a closed-form coordinate-ascent step; a natural-gradient stochastic variant makes the per-step cost independent of the number of points. We give an exact monotonicity guarantee, a rigorous truncation-error bound correcting an anti-conservative large-$α$ approximation in common use, and an honest account of what the fitted number of components estimates. Empirically: (i) the effective complexity $\hat{K}$ adapts to scene complexity and recovers the true $K$ within $\pm 1$ on well-separated synthetic data with regime-appropriate concentration; (ii) a deconfounded comparison shows the DP prior's contribution is complexity selection, not per-component efficiency -- converged DP fits exceed single-pass fixed-$K$ VBGS by +2.7 dB at matched budgets yet tie an equally converged fixed-$K$ baseline, and on 3D scenes DP-Splat matches or exceeds VBGS's held-out color prediction with 5.9-7.6x fewer components; (iii) the posterior-predictive color variance is well calibrated on model-matched synthetic data; and (iv) the ordering suggested by exact-posterior asymptotics reverses under mean-field coordinate ascent: the DP prior resists over-splitting while the sparse finite mixture saturates its truncation, a gap between variational practice and posterior asymptotics documented across three orders of magnitude in $N$.

</details>


### [106] [Unsupervised Detection of Entry and Exit Regions from Vehicle Trajectories for Camera-Agnostic Turning Movement Counts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10949)

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：25个印度班加罗尔监控摄像头数据 + UA-DETRAC benchmark（10个序列）；评价指标：分类误差（classification error，中位数约3%）、GEH值（交通工程统计指标）。

Limitations: 1. 与遥感卫星方向完全无关，无任何可迁移性；2. 依赖前置的object detection和multi-object tracking，但未讨论这些模型的轻量化或星上部署可行性；3. 仅在交通监控场景验证，未在遥感/卫星图像上测试。

Ideas for my research: 借鉴意义极低。唯一可能相关的点是：论文中使用了object detection作为前置步骤提取轨迹，但未涉及轻量化或遥感场景。对于"在轨遥感目标检测模型轻量化"课题，本论文无直接可借鉴内容。

Abstract: Turning movement counts are essential for intersection-level traffic management, yet their collection remains predominantly manual due to the cost of per-camera region annotation. This paper presents an unsupervised pipeline that identifies entry and exit regions directly from raw vehicle trajectories extracted via object detection and multi-object tracking, requiring no manual annotation, camera calibration, or prior knowledge of intersection geometry. Unlike trajectory clustering methods that classify individual trajectories using pairwise similarity and must be re-executed on every new batch, the proposed pipeline clusters initial and terminal point locations to produce persistent spatial region polygons that classify future trajectories by point-in-polygon containment at linear cost. The pipeline comprises six sequential steps, each with configurable parameters evaluated through a systematic statistical analysis spanning 19,152 pipeline executions across 25 surveillance cameras capturing dense heterogeneous traffic in Bengaluru, India, and 10 sequences from the UA-DETRAC benchmark dataset. Both parametric and nonparametric testing frameworks identify three consistently significant parameters and yield an empirically grounded recommended configuration. Under this configuration, the pipeline achieves a median classification error of approximately 3% across all 25 cameras, including 16 held-out locations, with GEH values within accepted engineering thresholds. Compared with two trajectory clustering baselines, the proposed pipeline exhibits greater stability across camera views and lower computational cost, at the expense of higher median error. Extended evaluation demonstrates that calibration clips of at least 60 minutes and peak-traffic selection further improve region estimation quality.

</details>


### [107] [Learning Anatomy-Grounded CT Vision-Language Representations with Organ-Hierarchical Report Knowledge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10953)

Lightweight method: 摘要中仅提及"lightweight query-based global branch"，但未涉及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS等典型轻量化方法，也未讨论模型压缩或加速。该"轻量"指分支设计轻量，非面向部署的轻量化技术。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗、实时性等部署相关信息。不涉及星上/边缘部署场景。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：CT-RATE、RAD-ChestCT（均为医学CT数据集）；评价指标：零样本异常诊断AUROC（84.9和72.2），另含检索和patch-occlusion分析。与遥感数据集（如DOTA、HRSC2016、DIOR、NWPU VHR-10等）无关。

Experiments: 在CT-RATE和RAD-ChestCT上零样本AUROC分别达84.9和72.2，优于先前CT VLP基线。检索和patch-occlusion分析显示改进的报告-图像对齐和对疾病相关解剖区域的敏感性。无遥感场景实验。

Limitations: 1. 仅针对医学CT模态，与遥感多光谱/SAR/光学图像差异巨大；2. 不涉及目标检测任务；3. 无任何轻量化或部署相关讨论；4. 未报告模型效率指标。

Ideas for my research: 弱相关，但以下思路可能有间接借鉴：1. 器官层级知识结构化（organ-hierarchical knowledge）的思路可类比遥感场景中的"地物层级知识"（如建筑-道路-植被层级）辅助遥感VLP；2. 将非配对样本中共享语义视为弱正样本（weak semantic positives）的对比学习策略，可迁移到遥感图像-文本对齐中处理类别不平衡；3. 轻量级全局查询分支的设计思路可用于遥感检测模型中的全局上下文聚合模块。但整体借鉴价值有限。

Abstract: Medical vision-language pretraining (VLP) from paired CT images and radiology reports enables scalable representation learning, but most existing methods align either whole scans with entire reports or local image regions with text fragments. These formulations underuse a key property of radiology reports: findings are organized around anatomical structures, with abnormalities described by organs, disease concepts, locations, and severity-related attributes. We propose OKA-CT, an organ-hierarchical knowledge-augmented framework for CT-report VLP. OKA-CT first converts free-text reports into organ-conditioned knowledge using radiology report parsing and LLM-assisted semantic structuring. The extracted hierarchy is used across two learning stages. Stage~1 injects anatomy-grounded evidence into the CT visual representation through fine-grained organ-conditioned supervision, while Stage~2 uses organ-specific report evidence to guide structured report-CT contrastive learning, where hierarchy-derived semantic soft targets treat non-paired cases with shared organ-level findings as weak semantic positives rather than uniform negatives. A lightweight query-based global branch further aggregates disease-relevant volumetric evidence for whole-scan representation. On CT-RATE and RAD-ChestCT datasets, OKA-CT achieves zero-shot abnormality diagnosis AUROCs of 84.9 and 72.2, outperforming prior CT VLP baselines. Retrieval and patch-occlusion analyses further show improved report-image alignment and stronger sensitivity to disease-associated anatomical regions.

</details>


### [108] [EquiFusion: Kinematics-Agnostic Human Motion Prediction via Equivariant Latent Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10984)
*Cecilia Curreli,Florian Hofherr,Dominik Muhle,Abhishek Saroha,Riccardo Marin,Daniel Cremers*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出首个运动学无关的随机3D人体运动预测模型EquiFusion，采用置换等变潜扩散架构，实现跨数据集泛化和零样本预测。

Research relevance: 1分，与本研究方向基本无关。论文聚焦于3D人体运动预测（human motion prediction），完全不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱/多光谱等遥感场景，也不涉及目标检测或遥感场景理解。虽然提到了模型更紧凑（75%更小）和更快推理，但这是针对人体运动预测任务的通用轻量化，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测的轻量化场景无直接关联。

Reading priority: 1分，与本研究方向基本无关，不建议投入时间精读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务：随机3D人体运动预测（Stochastic 3D Human Motion Prediction）；场景：人体姿态估计与运动生成；传感器类型：不涉及遥感传感器；目标类别：人体关节点/骨骼运动。

Model architecture: 潜扩散模型（latent diffusion model）+ 置换等变架构（permutation equivariant architecture），将运动学连接性作为显式输入参数，内部计算与关节点顺序和图结构无关。

Lightweight method: 模型更紧凑（up to 75% more compact than previous kinematics-specific methods），但摘要未说明具体轻量化手段（如剪枝、量化、蒸馏、NAS等）。轻量化是作为结果提及而非方法核心。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、显存、延迟、能耗等部署相关信息。仅提及训练和推理更快（faster training and inference）以及模型更紧凑，但无具体数值。

Datasets and metrics: 在主要基准（major benchmarks）上达到SOTA，但摘要未说明具体数据集名称和评价指标。

Experiments: 在主要基准上达到SOTA结果，比之前运动学特定方法紧凑75%，训练和推理更快。支持跨数据集泛化、零样本预测（部分遮挡观测、目标肢体生成）。

Limitations: 1. 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测完全无关；2. 摘要未提供具体参数量、FLOPs、延迟等可量化轻量化指标；3. 未说明在边缘/嵌入式设备上的部署可行性；4. 未涉及目标检测任务。

Ideas for my research: 借鉴意义有限。但以下思路可间接参考：1）置换等变架构（permutation equivariant）的设计思想——如果遥感目标检测中需要处理不同传感器通道顺序或不同波段组合，可能有启发；2）将结构信息作为显式输入参数而非硬编码的思路，可用于处理不同卫星平台传感器配置的泛化问题。但整体而言，该论文与在轨遥感目标检测轻量化课题的直接可借鉴点很少。

Abstract: Existing Stochastic 3D Human Motion Prediction models are fundamentally constrained by hard-coding the skeleton kinematics, severely limiting generalization, preventing cross-dataset training, and requiring complex data retargeting. We introduce EquiFusion, the first kinematics-agnostic model to solve this bottleneck, implementing a latent diffusion model with a permutation equivariant architecture. EquiFusion treats the kinematics' connectivity as an explicit input parameter, ensuring its internal computations are inherently agnostic to joint ordering and graph structure. This novel design enables truly cross-dataset generalization to unseen kinematics and unlocks novel zero-shot directions, such as motion prediction from partial or occluded observations and targeted limb generation. EquiFusion achieves state-of-the-art results on major benchmarks, being up to 75% more compact than previous kinematics-specific methods, while achieving faster training and inference. EquiFusion thus establishes a new, flexible standard for robust human motion prediction. Model and training code are available at https://ceveloper.github.io/publications/equifusion/.

</details>


### [109] [MED-DSLC: Multi-Expert-Domain Classification via Domain Supervision and Logit Calibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10985)
*Zheng Zeng,Deepak Sridhar,Nuno Vasconcelos*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MED-DSLC方法，通过域监督训练和域级logit缩放解决多专家域分类中跨域logit失校准问题，实现轻量级的多域零样本识别。

Research relevance: 1分，与本研究方向基本无关。论文聚焦于多域零样本分类中的logit校准问题，不涉及遥感、卫星、目标检测或模型轻量化（轻量化仅指LoRA合并方案本身参数少，非面向部署的压缩加速）。

Reading priority: 1分，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测与轻量化方向基本无关，不建议投入时间阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：多专家域分类（Multi-Expert-Domain classification）、零样本识别；应用场景：通用视觉-语言模型的多域适配；传感器类型：不涉及；目标类别：不涉及遥感目标。

Model architecture: 基于CLIP等VLM，使用LoRA进行域适配，提出MED-DSLC（域监督训练+域级logit缩放）。

Lightweight method: 摘要中提到的"lightweight solution"指MED-DSLC本身是轻量级的校准方案（仅需少量数据即可恢复logit可比性），但并非面向边缘/星上部署的模型压缩方法（如剪枝、量化、蒸馏、NAS等）。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗等部署相关信息。论文不涉及星上/边缘部署。

Datasets and metrics: 多种细粒度基准数据集；评价指标：mean accuracy（平均准确率+15%）、跨域鲁棒性、可扩展性。

Experiments: 在多个细粒度基准上实验，MED-DSLC相比基线平均准确率提升15%，有效降低跨域logit干扰，提升多域分类的可扩展性。

Limitations: 1. 与遥感、目标检测、在轨部署完全无关；2. 不涉及任何目标检测任务；3. 不涉及模型压缩加速方法；4. 仅讨论分类任务，不涉及检测框回归。

Ideas for my research: 弱相关，借鉴价值有限。但可注意：1) LoRA作为轻量微调方法在遥感领域有应用潜力；2) 多域logit校准思想或可类比遥感多场景（如不同传感器、不同分辨率）下的模型泛化问题，但非核心方向。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) such as CLIP enable zero-shot classification by comparing image features with text prompts in a shared embedding space. A fundamental property underlying this capability is the global comparability of logits across arbitrary candidate classes. However, VLMs are often adapted to fine-grained domains using techniques such as LoRA. While this improves in-domain accuracy, out-of-domain accuracy degrades. This leads to a highly fragmented model ecosystem, with thousands of specialized models. Multi-Expert-Domain classification seeks to address this problem, by merging LoRAs trained independently on specialized domains. However, due to the independent training, the various domain experts no longer produce globally calibrated logits. As a result, when evaluating over the union of multiple domain-specific class sets, heterogeneous logit scales induce cross-domain interference and artificially high confidence for out-of-domain classes, inducing prediction errors. In this work, we identify domain supervision and cross-domain logit miscalibration as the key issue to scalable multi-domain zero-shot recognition. We propose MED-DSLC, combining domain supervised training and domain-wise logit scaling, to explicitly restore global logit comparability. MED-DSLC is a lightweight solution for MED classification, which is shown to preserve within-domain discrimination while reducing cross-domain logit interference with minimal data. Extensive experiments across diverse fine-grained benchmarks demonstrate that it substantially improves mean accuracy (+15\%), cross-domain robustness, and scalability in the size of MED classification problem. Our results show that restoring output-level calibration is essential under highly data imbalanced settings for achieving a truly zero-shot VLM under multi-domain specialization.

</details>


### [110] [Event-RGB Adaptive Tracking for Nighttime Highway Perception](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11646)
*Haidong Wang,Hengxing Cai,Wanlei Li,Xiaogang Xiong,Renxin Zhong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出联合事件相机-RGB自适应跟踪框架JEAT，用于高速公路低光照环境下的车辆跟踪，并发布合成数据集SEHN。

Research relevance: 1分，与本研究方向基本无关。论文聚焦高速公路智能交通系统的车辆跟踪，使用RGB+事件相机，场景为地面交通而非遥感卫星；不涉及遥感图像、卫星平台、在轨部署或模型轻量化。

Reading priority: 1分。与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关，不建议深入阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务：多模态目标跟踪（vehicle tracking）；场景：高速公路智能交通（白天/夜晚/无人工照明）；传感器：RGB相机 + 事件相机（Event Camera）；目标类别：车辆。非遥感场景。

Model architecture: JEAT框架：联合事件流与RGB帧的数据关联优化，采用自适应扩展卡尔曼滤波（Adaptive Extended Kalman Filter）基于NIS统计量动态估计测量噪声并融合两种模态。摘要未说明具体网络结构。

Lightweight method: 摘要未涉及任何轻量化方法（剪枝、量化、蒸馏、NAS、轻量网络等）。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗等部署相关信息。不涉及星上/边缘部署。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：SEHN（基于CARLA模拟器生成的合成数据集，包含同步RGB图像和事件流，涵盖白天、夜晚、无人工照明夜晚及不同交通密度）。摘要未说明评价指标。

Experiments: 摘要未提供定量实验结果、对比方法或消融实验。

Limitations: 1. 使用合成数据集（CARLA模拟），与真实高速公路场景存在域差异；2. 未提供与现有方法的定量对比结果；3. 未讨论模型计算开销和实时性；4. 完全不涉及遥感卫星场景。

Ideas for my research: 借鉴意义有限。事件相机在低光照/高速运动场景下的鲁棒性思路可关注，但遥感卫星在轨场景中事件相机应用极少。多模态融合（如RGB+事件）的自适应加权策略（基于噪声估计动态调整模态权重）在遥感多模态融合（如光学+SAR）中可能有参考价值，但需大幅改造。

Abstract: Intelligent Transportation Systems deployed on highways predominantly rely on conventional RGB cameras for traffic perception and vehicle tracking. However, highway environments present unique challenges: the absence of artificial lighting infrastructure, combined with high vehicle velocities, results in severely degraded perception performance under low-light conditions. Specifically, nighttime scenarios suffer from motion blur, insufficient exposure, and poor signal-to-noise ratios, which catastrophically impair the reliability of RGB-based sensing systems. To address these limitations, we propose a novel Joint Event-RGB Adaptive Tracking (JEAT) framework. Unlike existing multi-sensor trackers constrained by rigid, hard-coded prioritization, JEAT merges asynchronous event streams and RGB frames into a unified joint data association optimization. By employing an Adaptive Extended Kalman Filter to continuously estimate measurement noise via NIS statistics, the framework dynamically weights and fuses both modalities, optimally harnessing event streams during dark or high-speed motion while leveraging RGB frames under bright or static conditions. Furthermore, given the absence of publicly available datasets tailored for event-based highway perception with diverse environmental conditions, we present SEHN, a large-scale synthetic dataset generated using the CARLA simulator. Our dataset encompasses diverse environmental conditions (daytime, nighttime, nighttime with out artificial lighting) and varying traffic densities, providing synchronized RGB imagery and event streams to facilitate multi-modal fusion research. Our code and datasets will be available at https://github.com/haidongwang96/SEHN.

</details>


### [111] [MMA-Former: Multi-Window Mixture-of-Head Attention Transformer for Adaptive PNI Prediction in 3D MRI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10988)
*Youngung Han,Induk Um,Kyeonghun Kim,Junga Kim,Hyunsu Go,Jaewon Jung,Woo Kyoung Jeong,Won Jae Lee,Pa Hong,Ken Ying-Kai Liao,Hyuk-Jae Lee,Nam-Joon Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MMA-Former，一种用于胆管癌神经侵犯预测的3D MRI分类架构，核心创新是Window-Specific Mixture-of-Head Attention (WS-MoH)机制。

Research relevance: 1分，与本研究方向基本无关。论文面向医学影像（胆管癌MRI），非遥感/卫星场景；任务是3D分类而非目标检测；不涉及轻量化或星上部署。

Reading priority: 1分，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关，不建议深入阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务：3D医学图像分类（胆管癌神经侵犯预测）；场景：医学影像；传感器：MRI；目标类别：perineural invasion (PNI) 二分类。与遥感目标检测无关。

Model architecture: MMA-Former (Multi-window Mixture-of-Head Attention Transformer)，包含Coarse-Fine Transformer (CFT)结构用于多尺度特征提取，核心是Window-Specific Mixture-of-Head attention (WS-MoH)机制。

Lightweight method: 摘要未明确提及轻量化方法。WS-MoH声称"without increasing parameters"，但未给出参数量、FLOPs等具体数据，且不涉及剪枝、量化、蒸馏、NAS等轻量化技术。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗等部署相关信息。3D Transformer架构通常计算开销大，不适合星上部署。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：168例T1-weighted MRI扫描（回顾性数据集）；评价指标：AUC（0.752）。与遥感常用数据集（DOTA, DIOR, HRSC2016, SSDD等）无关。

Experiments: MMA-Former AUC=0.752，优于最佳CNN (AUC=0.708)和Transformer基线 (AUC=0.681)。摘要未说明消融实验、推理速度等。

Limitations: 1. 非遥感/卫星场景，完全不涉及遥感目标检测；2. 无轻量化或部署相关信息；3. 数据集规模小（168例），泛化性存疑；4. 3D架构计算开销大，不适合资源受限场景。

Ideas for my research: 弱相关，借鉴意义有限。WS-MoH中"动态路由窗口到专用或通用注意力头"的思路，在理论上可迁移到遥感大图的多窗口处理中，但需大幅改造以适应目标检测任务和轻量化需求。

Abstract: Perineural invasion (PNI) is a critical prognostic factor in cholangiocarcinoma. Non-invasive prediction from 3D MRI is challenging, demanding models that efficiently capture both fine-grained details and global context. We propose the Multi-window Mixture-of-Head Attention Transformer (MMA-Former), a novel end-to-end 3D architecture featuring a Coarse-Fine Transformer (CFT) structure for parallel multi-scale feature extraction. We advance this structure by integrating a novel Window-Specific Mixture-of-Head attention (WS-MoH) mechanism. Unlike standard Multi-Head Self Attention (MSA), WS-MoH generates a representation for each 3D window and dynamically routes the entire window to specialized or common attention heads. This enables spatially adaptive feature extraction tailored to the local context of each window, enhancing specialization and reducing redundancy without increasing parameters. Evaluated on a retrospective dataset of 168 T1-weighted MRI scans, MMA-Former achieved an AUC of 0.752, outperforming other 3D architectures, including the best CNN (AUC of 0.708) and Transformer baselines (AUC of 0.681).

</details>


### [112] [TreeSoc: Tree-Structured Dynamic Reasoning and Tool Synergy for Soccer Video Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10990)
*Thanh-Nhan Vo,Thanh-Khoi Nguyen,Trong-Thuan Nguyen,Trung-Hoang Le,Minh-Triet Tran*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出TreeSoc框架，将足球视频问答重构为树结构层次化搜索问题，通过深度优先搜索分解复杂查询为有序子任务，实现多步推理与工具路由。

Research relevance: 1分，与本研究方向基本无关。论文聚焦足球视频场景理解与视觉-语言问答，不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱/多光谱等任何遥感相关领域；不涉及目标检测任务；不涉及任何模型轻量化方法（剪枝、量化、蒸馏、NAS等）。属于视频理解与VQA的纯视觉-语言方向。

Reading priority: 1分。与"遥感卫星在轨目标检测模型轻量化"课题方向基本无关，不建议投入时间精读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：视频问答（VideoQA）、图像问答（ImageQA）、文本问答（TextQA）；应用场景：足球比赛视频理解；传感器类型：普通视频/图像（非遥感传感器）；目标类别：足球场景中的事件、动作、对象（非遥感目标如舰船/飞机/车辆）。

Model architecture: TreeSoc框架：基于树结构的层次化推理，采用动态深度优先搜索（DFS）机制将复杂查询分解为有序子任务，支持自适应工具路由（adaptive tool routing），在每个推理节点选择性激活领域特定模块。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明任何轻量化方法。不涉及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS、轻量网络设计、实时推理加速等。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗等任何部署相关信息。不涉及星上/边缘部署、FPGA/NPU/TensorRT等。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：SoccerBench（TextQA、ImageQA、VideoQA三个子集）、NExT-QA（跨域泛化测试）；评价指标：准确率（Accuracy）。

Experiments: SoccerBench上TextQA 85.2%、ImageQA 87.4%、VideoQA 82.2%达到SOTA；NExT-QA上74.16%准确率，展示跨域泛化能力。

Limitations: 1. 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化完全无关；2. 未讨论推理效率、模型大小、计算开销等部署关键指标；3. 仅验证了足球视频场景，未在遥感数据上实验。

Ideas for my research: 弱相关，借鉴意义有限。但树结构层次化推理（tree-structured reasoning）和动态子任务分解的思想，在遥感大场景下的复杂目标检测任务（如多尺度目标、多类别联合检测）中，或许可作为后处理或推理增强模块的灵感来源，但与轻量化核心目标关联不大。

Abstract: Automated understanding of complex soccer scenarios from video remains a significant challenge for contemporary vision-language models (VLMs), which suffer from shallow cross-modal alignment and exhibit fundamental limitations in multi-step reasoning and coordinated tool integration. We present TreeSoc, a structured reasoning framework that reformulates soccer video question answering as a hierarchical search problem rather than a single-pass prediction. Specifically, TreeSoc employs a dynamic depth-first search (DFS) mechanism that decomposes complex queries into sequentially ordered sub-tasks, enabling iterative reasoning refinement through explicit intermediate states. This tree-structured decomposition naturally supports adaptive tool routing, wherein domain-specific modules are selectively activated and their outputs incorporated at each reasoning node to produce contextually grounded predictions. On SoccerBench, TreeSoc achieves state-of-the-art performance, with accuracies of 85.2%, 87.4%, and 82.2% on TextQA, ImageQA, and VideoQA, respectively. Additionally, TreeSoc further demonstrates strong cross-domain generalization, attaining 74.16% accuracy on NExT-QA. These results establish structured, tool-augmented tree reasoning as an effective paradigm for robust video understanding. Code is available at: https://github.com/thanhnhan29/TreeSoc.

</details>


### [113] [LoSA-Net: A Localized and Scale-Adaptive Network for Boundary-Sensitive Prediction of Perineural Invasion in 3D MRI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10992)
*Youngung Han,Hyunsu Go,Kyeonghun Kim,Induk Um,Junga Kim,Jaewon Jung,Woo Kyoung Jeong,Won Jae Lee,Pa Hong,Ken Ying-Kai Liao,Hyuk-Jae Lee,Nam-Joon Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LoSA-Net是一种面向3D MRI中神经侵犯（PNI）预测的局部尺度自适应架构，通过Talking Neighborhood Attention、尺度自适应特征混合和跨尺度精炼对齐模块提升边界敏感预测能力。

Research relevance: 1分，与本研究方向基本无关。论文研究的是医学影像（3D MRI）中的神经侵犯预测，属于医学图像分析领域，与遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱/多光谱等遥感场景完全无关，也不涉及目标检测或轻量化部署。

Reading priority: 1分。与"遥感卫星在轨目标检测模型轻量化"课题完全无关，不建议投入时间精读。仅当对局部注意力或多尺度特征融合的通用设计感兴趣时，可快速浏览相关模块设计思路。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：医学图像中的神经侵犯（Perineural Invasion, PNI）预测；应用场景：胆管癌术前评估；传感器类型：3D MRI（对比增强）；目标类别：神经侵犯区域（非遥感目标）。摘要未说明遥感相关任务。

Model architecture: LoSA-Net包含三个核心模块：(1) Talking Neighborhood Attention (TNA) — 局部自注意力+head-wise mixing，保留神经走行细节；(2) Scale-Adaptive Feature Mixing (SAFM) — 多尺度深度可分离卷积调节感受野；(3) Cross-Scale Refinement and Alignment (CSRA) — 跨阶段保持语义上下文与高分辨率边界的一致性。整体为3D体积模型。

Lightweight method: 摘要未涉及任何轻量化方法（剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS等）。模型本身设计有局部注意力机制，但目的并非轻量化，而是提升对细微结构的感知能力。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗等任何部署相关信息。3D MRI模型通常计算量较大，不具备星上部署可行性。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：168例胆管癌患者的对比增强MRI扫描；评价指标：AUC（0.7567）；对比方法：代表性卷积和Transformer基线模型（具体名称摘要未说明）。

Experiments: 在168例患者数据上，LoSA-Net达到AUC 0.7567，在相同预处理和优化设置下优于代表性卷积和Transformer基线。摘要未提供消融实验、参数量对比、推理速度等详细信息。

Limitations: (1) 与遥感/卫星/目标检测/轻量化完全无关，无法直接借鉴；(2) 数据集规模较小（168例），泛化性存疑；(3) 未提供计算开销指标；(4) 医学3D MRI与遥感2D图像在数据特性、任务目标上差异巨大。

Ideas for my research: 虽然论文与遥感在轨目标检测轻量化方向无关，但以下设计思路可能有间接启发：(1) Talking Neighborhood Attention中的局部自注意力+head-wise mixing思想，可借鉴用于遥感图像中密集小目标的局部特征增强；(2) Scale-Adaptive Feature Mixing的多尺度深度可分离处理，可考虑用于遥感多尺度目标检测中的轻量级特征融合；(3) Cross-Scale Refinement and Alignment的跨尺度对齐思路，可用于遥感旋转框检测中的边界精修。但需注意这些方法本身未考虑轻量化，直接迁移需额外进行模型压缩。

Abstract: Perineural invasion (PNI) is a clinically relevant indicator of tumor aggressiveness and can influence surgical decision-making, motivating interest in reliable preoperative assessment. The subtle MRI features of PNI, however, often resemble nearby anatomy, complicating noninvasive prediction. These fine perineural cues are easily attenuated by routine downsampling or overly global feature aggregation, reducing the effectiveness of conventional volumetric models. We present LoSA-Net, a localized and scale-adaptive architecture for boundary-sensitive PNI prediction in 3D MRI. Talking Neighborhood Attention (TNA) preserves nerve-aligned detail through localized self-attention with head-wise mixing, and Scale-Adaptive Feature Mixing (SAFM) modulates the receptive field using multi-scale depthwise processing. Cross-Scale Refinement and Alignment (CSRA) maintains consistency between semantic context and high-resolution boundaries across stages. In contrast-enhanced MRI scans from 168 patients with cholangiocarcinoma, LoSA-Net achieves an AUC of 0.7567 and outperforms representative convolutional and transformer baselines under matched preprocessing and optimization settings.

</details>


### [114] [Confidence Scores in Open-Vocabulary Detection Are a Biased Mixture of Scale and Semantics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10993)
*Yi Tang Soon,Jun-Wei Hsieh*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文揭示了基于CLIP的开放词汇目标检测器（GroundingDINO, OWL-ViT, YOLO-World）存在尺度偏差和语义偏差，并提出无参数的温度缩放校正方法改善小目标召回率。

Research relevance: 1分（弱相关）。论文研究的是开放词汇目标检测中CLIP视觉-语言相似度得分的偏差问题，使用COCO和LVIS数据集，属于通用视觉检测领域。不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、SAR、高光谱、多光谱等遥感场景，也不涉及模型轻量化、剪枝、量化、蒸馏、星上部署等方向。唯一与本研究方向的弱关联在于：其发现的尺度偏差（大目标得分偏高、小目标得分偏低）对遥感小目标检测有警示意义，但论文本身并非遥感场景研究。

Reading priority: 1分。与"遥感卫星在轨目标检测与模型轻量化"课题基本无关。不涉及遥感场景、不涉及轻量化方法、不涉及星上部署。仅作为背景知识了解CLIP-based检测器的偏差问题即可，不建议深入精读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：开放词汇目标检测（open-vocabulary object detection）；应用场景：通用视觉检测；传感器类型：自然图像（COCO, LVIS）；目标类别：COCO 80类、LVIS 1203类。不涉及遥感场景。

Model architecture: 基于CLIP的三种检测器：GroundingDINO, OWL-ViT, YOLO-World。核心机制：视觉-语言相似度 s=cos(v,t) 作为检测置信度。摘要未说明具体网络结构细节。

Lightweight method: 不涉及轻量化方法。本文提出的温度缩放校正（temperature scaling correction）是无参数的推理时校正方法，不属于模型压缩或加速技术。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗等部署相关信息。温度缩放校正方法本身计算开销极低（无参数、无需重训练），但基础模型（如GroundingDINO）本身参数量巨大，不适合星上部署。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：COCO（主要实验）、LVIS（1,203类别，用于验证尺度偏差的泛化性）；评价指标：F1（Delta F1）、Recall@10；统计指标：alpha（尺度偏差系数）、r（相关系数）、p值。

Experiments: 主要发现：尺度偏差系数 alpha=+0.064, r=0.579, p=1.29×10⁻⁵⁸（大目标得分系统性偏高）；语义偏差系数 beta=-0.705, p=5.23×10⁻⁴¹（通用查询得分被抑制）。Oracle per-scale thresholding 对小型目标 Delta F1=+0.001，大型目标 Delta F1=+0.102。温度缩放校正使小目标 Recall@10 提升19.6%（p<0.01），但会轻微降低 pooled-ranking precision。

Limitations: 1. 仅分析了三种基于CLIP的检测器，结论是否适用于其他视觉-语言检测框架未知；2. 温度缩放校正虽提升小目标召回，但以牺牲整体排序精度为代价，偏差只能部分逆转而非完全消除；3. 实验仅在自然图像数据集上进行，未在遥感场景下验证；4. 未涉及轻量化或部署相关讨论。

Ideas for my research: 1. 【警示意义】遥感图像中目标尺度差异极大（如舰船、飞机、车辆），CLIP类基础模型在遥感场景下可能存在更严重的尺度偏差，需警惕直接使用CLIP-based检测器进行遥感目标检测；2. 【可借鉴方法】温度缩放校正无需重训练、无参数，可作为一种轻量级的推理时校准手段，若未来在遥感检测器中使用视觉-语言模型，可尝试类似校正；3. 【研究缺口】本文揭示了图像级预训练模型迁移到区域级检测任务的根本性局限，这同样适用于遥感领域——遥感预训练模型（如基于ImageNet或遥感自监督）是否也存在类似的尺度/语义偏差，值得探索。

Abstract: Foundation models such as CLIP have enabled open-vocabulary object detectors that generalise to novel categories via vision-language similarity. However, the confidence scores these detectors produce are not reliable localization probability estimates: they conflate visual scale and semantic query specificity with the true detection signal. Through controlled experiments on COCO across three foundation-model-based detectors (GroundingDINO, OWL-ViT, YOLO-World), with the scale-bias finding further replicated on LVIS (1,203 categories) using GroundingDINO, we show that s=cos(v,t) is a biased mixture of two effects. Scale bias (alpha = +0.064, r = 0.579, p = 1.29 x 10^-58) systematically inflates scores for large objects. Semantic bias (beta = -0.705, p = 5.23 x 10^-41) suppresses scores for generic queries. Both biases are structurally inevitable from CLIP's image-level pretraining. Threshold adjustment cannot remove them: oracle per-scale thresholding yields Delta F1 = +0.001 for small objects versus +0.102 for large. A parameter-free temperature scaling correction improves small-object Recall@10 by 19.6% (p < 0.01) without retraining. This comes at a modest, measurable cost to pooled-ranking precision, so the bias is partially, not freely, reversible at inference time. These findings reveal a fundamental limitation of adapting image-level foundation models to region-level detection tasks.

</details>


### [115] [AsySplat: Efficient Asymmetric 3D Gaussian Splatting for Long-Sequence Scene Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10995)
*Yingji Zhong,Dave Zhenyu Chen,Fuzhao Ou,Youyu Chen,Zhihao Li,Lanqing Hong,Dan Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出非对称架构解耦几何与外观建模，通过任务感知的不对称设计减少计算冗余，实现高效长序列新视角合成，在32视图960P输入上相比优化方法获得近800倍加速。

Research relevance: 1分（基本无关）。该论文研究的是3D Gaussian Splatting用于新视角合成（NVS），属于计算机视觉/图形学中的三维重建与渲染任务，与遥感、卫星、Earth observation、目标检测、轻量化部署均无直接关系。虽然论文涉及模型轻量化（参数效率、计算冗余削减），但应用场景和目标任务与"遥感卫星在轨目标检测"方向完全不匹配。

Reading priority: 1分。与"遥感卫星在轨目标检测与模型轻量化"方向基本无关，不建议优先阅读。除非对3D Gaussian Splatting在遥感三维重建中的应用有额外兴趣，否则无需关注。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：长序列新视角合成（long-sequence novel view synthesis）；应用场景：通用3D场景重建与渲染；传感器类型：普通RGB相机；目标类别：无（非检测任务）。摘要未说明遥感、卫星、航空图像相关场景。

Model architecture: 非对称架构（asymmetric architecture），将几何建模（geometry）和外观建模（appearance）解耦。几何分支处理粗粒度token，使用大部分参数进行多视图重建；外观分支处理细粒度token，使用显著更少的参数捕捉细节。两分支通过双边连接（bilateral connections）交互，实现相互引导。

Lightweight method: 任务感知的非对称设计（task-aware asymmetry）减少计算冗余，更合理地分配计算资源，提升参数效率。摘要未涉及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS等经典轻量化方法。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、显存、延迟、能耗等具体部署指标。仅提到"更少的参数"（fewer parameters）、"降低训练/推理开销"（reduced training/inference overhead）、"近800倍加速"（nearly 800x speedup），但这些是在NVS任务上的加速，与遥感在轨部署无关。

Datasets and metrics: 摘要未说明具体数据集和评价指标。仅提到32-view 960P输入作为实验设置。

Experiments: 在32视图960P输入上，模型匹配基于优化的方法（optimization-based methods）的性能，同时实现近800倍加速；超越最先进的可泛化模型（zero-shot performance），且参数更少、训练/推理开销更低。

Limitations: 1. 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测完全无关，无法直接借鉴；2. 摘要未说明在遥感数据（如SAR、多光谱、高光谱）上的适用性；3. 未涉及目标检测任务；4. 未提供参数量、FLOPs等具体轻量化指标；5. 非对称架构的设计思路虽涉及计算效率，但面向的是3D渲染而非检测任务。

Ideas for my research: 弱相关，但以下思路可间接借鉴：1. 任务感知的不对称设计理念——在遥感目标检测中，可考虑将特征提取分为"粗定位"和"细分类"两个分支，前者用轻量网络快速定位目标区域，后者用更精细的网络处理关键区域，减少冗余计算；2. 双边连接（bilateral connections）实现分支间信息交互的思路，可用于遥感检测中的多尺度特征融合；3. "高精度几何并非严格必要"的观察，类比到遥感检测中，可思考是否某些高精度特征对检测任务冗余，从而进行针对性剪枝。但整体借鉴价值有限。

Abstract: Recent generalizable 3D Gaussian Splatting models have advanced long-sequence novel view synthesis (NVS), but at the cost of substantial redundant computation. We identify that the redundancy can be mitigated based on two observations: (i) high-precision geometry is not strictly required for high-quality NVS; (ii) appearance learning is generally easier than geometry recovery. Motivated by these insights, we propose an asymmetric architecture that decouples geometry and appearance modeling. The geometry branch processes coarse-grained tokens with most of the parameters for multi-view reconstruction, while the appearance branch operates on fine-grained tokens to capture details using significantly fewer parameters. The two branches interact through bilateral connections, enabling mutual guidance for their respective tasks. This task-aware asymmetry reduces the computational redundancy and allocates the computation more judiciously, thereby increasing parameter efficiency and enabling smaller models to achieve strong performance. On 32-view 960P inputs, our model matches optimization-based methods while delivering nearly 800x speedup, and surpasses the zero-shot performance of state-of-the-art generalizable models with markedly fewer parameters and reduced training/inference overhead, achieving an overall efficiency improvement.

</details>


### [116] [Temporal Feature Distillation for Label-Efficient Precise Event Spotting in Sports Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10998)
*Hao Xu,Xinyu Wei,Sam Wells,Sunil Aryal*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Temporal Feature Distillation和Transformer Gate Shift模块，用于精确事件定位（PES）任务，在体育视频细粒度事件检测上提升性能。

Research relevance: 1分。该论文与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关。论文聚焦于视频中的精确事件定位（Precise Event Spotting），属于细粒度动作识别/视频理解领域，不涉及遥感图像、卫星数据、目标检测或模型轻量化部署。

Reading priority: 1分。与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关，不建议优先阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务：Precise Event Spotting（精确事件定位）；场景：体育视频细粒度事件检测；传感器类型：RGB视频帧；目标类别：体育事件边界帧。

Model architecture: 基于Vision Transformer（ViT）架构，引入Transformer Gate Shift模块用于注入运动感知的时间信息。使用DINO-style自蒸馏作为基础框架。

Lightweight method: 摘要未涉及任何轻量化方法。虽然使用了知识蒸馏（Temporal Feature Distillation），但目的是提升表征质量而非模型压缩或加速。未涉及剪枝、量化、NAS、轻量网络设计等。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗等部署相关信息。未讨论星上或边缘部署可行性。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：FSPerf及另外三个细粒度体育基准数据集（共4个）；评价指标：mAP（mean Average Precision）；实验设置：半监督设置（10%标注、80%标注等）。

Experiments: 在10%标注的FSPerf上，mAP比最强对比方法提升4.54个点；在80%标注下，4个数据集中有2个达到或超过全监督100%标注的基线。

Limitations: 1. 与遥感/卫星/在轨部署完全无关；2. 未涉及目标检测任务；3. 未讨论模型轻量化或边缘部署；4. 仅在体育视频场景验证，泛化性未知。

Ideas for my research: 弱相关，借鉴价值有限。但以下思路可间接参考：1）Temporal Feature Distillation中对backbone特征而非projection head输出进行对齐的思路，若迁移到遥感视频流目标检测中，可能有助于时序一致性表征学习；2）Gate Shift模块的设计思想可用于轻量时序特征融合。但整体方向差异较大，不建议作为核心参考。

Abstract: Precise Event Spotting (PES) requires distinguishing visually similar yet semantically distinct adjacent frames, making it fundamentally different from image classification and coarse action recognition. Although self-distillation methods such as DINO have shown strong representation learning ability in images, we find that directly applying them to PES is ineffective: without supervised guidance, subtle but crucial motion cues are often suppressed as noise, leading to representations that are insensitive to precise event boundaries. To address this, we propose Temporal Feature Distillation, a semi-supervised objective that aligns temporally informative backbone features, rather than projection-head outputs, to preserve motion-sensitive and boundary-aware cues for frame-level localization. A supervised warm-up with a ramp-up schedule further stabilizes training by ensuring that meaningful event cues are learned before unlabeled distillation begins. We also introduce Transformer Gate Shift, a multi-scale gated shifting module that injects motion-aware temporal information into Vision Transformers. Experiments on four fine-grained sports benchmarks show consistent improvements over fully supervised and semi-supervised baselines. Under 10\% supervision on FSPerf, our method improves mAP by 4.54 points over the strongest competing approach, and with only 80\% labeled data, it matches or surpasses the fully supervised 100\% baseline on two of the four datasets.

</details>


### [117] [SynCLIP: Synonym-Coherent Language-Image Pretraining for Robust Open-Vocabulary Dense Perception](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11008)
*Mingjie Xie,Guangjun He,Dongli Xu,Youtian Lin,Hongjue Li,Pengming Feng,Jian Guan,Yue Deng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SynCLIP提出同义词一致性语言-图像预训练框架，通过语义一致的空间注意力对齐和空间注意力细化模块，解决开放词汇密集感知中同义词导致的注意力不一致问题。

Research relevance: 1分，与本研究方向基本无关。论文聚焦开放词汇密集感知（OVDP）中的同义词注意力不一致问题，属于通用视觉-语言理解任务，不涉及遥感/卫星场景、目标检测（尤其是遥感目标检测）、轻量化或星上部署等核心要素。

Reading priority: 1分。与"遥感卫星在轨目标检测模型轻量化"方向基本无关，不涉及遥感场景、目标检测、轻量化或星上部署中的任何一个核心要素。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务：开放词汇密集感知（OVDP），即对训练中未见过的目标进行定位；场景：通用视觉场景，非遥感/卫星；传感器类型：自然图像；目标类别：通用物体类别，非遥感特定目标（舰船/飞机/车辆等）。

Model architecture: 基于CLIP的框架，包含两个核心模块：(1) Semantic-consistent Spatial Attention alignment (SSA)模块——最小化原始表达与同义表达之间的注意力图差异；(2) Spatial Attention Refinement (SAR)模块——选择性增强语义最相关的空间区域。此外构建了Synonym-Enriched Visual Corpus (SEViC)数据集。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明任何轻量化方法（剪枝、量化、蒸馏、NAS、轻量网络等均未涉及）。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗等任何部署相关信息。基于CLIP的模型通常参数量较大（ViT-B/L等），不适合星上部署。

Datasets and metrics: 自建数据集：Synonym-Enriched Visual Corpus (SEViC)，为每个类别扩充多个同义词和文本定义。评测基准：多个开放词汇密集感知benchmark。指标：grounding consistency（定位一致性）、state-of-the-art性能对比。

Experiments: 在多个benchmark上，SynCLIP相比其他CLIP-based OVDP方法在语言变体下的定位一致性有显著提升，达到SOTA。具体数值摘要未说明。

Limitations: (1) 与遥感/卫星/在轨部署完全无关；(2) 未涉及任何轻量化或模型压缩技术；(3) 基于CLIP的框架计算开销大，不适合资源受限的边缘/星上场景；(4) 未在遥感数据集（如DOTA、HRSC2016、DIOR等）上验证；(5) 未讨论实时推理能力。

Ideas for my research: (1) 同义词注意力一致性在遥感领域也有潜在问题（如"船"vs"舰船"、"飞机"vs"飞行器"），但优先级低；(2) SSA模块中注意力图对齐的思想可借鉴到遥感多模态检测中的特征对齐，但与本课题轻量化核心方向偏离较大；(3) 整体借鉴价值有限，不建议投入时间深入阅读。

Abstract: Open-vocabulary dense perception (OVDP) aims to localize objects unseen during training by leveraging textual knowledge. Despite the remarkable progress of recent CLIP-based approaches, we identify a critical limitation: synonym-induced grounding inconsistency, where semantically equivalent expressions yield disparate spatial attention patterns. This inconsistency undermines the robustness and performance of existing methods in real-world OVDP applications. To address this issue, we propose SynCLIP, a Synonym-Coherent Language-Image Pretraining framework that enhances synonym-robust grounding for OVDP. SynCLIP introduces a Semantic-consistent Spatial Attention alignment (SSA) module to enhance spatial attention consistency by minimizing discrepancies between attention maps of original and synonymous expressions. Furthermore, a Spatial Attention Refinement (SAR) module selectively strengthens the most semantically relevant spatial regions within aligned maps for more precise and stable grounding. To support synonym-coherent pretraining, we also construct a Synonym-Enriched Visual Corpus (SEViC), which augments each category with multiple synonyms and textual definitions. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that SynCLIP substantially improves grounding consistency under diverse linguistic variants and achieves state-of-the-art performance among CLIP-based OVDP methods. Code is available at https://github.com/Justlovesmile/SynCLIP.

</details>


### [118] [Reference-Based Face Super-Resolution Using the Spatial Transformer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11025)
*Varun Ramesh Jois,Antonella DiLillo,James Storer*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种基于参考图像的人脸超分辨率方法，使用空间变换器进行对齐，并设计自适应聚合模块，在多个数据集上达到SOTA。

Research relevance: 1分，与本研究方向基本无关。论文聚焦于人脸超分辨率（face super-resolution），属于计算机视觉中的人脸图像增强任务，不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱/多光谱等遥感场景，也不涉及目标检测或轻量化部署。

Reading priority: 1分。论文主题为人脸超分辨率，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，不建议投入时间阅读。

<details>

Task and scene: 任务：人脸超分辨率（face super-resolution）；场景：通用计算机视觉中的人脸图像增强；传感器类型：普通RGB相机；目标类别：人脸。与遥感目标检测无关。

Model architecture: 基于参考图像的超分辨率网络，包含空间变换器（spatial transformer）对齐模块和自适应聚合函数（aggregation function）。

Lightweight method: 摘要仅提及"relatively smaller model"，未说明具体轻量化方法（如剪枝、量化、蒸馏、NAS等）。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗等部署相关信息。

Datasets and metrics: 摘要未说明具体数据集名称和评价指标。

Experiments: 在多个数据集上达到state-of-the-art结果，但未给出具体数值对比。

Limitations: 与遥感在轨目标检测方向完全无关；无轻量化方法细节；无部署相关指标；无遥感场景验证。

Ideas for my research: 弱相关，借鉴意义有限。空间变换器（spatial transformer）作为对齐模块的思路在遥感图像配准或多模态融合中可能有参考价值，但与本课题核心方向（遥感目标检测+轻量化）关联度极低。

Abstract: Face super-resolution is the task of increasing the resolution of an image containing a face thereby adding finer detail. It is a ubiquitous task in many computer vision applications and quite often the user isn't even aware that it is being performed. However, doing it with high fidelity is challenging as it is an ill-posed problem. In this paper we present a reference-based solution for face super-resolution that uses higher resolution reference images to aid in the task. We show an alignment module based on the spatial transformer that is considerably more stable than the popular deformable convolutions. We also show an aggregation function that can take good quality information from the reference images when available or suppress the function when such information is unavailable. Finally, we show that our relatively smaller model can achieve state of the art results on multiple datasets. The source code is available at https://github.com/varun-jois/FSRST.

</details>

Ideas for my research: 弱相关，借鉴价值有限。唯一可参考的点是"在CPU上实时运行"的设计目标与星上部署对低算力平台的需求有相似性，但该论文面向的是视频增强而非目标检测，且未给出任何轻量化技术细节（如参数量、FLOPs、量化策略等），因此对遥感在轨目标检测轻量化课题的借鉴意义极低。

Abstract: There's been a surge in adoption of video conferencing applications for both personal and business use cases. However, the bandwidth limitations faced by many users worldwide may restrict the optimal use of such applications. Although deep learning offers a solution for enhancing low bit rate videos, most models today are either hard to incorporate with modern compression standards or require specialized hardware to run such as significant GPUs making these models impractical. To address these issues, we introduce the Realtime Face Video Enhancement (RTFVE) model which can be easily incorporated with any video decoder and can run in realtime on ordinary CPUs. Experiments show that our model improves perceptual quality over the compressed video baseline at multiple low bitrate settings. The source code will be made available at https://github.com/varun-jois/RTFVE.

</details>


### [120] [FSFVE: Few Shot Compressed Face Video Enhancement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11040)
*Varun Ramesh Jois,Antonella DiLillo,James Storer*

Research relevance: 1分，与本研究方向基本无关。论文聚焦于视频通话中的人脸视频增强，不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱/多光谱等遥感场景，也不涉及目标检测或轻量化模型在遥感领域的部署。

Model architecture: 摘要未说明具体模型结构，仅提及可快速训练并在低算力设备上实时运行。

Limitations: 与遥感在轨目标检测完全无关，无任何遥感、卫星、目标检测或轻量化部署相关内容。摘要未说明模型泛化能力、是否支持非人脸场景等。

Ideas for my research: 弱相关。可借鉴的点非常有限：1）快速微调/适配的思路（10帧、100秒内训练）可能对遥感星上模型快速适应新场景有启发；2）在低算力设备上实时运行的模型设计目标与星上部署有相似性。但整体借鉴价值很低。

Abstract: Videocalling has become a popular form of communication in the world today, with many companies providing free services for it. However, there are still millions of people around the world that experience poor quality videocalls due to limitations in bandwidth. This despite, most people having the required hardware. In this paper we present a novel framework for enhancing highly compressed videocalls. We show, that with as little as 10 frames of the face, we can rapidly (in under 100 seconds) train a model to enhance that instance of the videocall. The model can be trained either prior to or during the call, enhancing the rest of the call by producing better quality video. The video conferencing application need not be modified - it can be off the shelf with our system as a layer on top that trains quickly then simply lets the video conferencing application (e.g. Zoom) run as usual, where our system intercepts and improves images before they are displayed. The model is designed to run in realtime on low-compute devices such as a typical laptop CPU. Experimentally, we show that the model significantly improves quality of compressed face video both quantitatively as well as perceptually. Code can be found at https://github.com/varun-jois/FSFVE.

</details>


### [121] [WiFi-JEPA: Self-supervised Learning for WiFi-CSI 3D Human Pose Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11064)
*Doeon Kim,Jungyoon Lee,Seongsin Kim,Seong-heum Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出WiFi-JEPA，一种面向WiFi信道状态信息(CSI)的自监督学习框架，通过预测掩码潜变量而非重建原始CSI信号，实现无需标注的3D人体姿态估计。

Research relevance: 1分，与本研究方向基本无关。论文研究的是WiFi CSI人体姿态感知，属于无线感知+人体姿态估计领域，完全不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱/多光谱等遥感核心要素，也不涉及目标检测或轻量化部署。

Reading priority: 1分。与"遥感卫星在轨目标检测模型轻量化"方向基本无关，不建议投入时间精读。除非对自监督预训练在遥感领域的迁移应用有额外兴趣，可作为泛读参考。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：3D人体姿态估计（single- and multi-person 3D pose estimation）；应用场景：WiFi信号覆盖的室内/相机受限环境；传感器类型：WiFi CSI（非遥感传感器）；目标类别：人体姿态关键点。与遥感目标检测（舰船/飞机/车辆等）完全无关。

Model architecture: WiFi-JEPA基于自监督学习框架，核心设计包括：(i) CSI-specific tokenization and link masking，对CSI张量在channel, time, link (C,T,L)三个维度进行token化，并掩码整个Tx-Rx天线链路；(ii) 使用ViT风格的masked latent prediction范式（受I-JEPA启发），预测掩码区域的潜空间表示而非原始信号。摘要未说明具体backbone网络结构。

Lightweight method: 摘要未涉及任何轻量化方法（无剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS、轻量网络设计等）。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗等部署相关信息。该工作面向WiFi基站/边缘设备，与星上部署无关。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：Person-in-WiFi-3D（WiFi CSI人体姿态数据集）；评价指标：3D pose estimation metrics（具体指标名称摘要未说明）；此外使用ray-tracing CSI simulation pipeline生成合成预训练数据。

Experiments: 在Person-in-WiFi-3D上，WiFi-JEPA在单人和多人3D姿态估计任务上均超越此前WiFi-CSI基线方法。消融实验表明：(1) 合成CSI数据可为真实CSI提供互补的预训练信号；(2) 四种视觉领域的自监督学习目标（vision-native SSL objectives）在CSI数据上性能下降甚至低于从头训练，而WiFi-JEPA持续提升下游姿态估计性能。

Limitations: (1) 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测完全无关，无法直接借鉴；(2) 摘要未说明模型参数量、推理速度等效率指标；(3) 仅针对WiFi CSI模态，不适用于遥感图像/光谱数据；(4) 未讨论跨场景泛化到真实遥感部署环境的可能性。

Ideas for my research: 尽管论文与遥感在轨目标检测轻量化方向基本无关，但以下思路可能有间接启发：(1) 自监督预训练范式（masked latent prediction）可迁移到遥感领域，用于利用海量无标注遥感图像预训练轻量检测模型，减少对标注数据的依赖；(2) 其link masking策略（掩码整个链路迫使模型学习跨链路相关性）可类比到遥感多光谱/高光谱波段间的掩码预训练，学习波段间相关性；(3) 合成数据管线（ray-tracing simulation）的思路可借鉴到遥感领域，通过物理仿真生成多样化遥感图像用于预训练。但这些均为间接启发，与轻量化本身无关。

Abstract: WiFi Channel State Information (CSI) enables privacy-preserving human pose sensing in camera-denied environments, but existing WiFi-based pose estimators often fail under environment shifts and rely on costly camera-based annotation pipelines that limit scale. We propose WiFi-JEPA, a self-supervised framework that learns CSI-native representations by predicting masked latent embeddings instead of reconstructing raw CSI signals that may contain hardware-specific artifacts. WiFi-JEPA makes three contributions: (i) CSI-specific tokenization and link masking tailored to the CSI tensor over channel, time, and link (C,T,L); masking entire Tx-Rx antenna links forces the model to predict one spatial link view from others, capturing cross-link correlations informative of 3D spatial structure. (ii) A ray-tracing CSI simulation pipeline that generates diverse unlabeled CSI from randomized geometric primitives, providing scalable pre-training data without pose annotations. (iii) State-of-the-art results on Person-in-WiFi-3D: WiFi-JEPA outperforms prior WiFi-CSI baselines on both single- and multi-person 3D pose estimation under the same evaluation protocol. We also show that simulated CSI provides complementary pre-training signal to real CSI, and that four vision-native SSL objectives degrade performance below training from scratch, whereas WiFi-JEPA consistently improves downstream pose estimation.

</details>


### [122] [DDR-Net: Haze-Aware Dual-Domain Refinement for Single-Image Dehazing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11071)
*Xinye Zheng,Ye Yu,Qiang Lu,Jinsheng Luo,Yiran Cui,Yongbin Cheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种基于雾霾先验的双域细化网络(DDR-Net)用于单图像去雾，通过雾霾先验提取器、细节增强块和空间-频率瓶颈细化三个模块提升去雾效果。

Research relevance: 1分，与本研究方向基本无关。该论文聚焦于单图像去雾任务，不涉及遥感、卫星、目标检测或模型轻量化任何一方面。

Reading priority: 1分。该论文与"遥感卫星在轨目标检测与模型轻量化"方向基本无关，不建议投入时间精读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：单图像去雾(Single-image dehazing)；应用场景：通用图像去雾，非遥感场景；传感器类型：普通RGB相机；目标类别：无目标检测任务。

Model architecture: DDR-Net (Haze-Aware Dual-Domain Refinement Network)，包含三个模块：HPE (Haze Prior Extractor)提取多尺度雾霾先验、DE Blocks (Detail-Enhanced Blocks)通过梯度感知卷积增强边缘纹理、SFBR (Spatial-Frequency Bottleneck Refinement)在瓶颈处联合空间和频率信息细化特征。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明任何轻量化方法，未涉及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS、轻量网络设计等。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗等任何部署相关信息。

Datasets and metrics: 在真实世界基准数据集(real-world benchmarks)和合成数据集(synthetic datasets)上进行实验，具体数据集名称和评价指标摘要未说明。

Experiments: 在真实基准数据集上优于现有去雾方法，在合成数据集上达到有竞争力的性能。未提供具体数值对比。

Limitations: 1. 完全不涉及遥感/卫星场景；2. 无目标检测任务；3. 无任何轻量化或部署相关讨论；4. 未报告模型复杂度指标；5. 未讨论实时推理能力。

Ideas for my research: 借鉴意义有限。可考虑的点：(1) SFBR模块中空间-频率联合细化的思路，若迁移到遥感目标检测骨干网络的特征增强中可能有一定价值；(2) 梯度感知卷积(Gradient-aware convolution)对遥感图像中边缘锐利目标(如舰船、飞机)的检测可能有帮助。但整体方向差异较大，不建议作为主要参考。

Abstract: Single-image dehazing aims to recover clear scenes from haze-degraded images. It remains challenging due to the atmospheric scattering and the complexity of real-world haze distributions. Although recent end-to-end networks have achieved promising performance, two issues still limit their effectiveness: insufficient feature refinement at the bottleneck stage and weak local structural representation in encoder-decoder architectures. Thus, we propose a Haze-Aware Dual-Domain Refinement Network (DDR-Net) for single-image dehazing. Our method is built upon three modules: Haze Prior Extractor (HPE) provides multi-scale haze-aware priors by operating directly on downsampled hazy images; Detail-Enhanced Blocks (DE Blocks) serve as the core feature extraction units, capturing multi-scale structural information and enhancing edge and texture recovery via gradient-aware convolutions; and Spatial-Frequency Bottleneck Refinement (SFBR) at the bottleneck jointly exploits spatial and frequency information to refine bottleneck features. DDR-Net achieves more effective feature representation and reconstruction for haze removal. Extensive experiments on real-world benchmarks demonstrate that our method outperforms existing dehazing approaches. It achieves competitive performance on synthetic datasets.

</details>


### [123] [Do Video-LLMs Actually Watch? Diagnosing Character-Tracking Failures in Long-Form Video](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11078)
*Mohammad Al-Ratrout,Shayla Sharmin,Aditya Raikwar,Roghayeh Leila Barmaki*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文通过诊断性实验发现，当前Video-LLM在长视频角色追踪任务中的高准确率并非来自真正的角色跟踪能力，而是依赖性别等粗粒度线索，模型无法区分同性别个体。

Research relevance: 1分，与本研究方向基本无关。论文研究的是Video Large Language Model在长视频中的角色追踪（character tracking）能力，不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱/多光谱等遥感场景，也不涉及目标检测或模型轻量化。

Reading priority: 1分。与"遥感卫星在轨目标检测模型轻量化"研究方向基本无关，不建议投入时间阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：长视频角色追踪与外观变化报告；应用场景：TV episode级别的视频理解；传感器类型：普通视频（非遥感传感器）；目标类别：人物角色（非遥感目标）。

Model architecture: Video-LLM（视频大语言模型），具体包括三种架构不同的开源Video-LLM（7-8B参数量级）以及Gemini 2.5 Flash作为前沿参考。摘要未说明具体模型名称和架构细节。

Lightweight method: 不涉及。论文未讨论任何模型轻量化方法（剪枝、量化、蒸馏、NAS等）。

Onboard deployability: 不涉及。论文未讨论星上/边缘部署、参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗、实时性等部署相关信息。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：InfiniBench的global appearance task；评价指标：准确率（accuracy），以及基于九种条件诊断协议（nine-condition diagnostic protocol）的对比分析，包括角色名称替换测试、开放式问答准确率等。

Experiments: 主要发现：1）当问题中的角色名换成其他演员时，模型仅4-31%的时间改变答案，说明模型基本忽略问题所指角色；2）跨性别替换比同性别替换引起更多答案变化（13-28个百分点的差距），模型仅依赖性别粗粒度线索；3）开放式问答场景下，开源模型准确率下降18-25个百分点，151个答案无一完全正确；4）添加字幕、使用信息最丰富的帧、加倍帧数均未改善角色追踪能力。

Limitations: 1）与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化完全无关；2）论文聚焦于Video-LLM在视频角色追踪任务中的诊断性分析，不涉及任何遥感或目标检测内容；3）不提供任何可迁移至遥感轻量化检测的技术方法。

Ideas for my research: 无直接可借鉴点。该论文的研究对象（Video-LLM角色追踪）与遥感在轨目标检测轻量化方向无交集，不涉及目标检测、轻量化网络设计、星上部署等核心问题。

Abstract: Can a Video Large Language Model (Video-LLM) follow one person through a long video, keeping track of who they are well enough to report, in order, how their outfit changes across a full TV episode? Benchmarks increasingly score this kind of task, and the strongest open-source 7--8B models now reach 37--38% on InfiniBench's global appearance task, which asks exactly that. But does that score come from tracking the named character, or from something easier? We test this with a nine-condition diagnostic protocol applied to three architecturally distinct open-source Video-LLMs, with Gemini~2.5~Flash as a frontier reference, and find the accuracy does not come from character tracking. When we change the character named in the question to a different cast member, leaving the video and answer options untouched, the models change their answer only 4--31% of the time, so they are largely ignoring who the question asks about. Breaking that test down by the gender of the swapped name shows why: the models react more when the name is changed to a different-gender character than to a same-gender one (a 13--28 point gap), picking up coarse gender cues but unable to tell same-gender individuals apart. This shallow processing surfaces again when we drop the multiple-choice options and ask the same questions open-endedly: open-source accuracy drops 18--25 points, with none of 151 answers fully correct, versus a 12-point drop for Gemini. Further checks rule out the obvious innocent explanations, adding subtitles, using the most informative frames, or doubling the number of frames all leave character tracking unimproved, so the bottleneck is not how much video the model sees but how it ties that video to the person the question names. We release a diagnostic toolkit for auditing what such benchmark scores actually measure.

</details>

Abstract: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have advanced video generation with high-quality, temporally coherent results. However, extending them to motion transfer, which requires following reference motion while aligning with a target prompt, remains challenging due to limited understanding of motion and structure representations within DiTs. We analyze video DiTs at the attention-head level and identify distinct heads specialized for motion and spatial structure. Based on this insight, we propose a head-aware controllable motion transfer framework that requires no parameter updates. Our method refines motion cues from motion-specialized heads via semantic correspondence guidance and preserves structure through selective feature injection. This head-level control not only enables accurate motion transfer but also provides an interpretable foundation for controllable video generation with DiTs.

</details>


### [125] [CUST: Clustered Unit-level Similarity Transformer for Lightweight Image Super-Resolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11088)
*Jeongsoo Kim*

Research relevance: 1分，与本研究方向基本无关。论文聚焦于图像超分辨率（image super-resolution）任务，不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、SAR、高光谱、多光谱等遥感场景，也不涉及目标检测（object detection）或旋转框检测等任务。虽然涉及Transformer轻量化（窗口注意力、计算效率优化），但应用场景和任务类型与"遥感卫星在轨目标检测模型轻量化"方向无直接关联。

Reading priority: 1分。论文与遥感卫星在轨目标检测模型轻量化方向基本无关，任务类型（超分辨率）和应用场景（通用图像）均不匹配，且缺乏部署相关量化指标。仅可作为Transformer轻量设计思路的泛化参考，阅读优先级很低。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：图像超分辨率（image super-resolution）；应用场景：通用图像复原；传感器类型：摘要未说明；目标类别：不涉及目标检测，无目标类别。

Model architecture: CUST (Clustered Unit-level Similarity Transformer)：核心创新是聚类单元级相似性机制，使每个patch能在局部窗口之外的扩大区域范围内聚合和关注相似patch，捕获全局上下文；同时使用重叠注意力窗口捕获局部依赖；通过原始特征与下采样-上采样特征的残差差异显式提取高频细节。

Lightweight method: 窗口注意力机制（window-based attention）降低ViT的二次计算复杂度；聚类单元级相似性在扩大感受野的同时控制计算量；残差高频提取模块。属于轻量网络设计范畴，但不涉及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS等经典轻量化方法。

Onboard deployability: 摘要提到"lower memory footprint and faster inference speed compared to recent global context or lightweight models"，但未给出具体参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗等部署关键指标。未涉及FPGA/NPU/TensorRT等边缘部署或星上部署相关内容。

Datasets and metrics: 摘要未说明具体数据集和评价指标。

Experiments: 摘要仅说明模型在计算效率和恢复性能之间取得了平衡，相比最近的全局上下文或轻量模型实现了更低内存占用和更快推理速度，但未给出具体数值对比和消融实验结果。

Limitations: 1. 任务为图像超分辨率，非目标检测，与遥感在轨场景无关；2. 未提供参数量、FLOPs、延迟等量化指标；3. 未在遥感数据集上验证；4. 未讨论星上/边缘部署的硬件适配问题。

Ideas for my research: 1. CUST中"聚类单元级相似性"的思路——在扩大感受野的同时控制计算复杂度——可借鉴到遥感目标检测的backbone设计中，解决大尺度遥感图像中全局上下文与计算效率的矛盾；2. 重叠窗口注意力机制可用于遥感旋转框检测中的特征提取；3. 残差高频细节提取模块可能对小目标检测（如遥感图像中的小舰船、小车辆）有启发意义；4. 但整体而言，该论文与课题方向弱相关，借鉴价值有限，不建议作为核心参考。

Abstract: Recently, Vision Transformer (ViT)-based models have exhibited remarkable performance in image super-resolution. However, the quadratic computational complexity of ViTs with respect to spatial resolution severely constrains their efficiency, leading to high latency and massive memory consumption. To alleviate this, various window-based attention mechanisms have been proposed; yet, they inherently compromise the long-range dependency modeling that is the primary advantage of ViTs. To overcome these limitations, we propose the Clustered Unit-level Similarity Transformer (CUST), a novel architecture that efficiently integrates global and local information. Specifically, CUST enables each patch to aggregate and attend to similar patches within a broadened regional scope outside its local window, thereby capturing extensive contextual understanding. Furthermore, it employs overlapping attention windows to capture local dependencies, while explicitly extracting high-frequency details by computing the residual difference between the original features and their downsampled-upsampled counterparts. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that our proposed model achieves a practical balance between computational efficiency and restoration performance. It achieves a lower memory footprint and faster inference speed compared to recent global context or lightweight models under realistic constraints. Code is available at [https://github.com/jwgdmkj/CUST].

</details>


### [126] [Why Low-Light Cameras Go Color Blind: Removing Color Bias in Raw Denoising](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11090)
*Mohammad Mohammadi,Sina Honari,Stavros Tsogkas,Tristan Aumentado-Armstrong,Michael S. Brown,Iqbal Mohomed,Konstantinos G. Derpanis,Alex Levinshtein,Igor Gilitschenski*

TL;DR: 提出一种与相机无关、无需标定的低光原始图像去噪方法，通过偏置估计网络预测黑电平误差以校正颜色偏移，在ELD/SID/LRID数据集上达到领先的去噪和色彩校正效果。

Research relevance: 1分，与本研究方向基本无关。论文聚焦低光原始图像去噪（low-light raw denoising），不涉及遥感/卫星场景、目标检测任务，也不涉及任何模型轻量化或星上部署技术。虽然去噪可作为遥感图像预处理的一环，但论文未提及遥感应用，且核心问题是相机黑电平误差校正，与遥感在轨目标检测及轻量化无直接关联。

Reading priority: 1分。论文与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，不建议优先阅读。除非后续研究涉及低光遥感图像raw域去噪预处理，否则参考价值极低。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务：低光原始图像去噪（low-light raw denoising）；场景：通用摄影/手机摄影低光环境；传感器类型：通用raw域相机传感器；目标类别：不涉及目标检测。与遥感、卫星、SAR、高光谱、多光谱无关。

Model architecture: 提出一个偏置估计网络（bias estimator network），用于预测黑电平误差（black-level error）作为噪声输入的全局特征（global feature）。摘要未说明具体网络结构细节（如backbone、层数、是否基于CNN/Transformer等）。

Lightweight method: 不涉及任何轻量化方法。未提及剪枝（pruning）、量化（quantization）、知识蒸馏（knowledge distillation）、NAS、轻量网络设计、实时推理、边缘部署、FPGA/NPU/TensorRT等。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗等部署相关信息。论文未考虑星上或边缘部署场景。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：ELD, SID, LRID（低光raw去噪数据集）；额外提及SIDD数据集存在颜色偏差问题并进行了校正。评价指标：摘要未明确说明具体指标（可能为PSNR/SSIM等图像质量指标）。

Experiments: 在ELD、SID、LRID三个数据集上评估，在盲去噪方法中表现优越，尤其在色彩校正方面。与有更强监督的方法相比具有竞争力甚至超越。此外，发现SIDD数据集ground-truth存在显著颜色偏差，提出了新的ground-truth提取框架并提供了校正后的基准。

Limitations: 1. 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化完全无关；2. 未讨论模型效率、参数量、推理速度等部署关键指标；3. 仅针对低光raw域去噪，未验证在遥感图像（如多光谱、高光谱、SAR）上的适用性；4. 未涉及目标检测任务，无法判断去噪对检测精度的影响。

Ideas for my research: 1. 低相关：该论文的偏置估计思想（全局特征预测传感器偏差）在遥感图像辐射校正或传感器非均匀性校正中可能有借鉴意义，但需大幅改造；2. 低相关：raw域去噪方法若轻量化后，可作为遥感在轨预处理流水线的一环，但论文本身未做轻量化工作；3. 整体而言，对本课题的直接借鉴价值有限。

Abstract: Raw images inherently suffer from noise due to the stochastic nature of light and sensor hardware imperfections. As real photon counts fall, the ratio of this noise to the signal degrades; consequently, for low-light conditions, robust denoising is especially vital for high-quality results. While recent data-driven methods achieve strong performance, they typically rely on large-scale noisy-clean image pairs that are costly and difficult to collect. Alternatively, parametric noise models can generate synthetic training data, but this necessitates precise camera calibration, which is often impractical for unknown devices. In this work, we propose a camera-agnostic, calibration-free paradigm for low-light raw denoising. We identify that color bias from black-level error is a primary source of performance degradation and causes severe color shifts. To mitigate this, we introduce a bias estimator network that predicts the black-level error as a global feature of the noisy input. We evaluate our approach across the ELD, SID, and LRID datasets, demonstrating superior performance among blind denoisers, particularly in terms of color correction. In many cases, we are competitive with-or can even surpass-methods with stronger supervision. Furthermore, we reveal that the widely used SIDD dataset contains significant color bias in its ground-truth images, which yields unrealistic color reproduction in trained models. We introduce a new ground-truth extraction framework to resolve this issue and provide a benchmark of existing methods on the corrected dataset.

</details>

Ideas for my research: 弱相关，借鉴价值有限。唯一可参考的点是"without auxiliary heads, multi-pass inference, or additional modules"这一设计理念——在遥感目标检测轻量化中也可追求无额外分支/多轮推理的简洁设计，但本文方法本身不直接适用于遥感目标检测任务。

Abstract: In this paper, we propose a training strategy for confidence estimation in omnidirectional stereo, targeting the ambiguous matches that frequently occur in wide-baseline setups. Reinterpreting the matching responses produced by the 3D encoder decoder block, we show that their expectation values provide intrinsic confidence signals. Building on this, our method directly penalizes ambiguous responses without auxiliary heads, multi-pass inference, or additional modules, resulting in more efficient and generalized predictions. Beyond confidence, we introduce swept feature volume resampling, where response features produced by 3D CNNs are resampled using regressed positive matching indices and then processed by 2D CNNs to predict meta-information such as surface normals. This joint learning introduces auxiliary geometric regularization and improves depth coherence by leveraging additional contextual cues during response aggregation stage. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach enhances both confidence estimation and surface normal prediction while maintaining deployment practicality for autonomous mobility applications.

</details>

*Zheng Zhang,Hao Tang,Yingying Hu,Zhanli Hu,Jing Qin*

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗、实时性等部署相关信息。从方法性质看，辛积分器推理可能计算开销较大，不适用于星上/边缘部署场景。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：BrainWeb、临床儿科数据集、UDPET数据集；评价指标：SSIM、PSNR；实验设置：与最先进的确定性和随机性基线对比，评估低对比度病灶恢复能力。

Experiments: FlowPET在SSIM和PSNR上超越SOTA基线，并在低对比度病灶恢复方面表现出显著优势。验证了哈密顿结构约束在高噪声场景下对医学逆问题的几何保护作用。

Limitations: 1. 与遥感/卫星/目标检测/轻量化完全无关；2. 未讨论计算效率、实时性、模型大小等部署关键指标；3. 辛几何方法的计算复杂度可能较高，不利于资源受限场景；4. 仅在医学PET数据上验证，未在遥感数据上测试。

Ideas for my research: 弱相关，但以下思路可能有间接启发：1. 物理信息引导的模型设计思路（如将遥感成像物理模型嵌入网络）可借鉴；2. Range-Null空间分解的数据一致性约束思想可用于遥感图像复原或超分任务；3. 体积保持传输防止信号湮灭的思路，对遥感小目标检测中防止弱特征丢失可能有理论参考价值。但整体而言，该论文对"在轨遥感目标检测模型轻量化"课题的直接借鉴价值有限。

Abstract: Low-count Positron Emission Tomography (PET) reconstruction is severely hindered by the dissipative nature of prevailing generative models, where the inherent phase-space contraction leads to the numerical extinction (``wash-out'') of weak but diagnostically critical lesion signals. To overcome this geometric limitation, we propose \textbf{FlowPET}, a physics-informed framework that reformulates reconstruction as volume-preserving transport in a symplectic phase space. By parameterizing the posterior dynamics via a Separable Hamiltonian System, our approach guarantees a divergence-free vector field by construction, theoretically immunizing weak signals against probability mass collapse. To steer this conservative flow, we introduce conjugate boundary conditions based on the Range-Null space decomposition of the PET operator; this strictly enforces data consistency in the range space while confining stochastic uncertainty injection to the unobserved null space. We train the model via symplectic flow matching and perform inference using a symplectic leapfrog integrator. Extensive experiments on BrainWeb, clinical pediatric, and UDPET datasets demonstrate that \textbf{FlowPET} not only surpasses state-of-the-art deterministic and stochastic baselines in SSIM and PSNR but, more crucially, exhibits superior recovery of low-contrast lesions. The results confirm that imposing Hamiltonian structural constraints offers a robust geometric safeguard for medical inverse problems in high-noise regimes.

</details>


### [129] [Beyond the Eye: Efficient Multimodal Reasoning via Self-Regulated Implicit Visual Tools](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11106)
*Xiuwei Chen,Quanlin Chen,Wentao Hu,Zisheng Chen,Kun Xiang,Zehua Ma,Mingyang Zhang,Jianhua Han,Hanhui Li,Hang Xu,Xiaodan Liang*

Main category: cs.CV

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：多模态大语言模型的细粒度视觉感知推理（fine-grained visual perception）；应用场景：通用视觉问答与推理；传感器类型：自然图像（非遥感）；目标类别：通用视觉对象（非特定遥感目标）。

Model architecture: BEE范式基于MLLM架构，核心设计包括：(1) Formalized Chain-of-Thought (CoT) Supervised Fine-tuning (SFT) —— 构建含结构化工具槽和混合调用状态的CoT轨迹；(2) Self-regulated Reward-Driven Alignment —— 引入Net Tool Gain (NTG)指标量化冗余工具调用，并设计自调节奖励机制惩罚无效工具依赖。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、显存、能耗等部署指标。仅提及"substantially reducing inference latency"（显著降低推理延迟），但未给出具体数值或与轻量化部署相关的硬件平台信息（FPGA/NPU/TensorRT等）。

Datasets and metrics: 摘要未说明具体数据集名称和评价指标。仅提及在fine-grained visual perception任务上达到SOTA，在general reasoning tasks上保持竞争力。

Experiments: 摘要未提供具体实验结果、对比方法或消融实验细节。

Limitations: (1) 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测完全无关；(2) 未涉及任何模型轻量化核心技术；(3) 方法依赖MLLM架构，参数量巨大，不适合星上部署；(4) 实验细节缺失，无法评估实际效率提升幅度。

Abstract: Recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made remarkable progress on fine-grained perception tasks under the "Thinking with Images" (TwI) paradigm by iteratively performing various visual tool operations. However, this paradigm relies heavily on frequent external tool calls and repeated image re-encoding, which leads to substantial computational overhead and inference latency. To address these issues, we propose Beyond the Eye (BEE), a novel implicit visual tool paradigm centered on self-regulated capability. BEE directly incorporates visual tool invocation behaviors into the training objective and encourages the model to develop a self-regulated invocation mechanism. This design enables the model to adaptively balance internal knowledge and implicit tools, avoiding redundant tool usage while substantially reducing inference latency. Specifically, BEE involves a two-stage training process: (1) Formalized Chain-of-Thought (CoT) Supervised Fine-tuning (SFT). We construct CoT trajectories with structured tool slots and mixed invocation states. This stage activates the model's implicit tool representations and adaptive switching capability. (2) Self-regulated Reward-Driven Alignment. To address redundant tool usage caused by ambiguous cognitive boundaries, we first introduce the Net Tool Gain (NTG) metric to quantify this phenomenon. Based on this observation, we further propose a self-regulated reward mechanism. This mechanism penalizes ineffective tool dependency and encourages the model to perform knowledge routing, ensuring that implicit tools are invoked only when the model's internal knowledge is insufficient. BEE achieves state-of-the-art performance in fine-grained visual perception while remaining competitive in general reasoning tasks and achieving substantial gains in inference efficiency.

</details>


### [130] [GHOST: Geometry-Guided Hallucination of Opaque Surface Textures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11118)
*Langxu Zhao,Zuan Gu,Tianhan Gao*

Abstract: Transparent objects pose a fundamental challenge for depth estimation and 3D reconstruction due to their violation of Lambertian assumptions, leading to severe geometry degradation in downstream tasks. To address this, we propose a novel geometry-guided preprocessing framework \textbf{GHOST} that leverages visual foundation models to transform transparent regions into opaque, structurally consistent representations without requiring downstream model retraining. Specifically, our pipeline utilizes (1) \textbf{TransDINO} and (2) \textbf{TransDecomp} to disentangle masks and transparency physical properties, while (3) \textbf{DAF-Net} recovers surface normal priors to encode geometric curvature. Subsequently, (4) \textbf{GeoSemTransNet} integrates these multi-modal cues to synthesize a texture-rich opaque RGB image that preserves the transparent object's 3D structure. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method significantly enhances the accuracy of state-of-the-art depth estimation and reconstruction models on transparent objects by restoring essential photometric cues.

</details>

*Vikas Kumar,Aditya Mishra,Haroon R. Lone*

TL;DR: 本文面向ABAW 2026 BAH挑战赛中的犹豫/矛盾情绪识别任务，提出融合文本、音频、视觉特征的多模态情感识别系统，核心贡献在于利用ASR擦除时间特征捕捉非语言犹豫信号。

Abstract: We address ambivalence and hesitancy (A/H) recognition in the ABAW 2026 BAH Challenge: given a short interview video, predict whether the person shows signs of A/H. Our system combines affect-specialised text, audio, and visual representations with a small set of readable linguistic hesitation cues, fused by a reliability gate we call Affective Marker Fusion (AMF), and finished with a simple AP-weighted ensemble at a fixed decision threshold. We also introduce \emph{ASR-erased time}: speech recognisers delete fillers and hesitation pauses from the transcript, but the chunk timestamps keep the time those events took, and sixteen features built from these gaps form the strongest and most independent non-verbal channel we measured (AP $0.718$, correlation $0.11$--$0.36$ with all other members). Across controlled experiments we find three things: cross-modal conflict design does not reliably help on BAH; language is by far the strongest channel while affect-specialised audio is a useful second; and calibration matters more than architecture. Fitting ensemble weights and a threshold on the small validation split overfits: it scores $0.741$ macro-F1 on validation but only $0.690$ on the untouched test set. AP-weighting at a fixed threshold instead reaches $\mathbf{0.731}$ on test.

</details>


### [132] [SISA-Rec: A Semantically Integrated Sequential Recommender with Contrastive Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11168)
*Soohan Abbasi,Shahid Munir Shah,Rafia Shaikh,Mahmoud Aljawarneh*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一个基于Transformer的序列推荐系统SISA-Rec，通过门控融合模块将BERT语义嵌入与物品ID嵌入结合，提升稀疏和冷启动场景下的推荐性能。

Research relevance: 1分，与本研究方向基本无关。该论文研究的是推荐系统（recommendation systems）中的序列推荐问题，完全不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、目标检测或模型轻量化。虽然使用了Transformer架构，但应用场景和任务目标与遥感卫星在轨目标检测模型轻量化无任何交集。
