Abstract: We introduce Skill Learning from Video Memory (SLVMBench), the first benchmark that jointly evaluates whether video large language models (video-LLMs) can learn skills from long video memory and apply them to real-time tasks. SLVMBench presents models with 2-3 hour video streams that contain a tutorial video embedded in a stream of arbitrary irrelevant videos, resembling real-world human learning practices. Video-LLMs are asked to apply the acquired skill to answer real-time questions about an ongoing video. Unlike long-video understanding benchmarks that emphasize passive comprehension and skill-learning benchmarks that rely on short, immediate demonstrations, SLVMBench tests the full pipeline of memorizing and extracting procedural knowledge, as well as transferring it to real-time tasks. Moreover, rigorous human annotations feature sub-second-level temporal calibration, manually engineered questions eliminating common-sense guessing, and collated tutorials to ensure coverage of the required skills. Evaluations on state-of-the-art proprietary and open-source video LLMs show that video-LLMs struggle substantially with learning and applying skill knowledge from videos. Moreover, performance degrades markedly when the skill knowledge is placed within a long video memory. These results reveal a key limitation of existing video LLMs and position SLVMBench as the first benchmark for studying real-time skill acquisition and application from long-context video memory.

</details>


### [150] [HierCAD: Hierarchical Text-to-CAD Design via Structure Alignment and Parameter Grounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11339)
*Jimin Xu,Tianbao Wang,Tao Jin,Zhou Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出HierCAD，一种分层文本生成CAD框架，通过结构对齐和参数接地策略提升复杂设计的结构一致性和几何参数预测精度。

Research relevance: 1分，与本研究方向基本无关。该论文聚焦于text-to-CAD（文本生成计算机辅助设计模型），属于计算机图形学/3D生成领域，完全不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱、多光谱等遥感场景，也不涉及目标检测或轻量化部署。

Reading priority: 1分。与"遥感卫星在轨目标检测模型轻量化"课题完全无关，不建议阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务：text-to-CAD生成（文本到CAD模型生成）；场景：计算机辅助设计/3D建模；传感器类型：不适用；目标类别：CAD构件（非遥感目标）。

Model architecture: HierCAD框架，包含分层CAD构造树分解（object-level procedural reasoning + part-level topology reasoning trajectories），以及SAPG（Structure Alignment and Parameter Grounding）学习策略。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明任何轻量化方法（无剪枝、量化、蒸馏、NAS、轻量网络等）。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗、实时性等部署相关信息。该工作不涉及星上/边缘部署。

Datasets and metrics: 摘要未说明具体数据集名称和评价指标（仅提及CAD sequence generation和reconstructed CAD model evaluation）。

Experiments: 实验表明HierCAD在CAD序列生成和重建模型评估上优于先前SOTA方法。摘要未提供具体数值对比。

Limitations: 与遥感在轨目标检测轻量化方向完全无关，无任何可借鉴的轻量化或目标检测技术。该论文解决的是3D CAD生成的结构一致性和参数预测问题。

Ideas for my research: 无直接可借鉴点。该论文属于完全不同的研究领域（text-to-CAD生成），不涉及遥感、目标检测或模型轻量化中的任何核心技术。

Abstract: Recent text-to-CAD approaches have shown promising results by leveraging large language models, but they often struggle with maintaining structural consistency in complex designs and accurately grounding geometric parameters. To address these issues, we propose HierCAD, a hierarchical text-to-CAD framework that improves both structural reasoning and parameter prediction. HierCAD reformulates CAD generation as progressive reasoning by decomposing CAD construction trees into object-level procedural reasoning and part-level topology reasoning trajectories. To further improve generation fidelity, we introduce a unified Structure Alignment and Parameter Grounding (SAPG) learning strategy. Structure alignment aligns topology reasoning trajectories with their corresponding parametric CAD spans, while parameter grounding mitigates shortcut learning through structure-preserving parameter perturbations and ranking-based supervision. Experiments demonstrate that HierCAD outperforms prior state-of-the-art methods on both CAD sequence generation and reconstructed CAD model evaluation. Our code is available at https://github.com/Collab-Gen/HierCAD.

</details>


### [151] [Longitudinal Multi-View Breast Cancer Risk Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11343)
*Solveig Thrun,Zijun Sun,Suaiba A. Salahuddin,Kristoffer Wickstrøm,Elisabeth Wetzer,Stine Hansen,Robert Jenssen,Michael Kampffmeyer*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出LMV-Net，一种纵向多视图乳腺癌风险预测模型，通过显式对齐CC和MLO视图的时空信息提升筛查准确率。

Research relevance: 1分，与本研究方向基本无关。论文聚焦于乳腺癌风险预测（breast cancer risk prediction），属于医学影像分析领域，完全不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱/多光谱、空间在轨智能等遥感相关主题，也不涉及目标检测或模型轻量化。

Reading priority: 1分。与"遥感卫星在轨目标检测模型轻量化"研究方向基本无关，不建议阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务：乳腺癌风险预测（breast cancer risk prediction）；场景：筛查性乳腺X光摄影（screening mammography）；传感器：乳腺X光机（非遥感传感器）；目标类别：乳腺癌风险等级。与遥感目标检测无关。

Model architecture: LMV-Net，纵向多视图（longitudinal multi-view）架构，联合分析CC和MLO两个解剖互补视图，并显式对齐纵向时间序列信息。具体模块细节摘要未说明。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明任何轻量化方法（无剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS、轻量网络等）。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗、实时性等部署相关信息。不涉及星上/边缘部署。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：EMBED（公开）、CSAW-CC（公开）；评价指标：整体风险预测性能、不同乳腺密度和癌症亚组性能。具体指标名称摘要未说明。

Experiments: 与SOTA乳腺癌风险预测方法对比，LMV-Net在整体性能和亚组性能上均优于现有方法。消融实验摘要未说明。

Limitations: 与遥感在轨目标检测轻量化方向完全无关，无任何可迁移的技术或思路。医学影像多视图对齐方法对遥感场景无直接借鉴意义。

Ideas for my research: 无借鉴点。该论文属于医学影像分析领域，不涉及遥感、目标检测或模型轻量化中的任何一个核心要素。

Abstract: Accurate breast cancer risk prediction from screening mammography is critical for enabling personalized screening intervals and early detection. Recent deep learning methods have shown the value of longitudinal data and explicit temporal alignment. However, existing approaches either perform explicit alignment using a single mammographic view or model multiple views without explicit longitudinal alignment, limiting their ability to exploit the complementary spatial-temporal information used in clinical practice. To address this gap, we propose LMV-Net, a longitudinal multi-view breast cancer risk prediction model that jointly analyzes anatomically complementary CC and MLO views within an explicitly aligned longitudinal framework. We evaluate our approach on the public EMBED and CSAW-CC datasets, comparing it to state-of-the-art breast cancer risk prediction methods. Our model consistently outperforms existing approaches in overall risk prediction performance and across different breast density and cancer subgroups. Importantly, these improvements highlight the potential of longitudinal multi-view modeling to enhance risk stratification, paving the way for future work on personalized screening, earlier identification of high-risk patients, and more efficient screening resource allocation. The code is available at https://github.com/sot176/LMV-Net.

</details>


### [152] [Benchmarking Edge Inference Strategies for Deep Learning Models in Industrial Machine Vision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11356)
*Miguel Gomez Fernandez,David Castro Boga,Roi Mendez-Rial,Eric Lopez-Lopez*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 系统比较了PyTorch、ONNX Runtime、OpenVINO、TensorRT四种推理框架在工业边缘设备上的推理速度，发现OpenVINO在CPU上最优，TensorRT在GPU上最优但对Transformer模型效果有限。

Research relevance: 2分（弱相关）。论文涉及边缘部署和推理加速（TensorRT/OpenVINO等），与轻量化部署有技术交集，但场景是工业机器视觉，**完全不涉及遥感、卫星、航空图像、SAR/高光谱/多光谱等遥感数据**，也没有目标检测任务或遥感特定目标（舰船/飞机/车辆）。属于泛视觉/泛机器学习方法，对轻量化部署工具有参考价值，但与遥感卫星在轨目标检测方向弱相关。

Reading priority: 2分。与遥感卫星在轨目标检测轻量化方向弱相关，但可作为推理引擎选型的背景参考。如果课题涉及TensorRT/OpenVINO在星载硬件上的部署优化，可快速浏览其实验设置和结论。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：推理框架性能对比（分类/检测未明确指定）；应用场景：工业机器视觉边缘部署；传感器类型：摘要未说明；目标类别：摘要未说明。**无遥感场景、无遥感目标**。

Model architecture: 对比了传统CNN和Transformer-based vision model（具体架构摘要未说明）。未涉及遥感专用模型（如旋转框检测、小目标检测网络）。

Lightweight method: 不涉及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS等模型压缩方法。聚焦于**推理引擎优化**（ONNX Runtime、OpenVINO、TensorRT）的部署加速对比，属于推理后端优化而非模型轻量化本身。

Onboard deployability: 涉及CPU和GPU硬件平台，测量指标仅为**inference time（推理时间）**。摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、显存、能耗等部署关键指标。未涉及星上部署（FPGA/NPU/宇航级芯片）相关讨论。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：摘要未说明；评价指标：仅inference time（推理时间）。无遥感数据集（如DOTA、HRSC2016、DIOR、NWPU VHR-10等）。

Experiments: 主要结论：OpenVINO在CPU上推理最快，TensorRT在GPU上推理最快；但TensorRT对Transformer模型未优于plain PyTorch。无遥感场景实验，无目标检测精度（mAP）对比。

Limitations: 1. 仅对比推理速度，未涉及精度-速度权衡；2. 未涉及模型压缩（量化/剪枝）与推理引擎的联合优化；3. 未涉及遥感场景下的特殊需求（大尺寸图像、旋转目标、小目标）；4. 未讨论星上部署的功耗、辐射加固等约束；5. Transformer模型仅一个，结论泛化性有限。

Ideas for my research: 1. **推理引擎选型参考**：在轨部署若使用GPU（如NVIDIA Jetson系列），TensorRT是首选；若使用CPU（如星载CPU），OpenVINO值得关注；2. **Transformer模型部署陷阱**：TensorRT对Transformer的加速效果可能不理想，需针对性优化或考虑其他方案；3. **可复现方向**：在遥感目标检测模型（如YOLO系列、RetinaNet等）上系统对比ONNX/TensorRT/OpenVINO在星载硬件上的推理性能，填补该论文的遥感场景空白。

Abstract: Edge deployment is often the preferred solution for industrial machine vision systems when low latency, data security, or limited connectivity are critical requirements. Several frameworks are available to optimise inference on edge devices; however, relatively few studies have systematically compared their inference-time performance under industrial deployment conditions.
  In this work, we present a comparative study of four widely used approaches for machine vision inference in industrial settings: plain PyTorch, ONNX Runtime, OpenVINO, and TensorRT. The evaluation focuses on inference time, covers several CPU- and GPU-based hardware platforms, and includes both conventional convolutional neural networks and a transformer-based vision model. For the hardware platforms and models evaluated, the results show that OpenVINO achieves the lowest inference time on CPUs, while TensorRT achieves the lowest inference time on GPUs. However, TensorRT does not outperform plain PyTorch for the transformer-based model considered in this study.

</details>


### [153] [Efficient Tuning Before Low-Bit Post-Training Quantization for Stochastic Gradient Descent-optimized Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11359)
*Peng Xia,Junbiao Pang,Muhammad Ayub Sabir*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出ETBQ方法，在量化前对全精度模型进行预调谐，使其对后续低比特PTQ的量化误差更鲁棒，从而提升低比特量化精度。

Research relevance: 2分——弱相关。论文聚焦于通用的模型量化方法（PTQ），属于模型轻量化/压缩技术范畴，但完全不涉及遥感、卫星、在轨部署场景，实验仅在CIFAR-100、Tiny-ImageNet、ImageNet、Cityscapes等通用数据集上进行，无任何遥感数据或遥感目标检测任务验证。

Reading priority: 2分——弱相关，可作为量化方法的背景参考，但非遥感场景核心文献。如果课题涉及低比特量化在遥感目标检测上的应用，可阅读其方法思路，但需自行迁移验证。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：图像分类（CIFAR-100, Tiny-ImageNet, ImageNet）和语义分割（Cityscapes）。应用场景：通用视觉任务，非遥感场景。传感器类型：自然图像。目标类别：通用物体类别，非遥感特定目标（舰船、飞机、车辆等）。

Model architecture: 摘要未说明具体模型架构，但提到适用于SGD优化的模型，且方法与具体网络结构无关（model-agnostic）。

Lightweight method: 量化（Post-training Quantization, PTQ），具体为低比特量化（W2A4, 2-bit权重/4-bit激活）。提出ETBQ（Efficient Tuning Before Quantization），在PTQ之前对全精度模型进行预调谐，通过模拟权重量化和激活量化的误差分布来扰动模型参数，引导模型进入对后续量化误差不敏感的损失景观区域。不同于QAT（量化感知训练），ETBQ不训练伪量化部署模型，计算和内存开销更低。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗等具体部署指标。仅提及ETBQ比QAT计算和内存开销更低，但未给出定量数据。未涉及FPGA/NPU/TensorRT等硬件部署。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：CIFAR-100, Tiny-ImageNet, ImageNet（分类），Cityscapes（语义分割）。评价指标：Top-1 accuracy（分类），mIoU（分割）。

Experiments: 在W2A4设置下，ETBQ相比naive PTQ在Tiny-ImageNet上提升2.14% Top-1准确率，在Cityscapes上提升5.80% mIoU。实验覆盖多个数据集和任务，提供了一致性的改进证据。

Limitations: 1. 仅在通用视觉数据集上验证，未在遥感图像（如SAR、高光谱、多光谱）上测试，量化误差分布特性可能不同；2. 仅验证了W2A4设置，其他比特组合（如W4A8、W2A8等）未提及；3. 未讨论目标检测任务（如YOLO系列、Faster R-CNN等）上的量化效果；4. 无实际边缘/星上部署的延迟、功耗等实测数据。

Ideas for my research: 1. ETBQ的"量化前预调谐"思路可迁移到遥感目标检测模型的低比特量化中，尤其是针对遥感图像中噪声分布与自然图像不同的特点，可设计针对遥感场景的量化误差扰动分布；2. 该方法与PTQ后端解耦，可配合TensorRT等推理加速工具使用，适合星上部署场景；3. 可尝试将ETBQ与遥感目标检测模型（如轻量YOLO系列）结合，验证其在遥感数据集（如DOTA、HRSC2016、SSDD等）上的低比特量化效果；4. 需注意该方法目前仅在分类和分割任务上验证，在旋转框检测等遥感特有任务上的适用性需进一步实验。

Abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) compresses deep neural networks for deployment under limited memory and computational budgets. However, low-bit (i.e., 2-bit or 4-bit) PTQ often suffers from substantial performance degradation. Most existing PTQ methods operate on an unconstrained full-precision (FP) model and primarily address quantization errors through post-hoc reconstruction. We argue that low-bit PTQ accuracy is limited not only by post-quantization error minimization, but also by the quantization-error tolerance of a FP model itself. In this paper, we propose Efficient Tuning Before Quantization (ETBQ), a pre-conditioning tuning stage for Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD)-optimized models before PTQ. During tuning, the FP model is optimized under perturbations sampled from the error distributions of weight and activation quantization, guiding the model toward a loss-landscape region that is less sensitive to the subsequent PTQ. Unlike QAT, ETBQ does not train a fake-quantized deployment model, which is computationally and memory intensive. Instead, ETBQ outputs a FP model that can be used by any PTQ backend. Experiments on CIFAR-100, Tiny-ImageNet, ImageNet, and Cityscapes provide consistent evidence that ETBQ improves low-bit PTQ across diverse tasks. Under W2A4 settings, e.g., ETBQ improves over naive PTQ by 2.14\% top-1 accuracy on Tiny-ImageNet and by 5.80\% mIoU on Cityscapes. Code is available at https://github.com/xpxpxp2001xpxpxp/ETBQ.

</details>


### [154] [Self-supervised training for high-resolution close-range multispectral remote sensing imagery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11366)
*Leon-Friedrich Thomas,Mikael Änäkkälä,Antti Lajunen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文评估了自监督学习（MoCo-v3和MAE）预训练Transformer编码器在高分辨率多光谱无人机影像上的效果，用于精准农业中的作物-杂草语义分割，并发布了芬兰多年度多光谱无人机数据集。

Research relevance: 2分——弱相关。论文涉及遥感（无人机多光谱影像）和自监督学习，但任务为语义分割而非目标检测，场景为精准农业而非卫星在轨遥感，且完全不涉及模型轻量化、压缩或星上部署。与"遥感卫星在轨目标检测与模型轻量化"方向相关性较弱。

Reading priority: 1分——与课题方向弱相关。任务类型（语义分割 vs 目标检测）、平台（无人机 vs 卫星）、关注点（预训练效果 vs 轻量化部署）均不匹配，不建议优先阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：语义分割（crop-weed semantic segmentation）；应用场景：精准农业（precision agriculture）；传感器类型：无人机多光谱相机（RedEdge-M, Sequoia），4波段（Green, Red, Red-Edge, Near-Infrared）；目标类别：作物与杂草；数据来源：无人机低空遥感，非卫星平台。

Model architecture: Transformer-based encoders，具体为Swin Transformer；预训练框架：MoCo-v3（Momentum Contrast v3）和Masked Autoencoders（MAE）。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明任何轻量化方法。不涉及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS、模型压缩或加速技术。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗等部署相关信息。论文未讨论星上或边缘部署可行性。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：msuav500K + 新采集的芬兰多年度多光谱无人机影像（已公开）；下游评估数据集：WeedMap；评价指标：摘要未明确说明具体指标（如mIoU等）；实验设置：Task A（德国，RedEdge-M传感器，5-100%训练数据，部分微调和全微调），Task B（瑞士，Sequoia传感器，仅评估Task A最优编码器）。

Experiments: Swin Transformer + MoCo-v3预训练在Task A和Task B上均取得最优性能，超越了Doornbos等人的Swin Transformer模型（在msuav500K预发布版本上预训练）；验证了跨传感器、跨区域的泛化能力。

Limitations: 1. 任务为语义分割而非目标检测，与课题方向任务类型不匹配；2. 仅涉及无人机低空遥感，非卫星在轨场景；3. 完全不涉及模型轻量化、压缩或部署；4. 未讨论推理速度、模型大小等实际部署指标；5. 仅使用4个多光谱波段，未涉及全色、SAR、高光谱等常见卫星遥感数据。

Ideas for my research: 1. 自监督预训练（MoCo-v3, MAE）在遥感数据上的有效性可借鉴，但需迁移到目标检测任务；2. Swin Transformer作为骨干网络在遥感多光谱数据上的表现值得关注，但其计算量大，需结合轻量化设计；3. 跨传感器/跨区域泛化验证思路可用于评估轻量化模型的泛化能力；4. 整体而言，本文对"在轨轻量化目标检测"的直接借鉴价值有限。

Abstract: Although self-supervised learning (SSL) offers a promising way to reduce annotation effort in close-range remote sensing, its effectiveness for high-resolution multispectral unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) imagery remains underexplored due to limited data. This study evaluated SSL pretraining for precision agriculture using cm-scale multispectral drone imagery collected across multiple sensors, years, and regions. Transformer-based encoders were pretrained with Momentum Contrast v3 (MoCo-v3) and Masked Autoencoders on a harmonized dataset combining msuav500K with newly collected multi-year UAV imagery from agricultural fields in Finland. Pretraining used four spectral bands (Green, Red, Red-Edge, Near-Infrared) for cross-sensor compatibility. The models were evaluated on crop-weed semantic segmentation using the WeedMap dataset with 5--100% training data. The following two subsets served as downstream tasks: Task A (Germany, RedEdge-M), where all pretrained models were compared under partial and full fine-tuning, and Task B (Switzerland, Sequoia), where the best encoder from Task A was assessed. Our Swin Transformer pretrained with MoCo-v3 achieved the strongest performance on both tasks, surpassing the Swin Transformer model of Doornbos et al. pretrained on a pre-release of msuav500K. Our pretrained Swin Transformer further demonstrated cross-sensor and cross-region generalization. We additionally provide a public multi-year multispectral UAV dataset from Finland to support future research.

</details>


### [155] [Uncertainty Quantification for EO Regression Tasks: Building Height, Tree Canopy Height and Above-ground Biomass Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11412)
*Ritu Yadav,Andrea Nascetti,Yifang Ban*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出两种不确定性估计方法（高斯UC和分位数UC），用于Sentinel-1 SAR和Sentinel-2 MSI时序数据上的建筑高度、冠层高度、地上生物量等EO回归任务，提升预测可靠性。

Research relevance: 1分。论文涉及遥感（Sentinel-1 SAR、Sentinel-2 MSI、Earth observation回归任务），但与目标检测无关，与模型轻量化/在轨部署无关。属于遥感回归任务中的不确定性估计方法研究，不涉及检测任务，也不涉及任何模型压缩或加速技术。

Reading priority: 1分。与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，不建议优先阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：EO回归任务（建筑高度估计、冠层高度估计、地上生物量估计）；传感器：Sentinel-1 SAR、Sentinel-2 MSI多时相数据；空间分辨率：10 m；目标类别：连续值回归（非目标检测）；场景：城市、森林、气候监测。

Model architecture: 两种方法：(i) Gaussian UC——在高斯假设下联合预测均值和标准差；(ii) Quantile UC——估计第10、50、90分位数以捕捉非对称和异方差误差分布。具体骨干网络结构摘要未说明。

Lightweight method: 摘要未涉及任何轻量化方法（无剪枝、量化、蒸馏、NAS、轻量网络等）。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗等任何部署相关信息。未讨论星上或边缘部署可行性。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：基于Sentinel-1 SAR和Sentinel-2 MSI年时序数据；三个代表性EO回归任务；空间分辨率10 m。评价指标：摘要提到"well-calibrated, interpretable, and operationally useful confidence estimates"，具体指标名称未说明。

Experiments: 两种方法在三个EO回归任务上匹配或超越确定性基准和现有全球产品；在冠层高度估计任务上超越当前10 m空间分辨率的最优不确定性感知模型。具体数值结果摘要未说明。

Limitations: 1. 与目标检测完全无关，不涉及任何检测框架或检测指标；2. 未讨论模型效率、参数量、推理速度等部署关键指标；3. 未涉及轻量化技术；4. 未讨论星上在轨推理的可行性。

Ideas for my research: 弱相关，借鉴价值有限。如果研究方向涉及遥感回归任务中的不确定性估计，可参考其Gaussian UC和Quantile UC两种建模思路；但对"在轨遥感目标检测模型轻量化"课题，该论文不提供目标检测方法、不提供轻量化技术、不提供部署指标，直接借鉴意义较小。

Abstract: Earth Observation regression tasks such as building height, canopy height, and above-ground biomass estimation underpin critical applications in urban planning, forest monitoring, and climate policy, where both accuracy and reliability are critical. Yet most deep learning models yield only deterministic predictions, providing no indication of per-pixel reliability. These regression tasks are inherently challenging due to heterogeneous land surfaces, skewed target distributions, sensor noise, and signal saturation at high target values, making uncertainty (UC) estimation essential for reliable inference. We address this gap by modeling aleatoric uncertainty using year-long Sentinel-1 SAR and Sentinel-2 MSI time series, proposing two complementary approaches: (i) Gaussian UC, which jointly predicts mean and standard deviation under a Gaussian assumption, and (ii) Quantile UC, which estimates the 10th, 50th, and 90th quantiles to capture asymmetric and heteroscedastic error distributions. Both models are evaluated on three representative EO regression tasks at 10 m spatial resolution. Results show that both approaches match or surpass deterministic benchmarks and existing global products, while delivering well-calibrated, interpretable, and operationally useful confidence estimates. Notably, both models outperform the current 10 m state-of-the-art uncertainty-aware model for canopy height estimation. Our implementation will be available at: https://github.com/RituYadav92/EO-Regression-Uncertainty-Estimation

</details>


### [156] [Video Transformer for Remote Identity Document Hologram Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11419)
*Joris Voerman,Nicolas Sidere,Jean-Christophe Burie*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出基于视频Transformer的远程身份证件全息图检测系统，用于手机视频中的证件真伪验证。

Research relevance: 1分，与本研究方向基本无关。论文聚焦于身份证件全息图检测的远程身份验证场景，不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱/多光谱等遥感核心要素，也不涉及目标检测或轻量化在轨部署。

Reading priority: 1分，与"遥感卫星在轨目标检测与模型轻量化"方向基本无关，不建议优先阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务：身份证件全息图检测（hologram detection）；场景：远程身份验证、手机视频采集；传感器类型：智能手机摄像头（可见光视频）；目标类别：全息图（holographic printing）。与遥感目标检测无关。

Model architecture: 基于视频Transformer（video transformer）的全息图检测模型。摘要未说明具体Transformer架构细节。

Lightweight method: 摘要提到"model adaptation to frugality, both for training samples and computational resources"，暗示了模型在计算资源受限条件下的适应性，但未明确说明使用了剪枝、量化、蒸馏、NAS等具体轻量化方法。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗等部署指标。系统设计为手机端采集+服务器端验证，非边缘/星上部署场景。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：MIDV-Holo（身份证件全息图检测基准数据集）；评价指标：Recall、Accuracy；报告了+26.86% Recall和+17.93% Accuracy的提升。

Experiments: 在MIDV-Holo数据集上超越SOTA方法，达到近完美精度（near-perfect accuracy），在中到小规模数据集上表现良好。包含模型在训练样本和计算资源上的节俭性（frugality）适应实验。

Limitations: 1. 与遥感/卫星/在轨目标检测完全无关；2. 未提供参数量、FLOPs等轻量化关键指标；3. 未说明具体轻量化技术（剪枝/量化/蒸馏等）；4. 场景为手机端+服务器端，非边缘/星上实时推理场景。

Ideas for my research: 借鉴意义有限。唯一可参考的点：论文中"model adaptation to frugality"的思路——在训练样本少和计算资源受限条件下保持模型性能，这对遥感在轨场景的数据稀缺和资源受限问题有一定启发性，但具体方法未展开，需阅读全文。

Abstract: Remote identity authentification using Identification Documents has been a major challenge for several years. DeepFakes advent and the development of AI-guided tools helps fraudsters creating counterfeit ID Documents. Ensuring the authenticity of ID Documents has become a real clue in the seurization of remote authentification. This need is all the more pressing given the increasing digitization of administrative and transactional processes. To ensure widespread accessibility, the system should rely solely on video captured via mobile devices. In this specific context, confirming the authenticity of ID is a real challenge as many security features needs specific device like infrared sensor for instance. Among underutilized but promising security features, holographic printings hold a special place. Difficult to counterfeit, they produce distinctive visual effects according enlightment, making them both detectable in a video captured by a smartphone camera and difficult to imitate. In this paper, we propose a Remote Identity Document Verification System (RIDVS) and an approach based on a video transformer for detecting holograms in simple videos captured by smartphones. Our system is designed for a smartphone-based capture process, followed by a server-side verification. The hologram detection method builds on a robust model previously validated in a related research domain. We demonstrate that it outperforms existing SotA methods, achieving near-perfect accuracy even when trained on medium- to small-sized datasets. In particular, we report improvements of +26.86\% in Recall and +17.93\% in accuracy over the best MIDV-Holo baseline. This study includes several experiments that evaluate the model adaptation to frugality, both for training samples and computational resources.

</details>


### [157] [Towards Efficient Convolutional Neural Network for Embedded Hardware via Multi-Dimensional Pruning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11473)
*Hao Kong,Di Liu,Xiangzhong Luo,Shuo Huai,Ravi Subramaniam,Christian Makaya,Qian Lin,Weichen Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出TECO多维剪枝框架，协同剪枝CNN的深度、宽度和分辨率三个维度，以提升在嵌入式硬件上的执行效率。

Research relevance: 2分 — 弱相关。该论文提出通用的CNN多维剪枝框架，面向嵌入式硬件部署，属于模型轻量化/压缩方法，对"轻量化"有直接贡献。但论文完全未涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image等遥感场景，也未涉及目标检测任务（仅提CNN通用架构）。因此与"遥感卫星在轨目标检测"方向弱相关，仅在剪枝方法论上有可借鉴性。

Reading priority: 3分 — 中等优先级。作为剪枝方法论有参考价值，但因完全脱离遥感场景和目标检测任务，优先级低于直接面向遥感目标检测轻量化的论文。建议作为剪枝技术储备阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 摘要未说明具体任务类型和应用场景。未涉及遥感/卫星场景。未说明传感器类型和目标类别。论文面向通用CNN在嵌入式硬件上的高效执行。

Model architecture: 面向通用CNN架构，提出多维剪枝框架TECO，剪枝维度包括深度（depth）、宽度（width）和分辨率（resolution）。未指定具体CNN backbone。

Lightweight method: 结构化剪枝（multi-dimensional pruning）。核心方法：(1) 两阶段重要性评估框架（two-stage importance evaluation），综合评估每个剪枝单元在维度内局部重要性和跨维度全局重要性；(2) 启发式剪枝算法（heuristic pruning algorithm），逐步剪枝三个维度以在精度与效率间取得最优权衡。未涉及量化、蒸馏、NAS。

Onboard deployability: 目标平台为嵌入式硬件（embedded hardware），但摘要未给出具体参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗等量化指标。未提及FPGA/NPU/TensorRT/星上部署。

Datasets and metrics: 在多个benchmark上验证（摘要未说明具体数据集名称和评价指标）。

Experiments: 实验表明TECO优于现有SOTA方法。摘要未提供具体数值对比和消融实验细节。

Limitations: (1) 未在遥感/卫星场景下验证；(2) 未针对目标检测任务设计；(3) 未给出具体硬件部署的延迟/能耗/吞吐量等量化指标；(4) 未说明剪枝后模型在边缘设备上的实际推理速度；(5) 仅涉及剪枝，未结合量化、蒸馏等其他轻量化手段。

Ideas for my research: (1) 可借鉴其"多维度协同剪枝"思路，将深度、宽度、分辨率三个维度同时剪枝的思想引入遥感目标检测模型（如YOLO系列、RetinaNet等）的轻量化中；(2) 两阶段重要性评估（局部+全局）的设计思路可用于评估遥感检测模型中各通道/层/分辨率的重要性；(3) 启发式渐进剪枝策略可复现并适配到遥感场景；(4) 需补充：在遥感数据集（如DOTA、HRSC2016、DIOR）上验证，并报告mAP、参数量、FLOPs、推理延迟等指标。

Abstract: In this paper, we propose TECO, a multi-dimensional pruning framework to collaboratively prune the three dimensions (depth, width, and resolution) of convolutional neural networks (CNNs) for better execution efficiency on embedded hardware. In TECO, we first introduce a two-stage importance evaluation framework, which efficiently and comprehensively evaluates each pruning unit according to both the local importance inside each dimension and the global importance across different dimensions. Based on the evaluation framework, we present a heuristic pruning algorithm to progressively prune the three dimensions of CNNs towards the optimal trade-off between accuracy and efficiency. Experiments on multiple benchmarks validate the advantages of TECO over existing state-of-the-art (SOTA) approaches. The code and pre-trained models are available at https://github.com/ntuliuteam/Teco.

</details>


### [158] [HyperGS: Fast and Generalizable Gaussian Video Representation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11500)
*Fatimah Zohra,Chen Zhao,Shuming Liu,Yahya Al Malallah,Bernard Ghanem*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出HyperGS，一种前馈式无需逐视频优化的高斯泼溅视频表示方法，通过分解时空Transformer和可学习查询Transformer直接从视频预测高斯参数，实现编码速度提升10^4-10^5倍并支持零样本泛化到高分辨率视频。

Research relevance: 1分，与本研究方向基本无关。该论文聚焦于**视频表示与重建**（video representation & reconstruction），使用Gaussian Splatting进行视频编码/解码加速，完全不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、目标检测或模型轻量化部署。虽然涉及模型加速（feedforward预测替代逐视频优化），但应用场景和任务目标与遥感在轨目标检测轻量化无任何交集。

Reading priority: 1分。该论文与"遥感卫星在轨目标检测模型轻量化"方向基本无关，不涉及遥感场景、目标检测任务或模型压缩轻量化技术。不建议优先阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：视频表示与重建（video representation & reconstruction）；应用场景：通用视频编码/渲染；传感器类型：不涉及遥感传感器；目标类别：不涉及目标检测。摘要未说明任何遥感相关场景。

Model architecture: HyperGS包含两个核心模块：(1) 分解时空Transformer（factorized spatiotemporal Transformer），从视频中提取tokens；(2) 可学习查询Transformer（learnable query-based Transformer），为每帧预测8参数2D Gaussian表示。此外设计了基于秩的几何正则化器（rank-based geometric regularizer）来稳定训练，防止"针状退化"（needle-like degeneration）。

Lightweight method: 本文的"轻量化"体现在用前馈预测（feedforward prediction）替代逐视频优化（per-video optimization），实现编码加速10^4-10^5倍。但这属于**推理加速**而非模型压缩轻量化，不涉及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS等典型轻量化技术。且加速对象是视频编码过程，而非目标检测模型。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、显存、能耗等部署关键指标。虽然编码速度快（10^4-10^5×加速），但这是相对于逐视频优化而言，不涉及星上/边缘部署可行性。模型包含Transformer结构，计算开销可能较大，不适合资源受限的星上环境。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：K400（Kinetics-400）、SSv2（Something-Something v2）、UCF101；评价指标：PSNR（峰值信噪比），HyperGS在K400、SSv2、UCF101上相比先前视频编码器提升+2.9-3.1 dB，且视频表示尺寸更小。

Experiments: 主要实验：在K400、SSv2、UCF101三个视频数据集上对比先前视频编码方法，PSNR提升2.9-3.1 dB；编码速度提升10^4-10^5倍；零样本泛化到720p视频。摘要未说明消融实验和与SOTA方法的详细对比。

Limitations: (1) 与遥感在轨目标检测完全无关，无法直接借鉴；(2) 模型包含Transformer，参数量和计算量可能较大，未报告FLOPs和参数量；(3) 仅针对视频重建任务，不涉及检测、分类等高层视觉任务；(4) 零样本泛化到720p视频，但更高分辨率或更复杂场景下的表现未知。

Ideas for my research: 虽然本文与遥感在轨目标检测轻量化方向弱相关，但以下思路可能有间接启发：(1) **前馈预测替代迭代优化**的思想——在星上场景中，是否可以用轻量前馈网络替代传统迭代式检测流程（如NMS后处理加速）？(2) **分解时空Transformer**的设计思路——如果处理遥感视频流（如卫星视频目标检测），可借鉴其分解式注意力机制降低计算复杂度；(3) **秩正则化**（rank-based geometric regularizer）防止训练崩溃的思路，可用于遥感小目标检测中缓解梯度不稳定问题。但整体借鉴价值有限。

Abstract: Gaussian Splatting has emerged as an effective representation for video, but existing methods rely on per-video optimization. This leads to slow encoding and limits generalization across videos. To amortize this optimization, we propose HyperGS, a feedforward, optimization-free approach that directly predicts Gaussian representations from any video in a single forward pass, speeding up encoding and decoding by orders of magnitude while generalizing to out-of-distribution videos at higher resolutions. In HyperGS, we design a factorized spatiotemporal Transformer to extract tokens from video, and a learnable query-based Transformer to obtain 8-parameter Gaussian representations for each video frame. We find that naively predicting Gaussians across diverse videos induces a needle-like degeneration that collapses training, and address this with a rank-based geometric regularizer whose strength adapts dynamically to stabilize optimization. HyperGS achieves encoding at $10^4$--$10^5\times$ the speed of per-video Gaussian optimization at matched reconstruction quality while generalizing zero-shot to $720p$ video, enabling higher-resolution rendering without re-encoding. HyperGS improves PSNR by +2.9--3.1 dB over the prior video encoders on K400, SSv2, and UCF101 at a smaller video representation size. By predicting explicit 2D Gaussians in a single forward pass, HyperGS combines the fast, flexible rendering of Gaussian Splatting with the speed and generalization of feedforward prediction, advancing Gaussians as a practical direction for fast and generalizable video representation.

</details>


### [159] [CFR-Net:Collaborative Feature Refnement Network for Medical Image Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11509)
*Zihan Nie,Muhao Xu,Wei Feng,Yuan Cui,Hua Wei,Sijie Niu,Yi Wan,Xunbin Wei,Weiye Song,Zongyuan Ge*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出CFR-Net，通过共享教师-学生特征精炼和跨空间一致性学习，解决医学图像异常检测中域适应和细粒度特征建模问题。

Research relevance: 1分，与本研究方向基本无关。论文聚焦医学图像异常检测（medical image anomaly detection），完全不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱、多光谱等遥感场景，也不涉及目标检测或轻量化部署。

Reading priority: 1分，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关，不建议优先阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务：医学图像异常检测（anomaly detection/classification/localization）；场景：医学影像；传感器类型：摘要未说明（医学图像如X光/CT/MRI等）；目标类别：异常区域（fine-grained local shifts, multi-scale contextual mismatches, orientation-sensitive structural deviations）。

Model architecture: CFR-Net (Collaborative Feature Refinement Network)：共享教师-学生架构，包含Multi-Path Feature Refinement Module (MPFRM) 用于特征精炼，解码前共享参数精炼+解码后跨空间一致性学习。

Lightweight method: 摘要未涉及任何轻量化方法（无剪枝、量化、蒸馏、NAS、轻量网络设计等）。虽然使用了教师-学生架构，但目的是域适应和特征精炼，而非模型压缩或加速。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗、实时性等任何部署相关信息。不涉及星上/边缘部署。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：医学基准数据集（medical benchmarks，具体名称摘要未说明）；评价指标：异常分类（anomaly classification）和异常定位（anomaly localization）性能。

Experiments: 在医学基准上，CFR-Net在仅使用正常数据训练时，取得了有竞争力的异常分类和强异常定位性能。未提供与遥感方法的对比。

Limitations: 1. 完全面向医学领域，与遥感场景无关；2. 未涉及轻量化或部署优化；3. 未报告计算开销；4. 教师-学生架构的额外推理开销可能较大，不适合资源受限场景。

Ideas for my research: 弱相关，借鉴价值有限。但教师-学生特征精炼的思想（共享参数的多路径精炼模块MPFRM）在理论上可迁移到遥感域适应场景（如不同卫星传感器间的特征对齐），但需要大幅改造且不涉及轻量化核心问题。

Abstract: Medical image anomaly detection remains challenging because networks pretrained on natural images often exhibit limited adaptability to medical images, where abnormal patterns appear as fine-grained local shifts, multi-scale contextual mismatches, and orientation-sensitive structural deviations. To address this, we propose the Collaborative Feature Refinement Network (CFR-Net), which combines shared teacher-student feature refinement before decoding with cross-space consistency after decoding. CFR-Net refines frozen teacher features and trainable student features using a Multi-Path Feature Refinement Module (MPFRM) with shared parameters, imposing common multi-path refinement rules on generic visual references and representations adapted to the medical domain, thereby mitigating domain discrepancy while modeling local, multi-scale, and orientation-sensitive feature characteristics. A variance-sensitive objective and dynamic ``homework set'' reorganization further support layer-adaptive consistency learning. Experiments on medical benchmarks show that CFR-Net achieves competitive anomaly classification and strong anomaly localization performance when trained on normal data.

</details>


### [160] [Vinci2: Providing Proactive Assistance in Continuous Egocentric Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11523)
*Gong Sitong,Tianyu Yan,Caixin Kang,Bo Zheng,Xiang Ruan,Huchuan Lu,Kaipeng Zhang,Yoichi Sato,Yifei Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Vinci2/EgoMemo，一个面向连续自我中心视频的主动式智能辅助系统，核心贡献在于构建了主动辅助决策基准EgoServe和无需训练的记忆增强智能体EgoMemo。

Research relevance: 1分，与本研究方向基本无关。论文聚焦于第一人称连续视频中的主动式智能辅助（proactive assistance），属于可穿戴设备/AR/人机交互领域，完全不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、SAR、高光谱/多光谱图像、空间在轨智能等遥感核心内容；不涉及目标检测（object detection）、小目标检测、旋转框检测、遥感场景理解等遥感视觉任务；不涉及轻量化、剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS、实时推理、边缘部署、星上部署、FPGA/NPU/TensorRT等模型压缩与部署技术。

Reading priority: 1分。与"遥感卫星在轨目标检测模型轻量化"研究方向基本无关，不建议投入时间精读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：主动式智能辅助决策（proactive assistance decision-making）；应用场景：连续自我中心视频（continuous egocentric video），如智能眼镜/可穿戴设备；传感器类型：RGB摄像头（egocentric camera）；目标类别：10类服务场景（安全警报、习惯指导等），非遥感目标。

Model architecture: EgoMemo：训练无关（training-free）、记忆增强智能体，包含三种互补记忆表示——多尺度时间摘要（multi-scale temporal summaries）、语义知识图谱（semantic knowledge graph）、视觉嵌入档案（visual embedding archives），通过检索增强推理（retrieval-augmented reasoning）判断是否提供辅助。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明轻量化方法。虽然提及"on-device"（设备端），但未涉及剪枝、量化、蒸馏、NAS等具体轻量化技术，也未报告参数量、FLOPs、延迟等部署指标。

Onboard deployability: 摘要仅提及"on-device assistant"，暗示设备端部署意图，但未提供参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗、实时性等任何具体部署指标。与星上部署（onboard satellite deployment）完全无关。

Datasets and metrics: EgoServe：首个面向连续自我中心视频中主动辅助的大规模基准，包含3000+服务实例，沿4个时间记忆维度组织（即时安全警报到长期习惯指导），覆盖10个服务类别。评价指标：摘要未明确说明具体指标。

Experiments: EgoMemo在EgoServe上建立了强基线（strong baselines），并在现有自我中心基准（existing egocentric benchmarks）上保持竞争力。摘要未提供具体数值对比。

Limitations: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向完全无关，无法直接借鉴。论文聚焦于人机交互中的主动辅助决策，而非视觉感知中的目标检测任务。

Ideas for my research: 弱相关，借鉴价值有限。唯一可参考的点是"training-free"（无需训练）的设计思路——在遥感在轨场景中，如果能够设计无需在轨微调即可适应新任务的轻量检测模型，可能降低星上计算开销。但论文核心的"记忆增强推理"机制与遥感目标检测任务差异过大，直接迁移意义不大。

Abstract: When should an intelligent assistant speak up without being asked? Continuous egocentric video offers rich, evolving context that enables a new form of assistance: one that is proactive rather than merely reactive. Yet existing approaches either wait passively for user queries or treat every detected event as requiring a response, without considering the user's history, current activity, or whether assistance would actually be welcome. We reframe proactive assistance as a context-dependent decision problem: the agent must not only perceive what is happening, but reason over accumulated temporal context to determine when and whether to intervene. To this end, we present Vinci2, a proactive egocentric assistance system that advances the on-device assistant Vinci from reactive response toward proactivity. On the evaluation side, we present EgoServe, the first large-scale benchmark for proactive assistance in continuous egocentric video. EgoServe comprises over 3,000 service instances organized along 4 temporal memory horizons, ranging from immediate safety alerts to long-term habit coaching, across 10 service categories. On the modeling side, we propose EgoMemo, a training-free, memory-augmented agent that maintains three complementary memory representations: multi-scale temporal summaries, a semantic knowledge graph, and visual embedding archives. At each timestep, EgoMemo performs retrieval-augmented reasoning to determine whether assistance is warranted and, if so, produces contextually grounded responses. Experiments demonstrate that EgoMemo establishes strong baselines on EgoServe while remaining competitive on existing egocentric benchmarks. Our benchmark and code are publicly available at \href{https://sitonggong.github.io/EgoServe-page/}{Vinci2}.

</details>


### [161] [Parse, Search, and Confirmation: Training-Free Aerial Vision-and-Dialog Navigation with Chain-of-Thought Reasoning and Structured Spatial Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11529)
*Yu Qi,Hongyu Li,Shaofei Huang,Tianrui Hui,Yaxiong Wang,Lechao Cheng,Zhun Zhong,Si Liu,Meng Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出PSC-AVDN，一种无需训练的训练自由框架，通过三段式解析-搜索-确认推理流水线与结构化空间记忆，解决高空无人机航拍场景下的视觉与对话导航任务。

Research relevance: 2分——弱相关。论文涉及aerial（航拍/高空无人机）场景，属于遥感/卫星相关的大范畴，但核心任务是Vision-and-Dialog Navigation（视觉与对话导航），而非目标检测；且不涉及任何轻量化方法（剪枝、量化、蒸馏等），也不涉及在轨部署或星上推理。因此与"遥感卫星在轨目标检测模型轻量化"方向弱相关。

Reading priority: 1分——与研究方向基本无关。不涉及遥感目标检测，不涉及轻量化方法，不涉及星上部署。仅因"aerial"场景与遥感有弱关联，给予1分而非0分。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：Aerial Vision-and-Dialog Navigation (AVDN，航拍视觉与对话导航)；应用场景：高空无人机（high-altitude UAV）导航；传感器类型：航拍视觉传感器（具体传感器类型摘要未说明）；目标类别：无目标检测任务，涉及导航目的地/区域定位。

Model architecture: PSC-AVDN框架包含：(1) 三段式推理流水线：Parsing（解析阶段，用LLM将模糊对话指令转为几何方向与目的地线索）、Search Chain-of-Thought (S-CoT，搜索思维链，逐步目标探索)、Confirmation Chain-of-Thought (C-CoT，确认思维链，候选区域细粒度验证)；(2) Structured Spatial Memory (SSM，结构化空间记忆)，融合多尺度视觉观测、空间视觉记忆、结构化几何记忆三种空间线索。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明任何轻量化方法。论文采用training-free（无需训练）策略，但这是指不进行微调训练，而非模型压缩或加速。不涉及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS、轻量网络设计等。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗等部署相关信息。论文声称面向resource-efficient（资源高效）的高空无人机导航，但未给出具体效率指标。由于依赖LLM和MLLM（多模态大语言模型），实际部署到星上或边缘设备的可行性存疑。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：ANDH和ANDH-Full（航拍视觉与对话导航数据集）；评价指标：摘要未说明具体指标名称，仅提及"state-of-the-art performance"。

Experiments: 在ANDH和ANDH-Full上，PSC-AVDN在training-free设置下达到新SOTA，匹配或超越若干微调方法。具体数值摘要未说明。

Limitations: (1) 与遥感在轨目标检测完全无关，不涉及任何检测任务；(2) 不涉及任何模型轻量化或压缩技术；(3) 依赖大语言模型（LLM/MLLM），计算开销大，不适合星上部署；(4) 未报告参数量、FLOPs、推理速度等效率指标；(5) 场景限定于高空无人机导航，非卫星遥感场景。

Ideas for my research: (1) 论文中的Structured Spatial Memory（结构化空间记忆）概念可借鉴到遥感目标检测中，用于融合多尺度/多时相遥感特征，提升检测一致性；(2) Chain-of-Thought推理思路可启发遥感检测中的多阶段精化策略（如粗检+细检级联）；(3) 但整体而言，该论文与"在轨遥感目标检测模型轻量化"课题的直接借鉴价值有限，不建议作为核心参考。

Abstract: In this paper, we tackle the Aerial Vision-and-Dialog Navigation (AVDN) task in the training-free setting for resource-efficient high-altitude UAV navigation.Naively applying MLLMs leads to unreliable navigation due to weak directional grounding and the lack of explicit spatial memory.To address these issues, we propose PSC-AVDN, a training-free framework that tightly couples a three-stage Parsing-Search-Confirmation reasoning pipeline with a Structured Spatial Memory (SSM).The parsing stage uses an LLM to convert ambiguous dialogue instructions into stable geometric directional and destination cues.A Search Chain-of-Thought (S-CoT) then performs stepwise target exploration under high-altitude observations, and a Confirmation Chain-of-Thought (C-CoT) conducts fine-grained verification around candidate regions to resolve visual ambiguity.Meanwhile, SSM integrates three complementary sources of spatial cues, including multi-scale visual observation, spatial visual memory, and structured geometric memory to provide global spatial context and long-horizon consistency.Extensive experiments on ANDH and ANDH-Full show that PSC-AVDN establishes new state-of-the-art performance in the training-free setting, matching or surpassing several finetuned methods.Code will be publicly available at: https://github.com/QY6616/PSC-AVDN

</details>


### [162] [Adaptive Routing for Efficient Diffusion Transformer-Based PNI Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11533)
*Youngung Han,Dohyun Kweon,Kyeonghun Kim,Hyunsu Go,Jina Jeong,Suah Park,Induk Um,Junga Kim,Anna Jung,Yului Jeong,Sungha Park,Jinyong Jun,Pa Hong,Woo Kyoung Jeong,Won Jae Lee,Ken Ying-Kai Liao,Hyuk-Jae Lee,Nam-Joon Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种基于扩散分类器和Transformer的胆管癌神经侵犯术前预测方法，并通过自适应路由机制降低计算开销。

Research relevance: 1分，与本研究方向基本无关。论文研究的是医学影像（MRI）中的胆管癌神经侵犯预测，完全不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱/多光谱等遥感场景，也不涉及目标检测任务，更不涉及在轨部署或星上推理。

Reading priority: 1分，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关，不建议深入阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务：医学影像分类（胆管癌神经侵犯预测）；场景：术前MRI诊断；传感器：MRI（磁共振成像）；目标类别：perineural invasion（神经侵犯）。与遥感目标检测完全无关。

Model architecture: 基于Transformer的扩散分类器（diffusion-based classifier），去噪网络采用Transformer表示，引入自适应路由机制（adaptive routing across attention heads, spatial tokens, and MLP width）。

Lightweight method: 自适应路由（adaptive routing）——在注意力头、空间token和MLP宽度三个维度上进行动态路由选择，以减少计算冗余。但这是针对医学影像分类任务的效率优化，并非面向遥感在轨部署的轻量化方法（如剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS等）。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明星上/边缘部署相关信息。仅报告了计算量257.57 GFLOPs，该数值对于星上部署而言过高（通常星上模型需在几GFLOPs以内），且未报告参数量、延迟、显存、能耗等关键部署指标。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：摘要未说明具体数据集名称；评价指标：AUC（0.731）。

Experiments: 仅报告了AUC=0.731和计算量257.57 GFLOPs，未提供与基线方法的详细对比或消融实验结果。

Limitations: 1. 与遥感/卫星/在轨目标检测完全无关；2. 计算量高达257.57 GFLOPs，远超出星上部署可接受范围；3. 仅报告AUC指标，缺乏精度-召回率、F1等更全面的评估；4. 未报告参数量、推理延迟等效率指标；5. 自适应路由方法虽可降低计算开销，但未与标准轻量化方法（剪枝、量化等）对比。

Ideas for my research: 弱相关，借鉴价值有限。可能的间接启发：1. 自适应路由（adaptive routing）的思想——在注意力头、token、MLP维度动态选择计算路径，可作为一种轻量化策略的思路，但需验证其在遥感目标检测模型上的有效性；2. 扩散模型用于分类的框架设计思路，但遥感在轨场景对实时性要求极高，扩散模型的迭代推理机制不适合星上部署。

Abstract: Perineural invasion (PNI) is a critical prognostic factor in cholangiocarcinoma. However, its preoperative prediction from magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) remains challenging due to subtle imaging features that extend beyond tumor boundaries into surrounding regions. Conventional convolutional neural networks are limited in capturing long-range spatial dependencies. Transformer-based architectures improve global modeling of volumetric MRI by aggregating spatially distributed contextual cues, yet capturing subtle and noise-sensitive patterns in peritumoral regions remains challenging. Diffusion-based classifiers offer an alternative formulation by leveraging denoising-based class scoring to better capture such subtle patterns. However, these approaches introduce substantial computational overhead due to the combination of transformer-based modeling and iterative denoising processes. To address these challenges, we formulate PNI prediction as a diffusion-based classification problem and implement the denoising network using a transformer-based representation. To improve computational efficiency, we introduce adaptive routing across attention heads, spatial tokens, and MLP width. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed approach achieves an AUC of 0.731 with 257.57 GFLOPs.

</details>


### [163] [Training-Free Off-Screen Player Imputation for Broadcast-Based Spatial Football Analytics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11548)
*Seongjin Choi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究足球广播视频中因球员离屏导致的球场控制率估计偏差，提出无需训练的角色锚定质心投票插补方法，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测轻量化方向无关。

Research relevance: 1分。论文完全聚焦于体育分析（足球广播视频中的球员位置插补与球场控制率估计），不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱/多光谱等任何遥感相关领域；不涉及目标检测（虽涉及球员位置，但核心问题是插补而非检测）；不涉及模型轻量化、剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS、边缘部署等任何轻量化技术。与"遥感卫星在轨目标检测模型轻量化"研究方向基本无关。

Reading priority: 1分。与遥感卫星在轨目标检测轻量化方向基本无关，不建议投入时间精读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务：足球广播视频中离屏球员位置插补（imputation）；场景：体育分析/足球比赛；传感器类型：广播主摄像机（broadcast main camera）；目标类别：足球运动员（22名球员中的10-16名可见）。

Model architecture: 摘要未说明具体模型架构。方法为训练无关（training-free）的在线插补基线，核心方法是角色锚定质心投票（role-anchored centroid voting）。

Lightweight method: 不涉及。论文方法本身是training-free的，但并非为模型轻量化设计，与剪枝、量化、蒸馏、NAS等无关。

Onboard deployability: 不涉及。论文未讨论星上/边缘部署、参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗、实时性等部署相关信息。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：Metrica Sports公开全场追踪数据（三场比赛，一场留出用于方法开发）；评价指标：隐藏区球场控制率误差（hidden-zone pitch-control error, 25.1-26.9个百分点）、平均绝对控制份额误差（mean absolute control-share error, 11.1-13.4个百分点）、中位数位置误差（binwise median position error, 3.3-8.9 m）。

Experiments: 在三个比赛数据集上评估了可见基线（visible-only baseline）和多种训练无关在线插补基线。角色锚定质心投票方法将隐藏区误差减半（至12.2-13.8个百分点），控制份额误差降至忽略策略的28-48%。在遮挡≤9.6秒时中位数位置误差为3.3-8.9 m。在真实世界杯广播窗口上，插补使下游空间创造指数（Space-Creation Index）变化15.6和17.2个百分点，翻转了一个窗口的判定结果。

Limitations: 50-57%的离屏球员观测超出9.6秒遮挡范围，方法在该长遮挡场景下的性能未充分验证；方法仅在足球场景验证，泛化性未知；未涉及任何遥感或目标检测场景。

Ideas for my research: 弱相关，借鉴价值有限。可能的间接启发：1) training-free的在线插补思路在遥感卫星场景中若存在部分目标被遮挡/截断的情况，可考虑类似的不依赖额外训练数据的补全策略；2) 角色锚定（role-anchored）思想可类比遥感中利用目标类别先验知识（如舰船朝向、飞机机型）来辅助遮挡推理。但整体而言，该论文与课题方向差距较大。

Abstract: Spatial football metrics such as pitch control assume access to the positions of all 22 players, yet the most widely available source of positional data -- the broadcast main camera -- shows only 10-16 of them at any moment. We quantify the resulting distortion with an open, reproducible benchmark: a simulated broadcast viewport applied to open full-pitch tracking data (Metrica Sports; three matches, one held out from method development). Ignoring off-screen players -- the visible-only baseline implied whenever a video-based game-state-reconstruction (GSR) pipeline adds no imputation layer -- inflates hidden-zone pitch-control error to 25.1-26.9 percentage points and a mean absolute control-share error of 11.1-13.4 points across the three matches. We then evaluate a ladder of training-free, online imputation baselines that use only observations from the match being analysed. The best overall on these decision-relevant metrics, role-anchored centroid voting (each visible player votes for the full-team centroid by subtracting its running role offset, attenuating the viewport-induced subset bias), roughly halves hidden-zone error (to 12.2-13.8 points) and cuts control-share error to 28-48% of the ignore policy at every viewport width from 36 m to 60 m in all three matches. For occlusions <=9.6 s -- the regime of the closest learned prior work -- it reaches binwise median position errors of 3.3-8.9 m; but 50-57% of hidden-player observations lie beyond that regime. Integrated end-to-end into a broadcast-video GSR pipeline, imputation moves a downstream possession-quality score (Space-Creation Index) by 15.6 and 17.2 points on two real World Cup broadcast windows, flipping the verdict class in one.

</details>


### [164] [Single-Teacher View Augmentation: Enhancing Knowledge Distillation with Student-Guided Perturbations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11557)
*Xuyi Yu,Yaohua Liu,Ziming Song,Yinghai Zhao,Huipeng Zhang,Kuizhi Mei*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Shift-Augmented Knowledge Distillation (SAKD)，利用学生网络动态特征生成自适应多样化视角，实现单阶段多视角知识蒸馏，在CIFAR-100和ImageNet上达到与两阶段方法相当的精度且无需预训练。

Research relevance: 1分。该论文与遥感、卫星、在轨部署、目标检测均无直接或间接关联。论文聚焦通用图像分类任务上的知识蒸馏方法改进，实验仅在CIFAR-100和ImageNet上进行，不涉及遥感场景、目标检测任务或轻量化部署。

Reading priority: 2分。与"遥感卫星在轨目标检测模型轻量化"方向弱相关。虽然知识蒸馏是轻量化的重要手段之一，但该论文聚焦通用分类任务，未涉及遥感场景、目标检测或部署指标，借鉴价值有限。建议仅作为知识蒸馏方法背景参考。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：图像分类（知识蒸馏）；应用场景：通用视觉；传感器类型：无；目标类别：CIFAR-100和ImageNet通用类别。不涉及遥感目标检测。

Model architecture: 基于知识蒸馏框架，教师网络提供静态特征，学生网络提供动态特征作为扰动生成条件。核心模块为参数无关的cyclic shift操作生成多样化视角。未说明具体backbone网络结构。

Lightweight method: 涉及知识蒸馏（KD），属于模型压缩/轻量化方法之一。但论文聚焦蒸馏方法本身的改进（多视角生成），而非面向部署的轻量化（如剪枝、量化、NAS等）。未讨论参数量、FLOPs、延迟等部署指标。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗等部署相关信息。仅提到"significantly fewer parameters and eliminating pre-training requirements"指与两阶段多教师方法相比，而非面向边缘/星上部署的指标。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：CIFAR-100, ImageNet；评价指标：分类精度（accuracy）。不涉及遥感数据集或目标检测指标（mAP, FPS等）。

Experiments: 在CIFAR-100和ImageNet上，SAKD一致优于随机扰动方法，精度与两阶段方法相当，参数更少且无需预训练。未提供与遥感目标检测相关的实验。

Limitations: 1. 仅在通用图像分类任务上验证，未在目标检测或遥感场景下测试；2. 未讨论在边缘设备或星上平台的部署可行性；3. 未提供计算开销（FLOPs、延迟）等量化指标；4. 未说明cyclic shift操作对遥感图像中旋转目标、小目标的适应性。

Ideas for my research: 1. SAKD中利用学生动态特征生成多样化视角的思路，可尝试迁移到遥感目标检测的知识蒸馏中，解决遥感场景下教师模型与学生模型特征分布差异大的问题；2. 参数无关的cyclic shift操作可作为轻量级数据增强/视角生成模块，嵌入遥感检测蒸馏框架；3. 但需注意：该方法目前仅在分类任务验证，迁移到遥感旋转框检测或小目标检测时需要重新设计扰动生成策略。

Abstract: Knowledge distillation (KD) typically relies on the fixed perspective of a single teacher, limiting the diversity of supervisory signals. While multi-teacher distillation addresses this by aggregating knowledge from multiple models, it incurs prohibitive computational and storage costs. To balance efficiency and diversity, recent research has focused on generating virtual views from a single teacher. However, existing methods face a trade-off: random perturbation approaches offer efficiency but lack controlled diversity, while structured augmentation methods require multi-stage training and incur linear parameter growth. We observe that this trade-off stems from a common design choice: using the teacher's strong but static features to generate views. Instead, we propose Shift-Augmented Knowledge Distillation (SAKD), a simple yet effective framework that leverages the student's evolving features as a dynamic condition for perturbation generation. This shift in perspective enables single-stage training while producing adaptive, diverse views through a parameter-free cyclic shift. Extensive experiments on CIFAR-100 and ImageNet demonstrate that SAKD consistently outperforms random perturbation methods and achieves accuracy on par with two-stage approaches, while using significantly fewer parameters and eliminating pre-training requirements.

</details>


### [165] [Technical Report on the CVPR 2026@AdvML Workshop Challenge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11560)
*Tianyuan Zhang,Zonglei Jing,Jiangfan Liu,Ligong Zhang,Ke Ma,Chengzhi Sun,Xiaohai Xu,Zhirui Zhang,Qianqian Xu,Qingming Huang,Hanyu Fang,Junhua Liu,Zheng Wang,Xiaoliang Liu,Yuanbo Li,Shuai Gui,Bin Wang,Menghe Zheng,Jing Nie,Hanyang Meng,Zeyang Zhang,Xiang Zhang,Yongxuan Zhu,Rui Ding,Hainan Li,Yongkang Zhang,Zhilei Zhu,Xianglong Kong,Jin Hu,Zonghao Ying,Yisong Xiao,Lei Chen,Haotong Qin,Jiakai Wang,Aishan Liu,Ruikai Li,Julia Karbing,Yinpeng Dong,Zhenfei Yin,Shao Jing,Xia Hu,Jingyi Xu,Juntao Dai,Xinyun Chen,Vishal M. Patel,Xianglong Liu,Dawn Song,Alan Yuille,Philip H. S. Torr,Dacheng Tao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文是关于CVPR 2026自动驾驶视觉语言智能体对抗攻击挑战赛的技术报告，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化完全无关。

Research relevance: 1分。该论文研究的是自动驾驶场景下视觉语言智能体(VLA)的对抗攻击方法，属于自动驾驶安全与对抗机器学习领域。完全不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱、多光谱、空间在轨智能等遥感相关主题；不涉及目标检测、小目标检测、旋转框检测等检测任务；不涉及轻量化、剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS、实时推理、边缘部署、星上部署等模型压缩与部署技术。与"遥感卫星在轨目标检测模型轻量化"研究方向基本无关。

Reading priority: 1分。该论文与"遥感卫星在轨目标检测模型轻量化"研究方向基本无关，不建议投入时间阅读。除非研究方向同时涉及自动驾驶VLA对抗攻击，否则无需关注。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：对抗攻击（adversarial attack）与鲁棒性评估；应用场景：自动驾驶（autonomous driving）；传感器类型：多视角相机（six synchronized camera images）；目标类别：不涉及具体目标检测类别。与遥感场景完全无关。

Model architecture: 摘要未说明具体模型架构。提及DriveLM-style多视角视觉问答（multi-view visual question answering）作为基础框架，涉及视觉语言智能体（VLA）。

Lightweight method: 不涉及任何轻量化方法。未提及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS、轻量网络设计等模型压缩或加速技术。

Onboard deployability: 不涉及星上/边缘部署。未提及参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗、实时性等部署相关信息。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：基于DriveLM-style的多视角视觉问答数据集（摘要未说明具体数据集名称）；评价指标：对抗攻击成功率、图像保真度（image fidelity）、文本扰动成本（textual cost）、黑盒迁移性（transferability）。与遥感目标检测常用数据集（如DOTA、HRSC2016、DIOR、NWPU VHR-10等）和指标（mAP、FPS等）完全无关。

Experiments: 两阶段竞赛设计，Phase II引入隐藏黑盒模型评估迁移性。分析了5个领先提交方案，发现：图像侧攻击更受青睐（因后缀惩罚）；场景级多视角优化优于单视角；QA类型和图结构可用于分配攻击预算；特征空间目标可提升黑盒迁移性；相机图像中的印刷文字是持续存在的脆弱点。

Limitations: 该论文聚焦自动驾驶VLA对抗攻击，与遥感在轨目标检测轻量化方向完全无关，不存在可借鉴的轻量化或遥感检测方法。局限性在于其研究场景、任务目标、技术路线均与本研究课题不匹配。

Ideas for my research: 无直接可借鉴点。该论文研究的是对抗攻击而非目标检测或模型轻量化，场景为自动驾驶而非遥感卫星。如果强行关联，多视角协同优化策略（scene-level, multi-view optimization）的思路或许对遥感多视角/多时相目标检测有一定启发，但与本课题"在轨轻量化"的核心目标关联极弱。

Abstract: Vision-language agents (VLAs) are increasingly used to interpret complex driving scenes and support safety-critical reasoning. This report presents the CVPR 2026@AdvML Workshop Challenge on adversarial multimodal attacks against autonomous-driving VLAs. Built on DriveLM-style multi-view visual question answering, the challenge represents each scene with six synchronized camera images and a structured collection of driving-related question-answer pairs. Participants generate adversarial images and suffix-only textual perturbations that induce model responses to deviate from reference answers while preserving image fidelity and limiting textual cost. The competition comprises two phases, with Phase II adding a hidden black-box model to assess transferability. We describe the task design, submission rules, evaluation protocol, and leaderboard results, and then examine five leading submissions for which technical reports were available. Across these reports, several recurring patterns emerge: image-side attacks are favored by the suffix penalty; scene-level, multi-view optimization is more effective than treating views in isolation; QA types and graph structure provide useful priors for allocating attack budget; feature-space objectives can improve black-box transfer; and typographic content embedded in camera images exposes a persistent vulnerability in driving VLAs. These findings provide a practical reference for future robustness evaluation and defense design in multimodal autonomous-driving systems.

</details>


### [166] [MonkeyOCRv2: A Visual-Text Foundation Model for Document AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11562)
*Yuliang Liu,Zhang Li,Ziyang Zhang,Shuo Zhang,Qiang Liu,Jiajun Song,Zidun Guo,Xinhan Wang,Handong Zheng,Yang Liu,Dongliang Luo,Zhiyin Ma,Jiarui Zhang,Xiang Bai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出面向文档AI的视觉-文本预训练模型MonkeyOCRv2，通过大规模文档预训练语料库和联合预训练策略，提升文档分析任务性能，并作为轻量级视觉编码器用于文档解析与理解。

Research relevance: 1分，与本研究方向基本无关。论文聚焦文档图像分析（document AI），涉及文本识别、公式识别、文档篡改检测等任务，完全不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱/多光谱等遥感场景，也不涉及目标检测（object detection）或旋转框检测等遥感典型任务。虽然文中提到轻量级语言模型（0.7B参数）和11×更小的视觉编码器，但这是针对文档解析的轻量化，与遥感在轨部署无关。

Reading priority: 1分。与"遥感卫星在轨目标检测与模型轻量化"方向基本无关，不建议优先阅读。仅当对视觉预训练策略的通用方法论感兴趣时可作泛读参考。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：文档AI（document AI），包括文本识别、公式识别、文本检测、文档篡改检测、重叠文本分割、文档解析、文档理解。应用场景：文档图像处理，非遥感/卫星场景。传感器类型：文档扫描/拍摄图像。目标类别：文本、字符、公式、文档布局元素。

Model architecture: MonkeyOCRv2视觉编码器，采用视觉-文本预训练架构。文中提及与轻量级语言模型（lightweight language model）搭配，整体模型0.7B参数。具体网络结构细节摘要未说明。

Lightweight method: 文中提到"lightweight language model"和"vision encoder roughly 11× smaller"，但未说明具体的轻量化方法（如剪枝、量化、蒸馏、NAS等）。轻量化体现在模型规模（0.7B参数）和编码器尺寸缩减，但这是针对文档任务的模型设计选择，非遥感轻量化方法。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗、实时性等部署相关信息。虽然提到0.7B参数模型和11×更小的视觉编码器，但未给出具体计算量或推理速度指标，且面向的是文档解析场景而非星上/边缘部署。

Datasets and metrics: 预训练语料库：MonkeyDoc v2，1.13亿张图像，覆盖17种语言。评测基准：MDPBench（数字原生和拍摄文档，17种语言）、8个文档理解基准。任务：文本识别、公式识别、文本检测、文档篡改检测、重叠文本分割、文档解析、文档理解。具体指标名称摘要未说明。

Experiments: 在5个文档分析任务上，替换原始编码器为MonkeyOCRv2后性能一致提升。在MDPBench上，0.7B文档解析模型超越之前最好的3B dots.mocr模型2.8%绝对值，视觉编码器小约11×。文档理解模型在8个基准上优于基于CLIP、DINO、SAM的同类模型。

Limitations: 1. 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测完全无关，无法直接借鉴。2. 摘要未说明轻量化方法的具体技术细节（剪枝/量化/蒸馏等）。3. 未提供推理速度、FLOPs、能耗等部署关键指标。4. 预训练数据为文档图像，与遥感图像分布差异极大。

Ideas for my research: 1. 预训练策略思路：该文的"图像到文本生成+像素级文档重建"联合预训练策略，可类比思考遥感领域是否可采用"遥感图像描述生成+遥感场景重建"的联合预训练方式，以增强遥感特征表达。2. 轻量编码器思路：文中用11×更小的视觉编码器超越大模型，提示在遥感目标检测中也可探索更小但针对性预训练的编码器替代大模型。3. 但需注意，这些借鉴非常间接，且文档图像与遥感图像特性差异巨大，直接迁移风险高。

Abstract: Mainstream visual encoders are pretrained on natural images and cannot be effectively applied to document images without document-oriented adaptation, as dense text and fine-grained character strokes demand character-level visual perception. We present MonkeyOCRv2, a visual-text pretrained model for document AI. First, we construct MonkeyDoc v2, to our knowledge the largest document-image pretraining corpus, comprising 113 million images spanning 17 languages. Second, we propose a pretraining strategy that jointly learns image-to-text generation and pixel-level document reconstruction: the former aligns visual representations with textual content, while the latter preserves character strokes and layout details. Extensive experiments are conducted on five representative document analysis tasks, including text recognition, formula recognition, text detection, document tampering detection, and overlapping text segmentation. Replacing the original encoders with MonkeyOCRv2 consistently improves performance across all five tasks. Finally, we validate its effectiveness as the vision encoder of multimodal large language models on the more challenging tasks of document parsing and document understanding. Kept frozen and paired with a lightweight language model, it yields a 0.7B document parsing model that sets a new open-source state-of-the-art on MDPBench, a recent benchmark spanning digital-born and photographed documents across 17 languages, surpassing the previous best 3B dots.mocr by 2.8% absolute with a vision encoder roughly 11$\times$ smaller. The frozen encoder also powers a document understanding model that outperforms counterparts built on CLIP, DINO, and SAM across eight benchmarks under identical training settings. These results suggest that document-oriented visual pretraining can serve as a foundation for document intelligence in its own right.

</details>


### [167] [Actor as Its Own Critic: Unifying Region Understanding and Localization via CycleGRPO](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11581)
*Xin Zhang,Haochen Wang,Yikang Zhou,Jason Li,Robby T. Tan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出CycleGRPO框架，利用强化学习中的"自身即评论家"机制，让多模态大语言模型通过"区域→文本→区域"的循环自评估来联合优化区域理解与定位能力，无需文本真值标注。

Research relevance: 1分，与本研究方向基本无关。论文聚焦多模态大语言模型(MLLM)的区域理解与定位任务，不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、SAR、高光谱、多光谱等遥感场景，也不涉及目标检测的轻量化或星上部署问题。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：区域描述(region captioning)、区域VQA、接地对话(grounded dialogue)、指代分割(referring segmentation)；应用场景：通用视觉-语言理解；传感器类型：通用RGB图像；目标类别：通用物体。不涉及遥感场景。

Model architecture: 基于SAMTok构建的MLLM框架，采用"actor-critic"统一强化学习范式，核心是CycleGRPO（Cycle Group Relative Policy Optimization）。模型结构为单MLLM同时扮演actor和critic角色，通过"region→text→region"循环实现自评估。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明任何轻量化方法。不涉及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS、轻量网络设计等模型压缩或加速技术。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗等部署相关信息。不涉及星上/边缘部署可行性讨论。

Datasets and metrics: 摘要未说明具体数据集名称。评价指标涉及区域描述、区域VQA、接地对话、指代分割等任务的benchmark指标，但未列出具体指标名称。

Experiments: 在区域描述、区域VQA、接地对话、指代分割等多个benchmark上取得一致性性能提升，无需任务特定微调。但摘要未给出具体数值对比。

Limitations: 1. 与遥感/卫星/在轨目标检测完全无关；2. 不涉及任何轻量化或部署优化；3. 依赖MLLM大模型架构，计算开销大，不适合星上资源受限场景；4. 仅处理通用RGB图像，未验证在遥感图像上的有效性。

Ideas for my research: 弱相关，借鉴价值有限。但以下思路可间接参考：1) "自身即评论家"的自监督循环范式可启发遥感目标检测中的自训练或自蒸馏方法设计；2) 区域到文本再到区域的闭环一致性思想，可用于遥感旋转框检测中的质量评估；3) 无需文本真值的训练方式对遥感标注稀缺场景有潜在启发。但整体方向差异较大，不建议作为核心参考。

Abstract: This paper introduces Actor as Its Own Critic, a unified reinforcement learning framework, Cycle Group Relative Policy Optimization (CycleGRPO), that jointly optimizes region understanding and localization for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). Unlike existing separate pipelines, we leverage the inherent duality between the two tasks to construct a self-evaluating reinforcement learning paradigm: "region $\to$ text $\to$ region''. Specifically, a single MLLM first acts as the actor to generate region captions, then immediately transitions to a critic to ground its generated text back in the spatial domain. Therefore, CycleGRPO requires only region inputs, e.g., masks or bounding boxes, entirely bypassing the need for textual ground truths. A quality-aware token-level cycle-consistency reward is employed to assess the semantic discriminability of text captions via their physical localization accuracy. Empirically, built upon SAMTok, our CycleGRPO framework successfully bootstraps both capabilities simultaneously. Without any task-specific fine-tuning, the framework yields consistent performance gains across a wide range of benchmarks, including region captioning, region VQA, grounded dialogue, and referring segmentation. Overall, CycleGRPO offers a straightforward and scalable way to advance pixel-level capabilities in MLLMs. Code and models are released at https://github.com/devinxzhang/CycleGRPO.

</details>


### [168] [GB-SVFBP: Gaussian-Based Shift-Variant FBP neural network](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11584)
*Chengze Ye,Linda-Sophie Schneider,Yipeng Sun,Andreas Maier*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种基于高斯模型的移位变体滤波反投影神经网络，用于非圆轨迹锥束CT的高效重建，参数量减少99%，训练时间缩短至1/4。

Research relevance: 1分。该论文与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关。论文研究的是医学CT图像重建（cone beam computed tomography），属于医学成像领域，不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱/多光谱等任何遥感相关场景，也不涉及目标检测任务。

Reading priority: 1分。与"遥感卫星在轨目标检测模型轻量化"研究方向基本无关，不建议投入时间阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：CT图像重建（cone beam computed tomography reconstruction）；应用场景：医学成像（非圆轨迹锥束CT）；传感器类型：CT扫描仪；目标类别：不涉及目标检测。与遥感场景完全无关。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量具体数值、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗等部署相关信息。仅提及参数量减少99%、训练时间缩短至1/4，但这些是针对CT重建任务，不涉及星上/边缘部署场景。

Datasets and metrics: 摘要未说明具体数据集名称和评价指标名称。

Experiments: 实验结果表明：参数量减少99%，重建质量略有牺牲；每个轨迹的训练时间缩短至原来的1/4，收敛速度显著加快。但未与目标检测领域的SOTA方法对比。

Limitations: 1. 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测方向完全无关，无法直接借鉴；2. 摘要未说明在真实CT数据上的重建质量具体指标（如PSNR、SSIM等）；3. 仅针对非圆轨迹锥束CT这一特定场景，泛化性未知；4. 未涉及任何目标检测任务或遥感图像理解。

Abstract: This paper proposes a Gaussian-Based Shift-Variant filtered backprojection (FBP) neural network, which is designed for the efficient reconstruction of non-circular trajectory cone beam computed tomography. The traditional differentiable shift-variant FBP model consists of a filtering component and a backprojection process. The filtering component includes operations such as weightings, differentiations, a 2D Radon transform, and a 2D backprojection. The proposed methods build on this framework by introducing a trainable 2D Gaussian model to represent the trajectory-related part in the filtering process, achieving a substantial reduction in the number of trainable parameters. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed model reduces the parameter count by 99%, while only sacrificing a slight amount of reconstruction quality. Furthermore, the training time for each trajectory is reduced to one-fourth of the original, significantly accelerating convergence. These enhancements demonstrate a considerable augmentation in the model's practicality and effectiveness, making it a valuable asset for real-world applications.

Abstract: We present FoundationGeo, a two-stage framework that explicitly bridges relative and metric prediction via spatial calibration and principled data design. Stage 1 learns a high-fidelity, affine-invariant geometry model by initializing with DINOv3 and training on a curated 10.2M-sample multi-domain corpus with complementary local-detail supervision, yielding sharp boundaries and strong cross-domain generalization. Stage 2 moves beyond global scaling by introducing lightweight pixel-wise calibration fields for metric estimation: a scale field for spatially varying metric alignment and a ray-direction correction field that mitigates directional bias in point-map geometry, together producing metrically consistent 3D point maps. Beyond model design, we identify camera intrinsic coverage, especially focal length distribution mismatch between training and test data, as a key bottleneck for zero-shot metric generalization: performance drops sharply when test intrinsics fall outside the training distribution. To address this, we synthesize additional training data across diverse focal lengths using a Blender-based data engine, repairing under-covered focal regimes and improving robustness under intrinsic shift. Extensive zero-shot evaluations across seven benchmarks show that FoundationGeo significantly strengthens cross-domain robustness, staying near the top across diverse domains while avoiding the sharp cross-domain performance drops observed in other methods. This consistency translates into the best overall performance, surpassing heavier baselines by over 5.2% on average.

Abstract: Percutaneous Coronary Intervention (PCI) is a minimally invasive procedure used to restore coronary blood flow obstructed by atherosclerotic plaque. During PCI, repeated injections of iodine-based contrast agents are required to visualize the coronary arteries and guide interventional devices. However, frequent contrast injections increase radiation exposure and the risk of contrast-induced nephropathy, with acute kidney injury reported in up to 30% of patients with renal impairment. Dynamic Coronary Roadmapping (DRM) reduces these risks by overlaying a precomputed angiographic vessel map onto live fluoroscopy and continuously updating it throughout the procedure. Accurate DRM relies on precise cardiac phase matching between angiography and fluoroscopy, together with reliable catheter tip tracking for motion compensation. These tasks remain challenging in ECG-free settings and when only limited manual annotations are available. We present a unified DRM framework that simultaneously performs cardiac phase matching and catheter tip tracking for accurate real-time guidance. Our method employs a large-scale spatio-temporal encoder pretrained on 16 million X-ray frames to learn cardiac motion dynamics. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first application of large-scale spatio-temporal pretraining for motion compensation in DRM. We further introduce auxiliary tasks based on ECG R-peak detection and catheter tip tracking, improving optimization while eliminating the need for extensive catheter mask annotations. Finally, a majority-voting postprocessing strategy aggregates temporal predictions, improving robustness and providing a confidence score that correlates with phase-matching error. Comprehensive evaluation on clinical X-ray datasets demonstrates state-of-the-art performance, achieving low temporal misalignment and robust phase-matching accuracy suitable for real-time DRM.

</details>

Abstract: Deep models for retinal optical coherence tomography (OCT) classification report high accuracy but rarely report whether their confidence can be trusted -- a gap that matters when a wrong-but-confident reading delays sight-saving treatment. We pair a hybrid convolutional-Transformer encoder with a gradient-boosting (XGBoost) classification head and a three-part clinical safety layer: confidence calibration, out-of-distribution (OOD) rejection, and per-prediction uncertainty flagging. On four-class OCT (84,495 scans) the model reaches 95.4% accuracy while cutting calibration error twelve-fold (expected calibration error, ECE = 0.0024), so the confidence it reports tracks its true accuracy. To our knowledge this is the first OCT classifier to validate all three safety mechanisms jointly, with public weights and reproducible multi-seed evaluation.

Abstract: Medical imaging generates high-resolution images posing significant storage, transmission, and computational challenges. While low-rank matrix approximation (LoRMA) techniques offer efficient compression by exploiting structural redundancy, global approaches often fail to preserve local details critical for diagnosis. This paper focuses on clustering techniques that exploit non-local self-similarity to identify structurally similar regions in medical images. These clusters can be used for post-processing tasks such as adaptive image compression. We evaluate five clustering techniques: k-means, mini-batch k-means, agglomerative hierarchical clustering, balanced iterative reducing and clustering using hierarchies (BIRCH), and bisecting k-means across MRI, ultrasound, and chest X-ray modalities. All clustering techniques were optimised using random search, and cluster quality was assessed using the Silhouette score, the Davies-Bouldin (DB) index, and the Calinski-Harabasz (CH) index. Results demonstrate that standard k-means and bisecting k-means generally achieve strong cluster cohesion and separation across modalities. However, they tend to form a small number of clusters with high intra-cluster variability, limiting their effectiveness for post-processing tasks such as adaptive compression. Agglomerative clustering outperformed other techniques for MRI and ultrasound in terms of intra-cluster homogeneity, making it more suitable for preserving fine diagnostic details. For chest X-rays, mini-batch k-means achieved the best balance between clustering quality and intra-cluster compactness. BIRCH consistently underperformed across all modalities.

</details>

Abstract: The differentiable shift-variant filtered backprojection (SV-FBP) framework enables data-driven estimation of redundancy weights for cone-beam CT reconstruction under general source trajectories, removing the need for analytically derived weighting schemes. In this work, we present a systematic study of the robustness and adaptability of differentiable SV-FBP under challenging acquisition settings. We show that the framework remains stable across highly irregular and discontinuous trajectories, indicating that reconstruction performance is largely insensitive to trajectory ordering or continuity. Instead, the spatial distribution of sampling points plays a more dominant role. Under sparse-view conditions, differentiable SV-FBP achieves competitive reconstruction quality while providing an order-of-magnitude reduction in computation time compared to iterative reconstruction methods at moderate sampling densities. However, we identify a clear transition regime under severe undersampling, where the absence of iterative data consistency leads to performance degradation. Furthermore, we demonstrate that the framework remains applicable to non-planar multi-isocenter geometries, such as Lissajous-saddle trajectories, without requiring architectural modifications. These findings provide new insights into the behavior and limitations of the differentiable SV-FBP model and highlight it as a flexible and efficient solution for non-standard and robotic CBCT acquisition scenarios.

Abstract: In time-lapse fluorescence imaging, single-particle-tracking is a powerful tool to monitor the dynamics of objects of interest, and extract information about biological processes. However, tracked particles can be subject to occlusion and intermittent detectability. When these phenomena persist over a few frames, tracking algorithms tend to produce multiple tracklets for the same particle. In this work, we introduce self-supervised learning of visual features to compare tracked particles, and we exploit both visual and positional distances to robustly stitch tracklets representing the same particle. We demonstrate the performance of our stitching framework on time-lapse fluorescence sequences of Hydra vulgaris neurons. Results show high stitching precision, and reduction of errors made by previous algorithms on the same data by a factor of two.

Abstract: Deep learning-based segmentation of histopathology whole-slide images (WSIs) requires large amounts of pixel-level annotations, which are costly and time-consuming to obtain. Active learning (AL) has been proposed to reduce this effort, but existing methods exhibit three key limitations. Uncertainty estimation is unreliable on partially annotated WSIs, patch-level acquisition is inconsistent with slide-level annotation workflows, and class imbalance in multi-class settings is not explicitly addressed. To address these challenges, we propose SHAL (Slide-level Hybrid Active Learning), a patient-level AL framework for annotation-efficient multi-class histopathology segmentation. SHAL integrates three complementary components: a foreground-aware strategy that suppresses bias from unlabeled background regions, a stage-adaptive mechanism that hybridizes predictive entropy and epistemic uncertainty across learning stages, and a class-aware strategy that prioritizes diagnostically relevant tissue classes. SHAL is evaluated on the TCGA colorectal cancer dataset. It achieves the highest Macro Dice at the full annotation budget (0.846) and reaches Dice greater than or equal to 0.80 using only 26 percent of the budget (50 of 190 slides), whereas competing methods reach this threshold only at 37 percent (70 slides). Across five independent external cohorts, SHAL attains the highest mean external Macro Dice (0.815) and the smallest internal-to-external generalization gap among all methods (0.025 at Round 3 and 0.026 at the full budget). The results indicate that patient-level hybrid uncertainty acquisition reduces annotation cost without sacrificing cross-domain generalization in computational pathology.

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗等部署相关信息。虽然提到"slow inference of raster-order autoregression"和"predicting multiple tokens in parallel"以加速推理，但未给出具体速度指标，且不涉及星上/边缘部署可行性。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：多对比度脑MRI（医学图像）、ImageNet（自然图像）。评价指标：FID（Fréchet Inception Distance）、IS（Inception Score）。不涉及遥感数据集（如DOTA、HRSC2016、DIOR、NWPU VHR-10、SSDD、SARDet等）。

Experiments: 在医学图像上，单个DenseAR模型统一了跨模态翻译、条件生成和肿瘤分割任务，与任务特定方法竞争力相当。在ImageNet上，DenseAR在类条件生成质量（FID和IS）上优于单网格基线（无步长排序）和多尺度分词器基线。

Limitations: 1. 完全不涉及遥感场景，未在遥感数据集上验证；2. 不涉及目标检测任务；3. 不涉及模型轻量化或边缘部署；4. 未报告参数量、FLOPs、推理速度等效率指标；5. 生成式方法与遥感在轨目标检测的检测式方法范式差异大。

Ideas for my research: 弱相关，借鉴价值有限。可能的间接启发：1. "compact single-scale tokenizer"的设计思路或许可迁移到遥感目标检测的轻量特征表示中，但需要大幅改造；2. "coarse-to-fine"的预测策略在遥感小目标检测中已有类似思想（如特征金字塔），本文的步长递增机制可参考；3. 多任务统一骨干的设计思路对遥感多任务（检测+分割+场景理解）有启发，但本文是生成范式，与检测范式差异大。

Abstract: We introduce DenseAR, a new generative paradigm that reformulates autoregressive image generation as coarse-to-fine next-dense-stride prediction using a compact single-scale tokenizer. Our key insight is that traversing a single-scale latent grid with progressively denser strides naturally captures the transition from global structure to fine detail. This addresses two limitations of existing autoregressive models at once: the slow inference of raster-order autoregression, which DenseAR avoids by predicting multiple tokens in parallel, and the heavy cost of multi-scale approaches, which need long, multi-resolution token sequences to achieve coarse-to-fine prediction. Building on our efficient framework and the flexibility of autoregressive modeling, we further extend DenseAR to a unified model that handles multiple modalities and imaging tasks within a single backbone. We validate DenseAR on both medical and natural images. On multi-contrast brain MRI, a single DenseAR model unifies cross-modal translation, modality-conditioned generation, and tumor segmentation, while remaining competitive with task-specific methods. On ImageNet, DenseAR improves class-conditional generation quality (FID and IS) over both a single-grid baseline without stride ordering and a multi-scale tokenizer-based baseline.

</details>


### [178] [Tomo-center: an AI-based rotation-axis center finder for synchrotron micro- and nano-tomography](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.09916)
*Songyuan Tang,Xiaoyang Liu,Viktor Nikitin,Alberto Mittone,Samuel J. Clark,Francesco De Carlo*

Ideas for my research: 可借鉴点极少。唯一可能相关的是：DINOv2预训练ViT + 注意力MIL的架构设计思路，如果未来要处理遥感图像中的弱监督/多实例学习任务（如从大量遥感图块中筛选包含特定目标的图块），可参考其端到端微调策略。但整体而言，该论文对"在轨遥感目标检测模型轻量化"课题的参考价值非常有限。

Abstract: Accurate determination of the rotation-axis position is a prerequisite for artifact-free reconstruction in parallel-beam synchrotron micro-tomography. Traditional approaches such as Vo's method rely on sinogram features that can fail for low-contrast or weakly absorbing specimens. We present a learning-based method that treats center selection as a binary classification problem, using a DINOv2-pretrained vision transformer aggregated with attention-based multiple-instance learning, fine-tuned end-to-end on tomographic images. At inference time, the proposed algorithm was applied to a stack of tomograms reconstructed at a sweep of candidate centers to select the optimal center for reconstruction. We tested the estimation accuracy of the proposed method on two independent data sources and consistently achieved a mean absolute error of below 1 pixel. We also tested the method robustness to sparse or noisy acquisitions with the same datasets and demonstrated consistent performance when the number of projections was reduced by a factor of up to 10 or the blank scan factor of the underlying Poisson's noise was increased to 10. We also illustrated the interpretability of the proposed method by mapping out the relative contributions of continuous spatial features to the overall classification task. This method, delivered as tomo-center, an open-source command-line tool, has been integrated into several tomography software packages to assist experiments during the routine beamline operations.

</details>


### [179] [A neuromorphic vision system for open-world visual intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10066)
*Jiankai Yin,Zheng Miao,Lianghao Guo,Cong Li,Shengbo Wang,Hongfu Xu,Weihao Ma,Yuyang Zeng,Yubiao Luo,Yongxiang Li,Saitao Zhang,Arokia Nathan,Luigi Occhipinti,Shuo Gao,Zhong Sun,Xiaoyu Guo*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 提出一种受生物视觉启发的神经形态视觉系统，通过信息瓶颈理论和任务牵引机制，在RRAM硬件上实现任务导向的视觉智能，在8个开放世界场景中实现193μs执行时间和显著精度提升。

Research relevance: 1分，与本研究方向基本无关。论文聚焦于通用开放世界视觉智能的神经形态硬件系统，完全不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱/多光谱等遥感场景，也不涉及目标检测（论文任务为tracking/segmentation/trajectory prediction）、轻量化模型压缩方法或星上部署。

Reading priority: 1分。与遥感卫星在轨目标检测轻量化方向基本无关，不建议优先阅读。除非对神经形态硬件或信息瓶颈理论在视觉中的应用有特别兴趣，否则可忽略。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：object tracking, object segmentation, trajectory prediction；场景：unstructured open-world environments（8个开放世界场景）；传感器：polarization-sensitive imager（偏振敏感成像器）；目标类别：摘要未说明具体目标类别。

Model architecture: 神经形态视觉系统，集成polarization-sensitive imager + RRAM阵列，通过light field selection, region of interest extraction, target anticipation三级信息蒸馏实现task traction mechanism。核心受biological vision和information bottleneck theory启发。

Lightweight method: 不涉及传统轻量化方法（剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS等）。论文的"轻量"体现在硬件层面的神经形态计算（RRAM阵列）和任务导向的信息蒸馏策略，而非模型压缩或加速方法。

Onboard deployability: 执行时间193 μs，延迟相比SOTA平均降低30.6倍。但参数量、FLOPs、显存、能耗等摘要未说明。硬件基于RRAM阵列，与星上常用的FPGA/NPU/TensorRT平台不兼容，且未讨论星上部署可行性。

Datasets and metrics: 8个challenging open-world scenarios；评价指标：accuracy improvements（object tracking 25.54%, object segmentation 37.73%, trajectory prediction 36.10%），以及latency reduction（平均30.6倍）。具体数据集名称摘要未说明。

Experiments: 在8个开放世界场景中评估，对比SOTA方案，在tracking/segmentation/trajectory prediction三个任务上分别提升25.54%/37.73%/36.10%精度，延迟降低30.6倍。消融实验和详细对比摘要未说明。

Limitations: 1. 完全不涉及遥感/卫星场景，未在遥感数据集上验证；2. 任务为tracking/segmentation/trajectory prediction，非目标检测；3. 硬件方案基于RRAM和偏振敏感成像器，与现有星上计算平台差异大；4. 未报告参数量、FLOPs等模型轻量化核心指标；5. 未讨论在轨环境适应性（辐射、温度、功耗约束）。

Ideas for my research: 借鉴价值有限。但以下思路可参考：1）信息瓶颈理论（information bottleneck）可作为轻量化检测模型设计的理论指导，通过蒸馏任务相关信息、丢弃冗余特征来压缩模型；2）"task traction mechanism"中渐进式信息蒸馏（光场选择→ROI提取→目标预测）的思路可迁移到遥感图像的多级检测流程中，先粗筛再细检以减少计算量；3）硬件-算法协同设计的理念值得关注，但RRAM方案在星上部署的成熟度远低于FPGA/NPU。

Abstract: Time-efficient and robust visual intelligence remains a critical challenge in unstructured open-world environments, yet current approaches often rely on computationally intensive neural architectures or task-specific sensors with limited versatility. Inspired by biological vision and information bottleneck theory, we report a neuromorphic vision system that performs task-oriented visual intelligence through an information distillation strategy (named as task traction mechanism) implemented on hardware. The system integrates a polarization-sensitive imager with a resistive random-access memory (RRAM) array to progressively distill task-relevant information via light field selection, region of interest extraction, and target anticipation. The neuromorphic vision system conducts visual tasks within an execution time of 193 μs. Evaluation across eight challenging open-world scenarios shows accuracy improvements of 25.54%, 37.73%, and 36.10% for object tracking, object segmentation, and trajectory prediction, respectively, together with an average 30.6-fold reduction in latency relative to state-of-the-art solutions.

</details>


### [180] [Differentiable Proxy Learning for Adaptive Quantization Control in H.264 Video Coding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10478)
*Qihan Xu,Ivan V. Bajić*

Reading priority: 1分。与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，不建议投入时间精读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
