Ideas for my research: 无借鉴点。该论文属于无人机飞控/气动力学领域，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测模型轻量化课题无交叉。

Abstract: Gust disturbances, dynamic vertical inflow and ground effect are key adverse aerodynamic phenomena that induce variations in the forces acting on a multirotor and complicate its flight control. Miniature rotorcraft typically rely on simplified modelling of such effects to compute adjustments in thrust to counteract these forces. In the most basic case, disturbance force estimations are derived from the aircraft's motion and the generated thrust is assumed to exactly match that requested by the controller. However, such systems rely on the aircraft's trajectory to be affected before disturbances can be sensed and compensated. Numerous approaches presented over the last 15-20 years aim to reject external disturbances more quickly, but challenges remain.
  This paper presents a new approach in this category by measuring the instantaneous force of the rotors directly at the point of generation using load-cells and implementing high-speed control to accurately track the desired thrust. Measurements from load-cells were previously considered too noisy to provide meaningful input, but the experiments presented in the paper using purpose-built hardware from low-cost commodity components in single- and dual rotor see-saw models and a flying aircraft demonstrate both the feasibility and the effectiveness of the approach in the presence of complex aerodynamic phenomena.

</details>


### [299] [TAC-LOCO: Unified Whole-Body Control for Quadrupedal TACtile-Informed LOCO-Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10132)
*Muqun Hu,Yuhao Zhou,Kabir Ray Malik,Chi Lin,Won Suk Lee,Yu She,Yan Gu*

TL;DR: 提出TAC-LOCO框架，利用触觉感知增强四足机器人全身动态操作中的抓取力调节能力，实现零样本部署到真实机器人。

Model architecture: TAC-LOCO框架：将触觉阵列观测编码为紧凑的潜在表示（compact latent representation），与本体感知联合用于腿、臂、夹爪的统一控制。基于强化学习（RL）的策略学习。摘要未说明具体网络结构细节。

Lightweight method: 摘要未涉及任何轻量化方法（剪枝、量化、蒸馏、NAS等）。触觉编码为紧凑潜在表示可视为一种特征压缩，但并非面向模型轻量化的方法。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗等部署指标。仅提到零样本部署（zero-shot deployment）到Unitree Go2机器人平台，但这是机器人领域的部署，非星上/边缘部署。

Datasets and metrics: 无标准遥感数据集。评价指标：抓取力降低47%（47% reduction in grasping force）、物体掉落率低于1%（object drop rate < 1%）。实验在真实机器人Unitree Go2 + Interbotix WidowX 250机械臂 + 触觉夹爪上进行。

Experiments: 零样本部署到真实机器人，在渐变负载变化和突然释放事件下验证，实现了抓取力降低47%，掉落率<1%。摘要未说明与基线方法的定量对比或消融实验细节。

Limitations: 1. 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测完全无关；2. 不涉及任何目标检测任务；3. 不涉及模型轻量化或边缘部署；4. 仅在单一机器人平台上验证，泛化性未知。

Ideas for my research: 该论文与本人研究方向基本无关，无可借鉴点。唯一可勉强提及的是"紧凑潜在表示"（compact latent representation）的思想在特征压缩层面有一定通用性，但遥感目标检测中的特征压缩已有更成熟的方法（如通道剪枝、知识蒸馏），无需从该论文借鉴。

Abstract: Dynamic loco-manipulation requires legged robots to coordinate whole-body motion while maintaining stable physical interaction with grasped objects under uncertain external forces. While tactile sensing has been widely studied for robotic manipulation, its role in dynamic whole-body control remains largely unexplored. Existing works without tactile feedback commonly grasp firmly rather than regulate the grasp according to the interaction. We propose TAC-LOCO, a tactile-augmented unified reinforcement learning framework that encodes tactile array observations from compliant grippers into a compact latent representation and joins it with proprioception for unified control of the legs, arm, and gripper. With effective grasp stability reward design, the policy learns to simultaneously track body velocity and end-effector trajectories, moderate grasp force, and prevent object slip under both gradual load changes and sudden release events. We deploy the policy zero-shot on a Unitree Go2 with an Interbotix WidowX 250 arm and tactile gripper, demonstrating dynamic tactile-informed loco-manipulation under varying external interactions, achieving a 47% reduction in grasping force and an object drop rate of less than 1%.

</details>


### [300] [Millimeter Wave Radar: From Synthetic Aperture to Probabilistic Mapping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10161)
*Jui-Te Huang,Ruoyang Xu,Michael Kaess*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于毫米波雷达的鲁棒概率建图方法，用于机器人在烟雾、雾等恶劣环境下的自主导航，包含从原始雷达到概率占用图的完整流程。

Research relevance: 1分，与本研究方向基本无关。论文聚焦于地面机器人自主导航中的毫米波雷达概率建图，不涉及遥感卫星、目标检测或模型轻量化。

Reading priority: 1分。与"遥感卫星在轨目标检测模型轻量化"研究方向基本无关，不建议阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：概率占用建图（probabilistic occupancy mapping）；应用场景：地面机器人在烟雾/雾等恶劣环境下的自主导航；传感器：毫米波雷达（mmWave radar）；目标类别：不涉及目标检测。

Model architecture: 摘要未说明具体模型架构。流程包含：原始雷达信号 → SAR（合成孔径雷达）信号处理 → 概率建模步骤。

Lightweight method: 不涉及。未提及剪枝、量化、蒸馏、NAS或任何轻量化方法。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗等部署指标。仅提及提供GPU加速的信号处理流水线，但未给出具体性能数据。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：自建开源级联毫米波雷达数据集（cascaded mmWave radar dataset）；评价指标：通过下游路径规划性能分析评估建图质量，具体指标摘要未说明。

Experiments: 在室内环境中进行验证，对比了不同信号处理和概率建模方法，并分析了关键参数和天线阵列配置的影响。

Limitations: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向完全无关。该论文属于地面机器人感知与建图领域，不涉及遥感图像、目标检测、模型压缩或星上部署等核心问题。

Ideas for my research: 无直接可借鉴点。虽然论文使用了SAR信号处理（与遥感SAR有技术交集），但其应用场景（地面机器人建图）和目标（概率占用图）与在轨遥感目标检测轻量化差异巨大，且未涉及任何检测或轻量化技术。

Abstract: Robust probabilistic mapping is essential for autonomous robotic systems operating in challenging environments. While traditional sensors fail in adverse conditions such as smoke and fog, millimeter wave (mmWave) radar sensors offer reliable sensing in such conditions. However, creating accurate probabilistic maps from radar data presents significant challenges due to the inherently sparse and noisy characteristics of radio wave measurements and signal processing steps. In an attempt to address these issues, we establish a complete pipeline from raw radar signals to probabilistic occupancy maps, incorporating Synthetic Aperture Radar processing followed by a probabilistic modeling step. We conduct extensive validation across indoor environments, comparing our approach against different signal processing and probabilistic modeling approaches. We also evaluate mapping quality through downstream path planning performance analysis. Furthermore, we investigate the impact of key parameters and antenna array configuration on mapping performance. The experimental results demonstrate both the effectiveness and limitations of SAR-based probabilistic mapping for real-world robotic deployment. To facilitate future research and broader adoption, we contribute an open-source cascaded mmWave radar dataset with an accompanying GPU-accelerated signal processing pipeline available at https://github.com/rpl-cmu/rpm.

</details>


### [301] [From Non-Rigid to Rigid: Safe Acquisition of Rigid Communication Graphs under Limited Sensing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10170)
*Saharsh,Vedhas Talnikar,Pushpak Jagtap*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种基于通信图刚性的多机器人编队控制方法，通过分布式二次优化实现异构非线性机器人在有限感知范围下的无碰撞刚性时变通信图。

Research relevance: 1分，与本研究方向基本无关。该论文属于多机器人编队控制领域，不涉及遥感、卫星、目标检测或模型轻量化中的任何一项。

Reading priority: 1分，与研究方向基本无关，不建议投入时间阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 多机器人编队控制（multi-robot formation control），场景为地面机器人集群，不涉及遥感卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱、多光谱或空间在轨智能。

Model architecture: 摘要未说明具体的深度学习模型架构。提出的是基于分布式二次优化（distributed quadratic optimization）的控制器，属于控制理论方法，非神经网络模型。

Lightweight method: 摘要提到"computationally lean, distributed quadratic optimization-based controller"，即计算精简的分布式控制器，但这属于控制算法的计算效率优化，并非深度学习模型压缩领域的剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS等方法。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、显存、延迟、能耗等部署指标。仅在算法层面提及"computationally lean"（计算精简），但无具体量化数据。

Datasets and metrics: 通过仿真（simulations）和运动捕捉环境下的硬件实验（hardware experiments in a motion-capture environment）验证，未使用遥感领域标准数据集。

Experiments: 在仿真和硬件实验中验证了有限感知能力下的可靠性，但未与遥感目标检测方法进行对比。

Limitations: 与遥感在轨目标检测及轻量化方向完全无关，无法提供该方向所需的技术参考。该论文聚焦于多机器人系统的通信拓扑控制，不涉及任何视觉感知或深度学习推理任务。

Ideas for my research: 无直接可借鉴点。该论文与"遥感卫星在轨目标检测模型轻量化"课题在问题域、技术路线和应用场景上均无交集。

Abstract: Communication graph rigidity is a fundamental requirement in many multi robot formation control approaches. However, ensuring and maintaining a rigid communication topology becomes challenging in practice due to limited sensing ranges and dynamic operating conditions. This paper provides a method for achieving an inter robot collision free, rigid time varying communication graph, where communication links are established or broken according to limited sensing ranges, without assuming an initial rigid graph. In addition, the proposed approach guarantees the realization of a rigid graph for heterogeneous nonlinear multi robot systems. A computationally lean, distributed quadratic optimization-based controller is developed for a leader follower architecture, acquiring rigidity based on hierarchical second-order consensus among robots. Follower agents do not require global absolute positions of any agent, including their own. The proposed method is validated through both simulations and hardware experiments in a motion-capture environment, demonstrating reliable performance under the limited sensing capabilities of individual robots.

</details>


### [302] [On the Efficiency of LoRA Fine-Tuning for Vision-Language-Action Models in Industrial Robotic Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10172)
*Finn Ferchau,Daniel Pommer,Cristian Axenie*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 研究LoRA微调方法在机器人VLA模型上的效果，发现r=32的LoRA可替代全参数微调，将峰值显存从36.2 GiB降至10.8 GiB且性能无损。

Research relevance: 1分，与本研究方向基本无关。论文研究的是机器人操作领域的Vision-Language-Action (VLA)模型微调，涉及UR5e机械臂和精密装配任务，完全不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱/多光谱等遥感场景，也不涉及目标检测任务。虽然LoRA作为一种轻量化微调方法在理论上可迁移，但论文本身与遥感卫星在轨目标检测无直接关联。

Reading priority: 1分。与"遥感卫星在轨目标检测与模型轻量化"方向基本无关，不建议优先阅读。除非课题涉及遥感基础模型的参数高效微调，可作为LoRA方法的参考，但优先级很低。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：机器人精密装配（precision assembly tasks）；应用场景：工业机器人操作；传感器类型：未说明（机械臂视觉系统）；目标类别：未说明（装配任务中的零件/工件）。与遥感场景完全无关。

Model architecture: 模型：π₀（flow-matching Vision-Language-Action模型），包含Vision-Language-Model (VLM) backbone和action expert两部分。摘要未说明具体视觉backbone类型。

Lightweight method: LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) 微调方法。探索了LoRA rank (r=8到256)、分配策略（uniform allocation across VLM backbone and action expert）、组件冻结消融（freezing VLM、restricting vision encoder to LoRA）。核心发现：r=32时性能饱和，uniform allocation足够，冻结VLM或限制视觉编码器会显著降性能。

Onboard deployability: 摘要仅报告了静态峰值显存（static peak VRAM）从36.2 GiB降至10.8 GiB（含参数和优化器状态，不含激活内存）。未说明参数量、FLOPs、延迟、能耗、实时性、推理速度等部署关键指标。且该显存数据针对的是训练/微调阶段而非推理部署阶段，与星上推理部署场景差异较大。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：未说明具体数据集名称；评价指标：未说明具体指标名称（仅提及"no statistically significant advantage"）；实验设置：4种精密装配任务，UR5e机械臂平台。

Experiments: 对比方法：Full Fine-Tuning (FFT) vs. 多种LoRA配置；消融实验：LoRA rank扫描(r=8~256)、分配策略、组件冻结（freeze VLM、restrict vision encoder）。主要结果：FFT相比某些LoRA配置无统计显著优势，r=32性能饱和，uniform allocation足够，冻结VLM或限制视觉编码器显著降性能。

Limitations: 1. 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测完全无关，场景差异巨大；2. 仅报告了训练阶段显存，未报告推理阶段的参数量、FLOPs、延迟等关键指标；3. 未涉及遥感图像特有的挑战（多尺度、旋转目标、小目标、复杂背景等）；4. LoRA方法在遥感目标检测模型上的迁移性未经验证；5. 未涉及量化、剪枝、知识蒸馏等更直接的模型轻量化方法。

Ideas for my research: 1. LoRA作为一种参数高效微调方法，理论上可应用于遥感基础模型（如遥感CLIP、遥感ViT）的微调，减少在轨模型更新时的存储和计算开销；2. 论文发现"full vision encoder fine-tuning"对性能至关重要，提示在遥感场景中视觉编码器的适配不可忽视；3. 但需注意：该论文是机器人领域，遥感场景的域差异（传感器特性、目标分布、背景复杂度）可能使LoRA的最佳rank和分配策略完全不同，需要重新实验验证；4. 对于在轨场景，LoRA的推理阶段额外开销（合并权重或动态LoRA）需要评估，摘要未涉及。

Abstract: Deploying billion-parameter Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models on industrial hardware requires fine-tuning to bridge the embodiment gap. Full Fine-Tuning (FFT) provides maximal plasticity but requires data centre-grade GPUs. We present a systematic study of Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) for $π_0$, a flow-matching VLA, evaluated on four precision assembly tasks with a UR5e robotic manipulator. Across a sweep of LoRA ranks (r=8 to 256), allocation strategies, and component-freezing ablations, we find no statistically significant advantage of FFT over certain LoRA configurations. Performance saturates at r=32, and uniform allocation across the Vision-Language-Model (VLM) backbone and action expert proves sufficient. Freezing the VLM or restricting the vision encoder to LoRA significantly degrades performance, indicating that embodiment adaptation requires both semantic and visual plasticity. These results suggest that LoRA at r=32 with full vision encoder fine-tuning is a practical approach, reducing static peak VRAM from 36.2 to 10.8 GiB (parameters and optimizer states, activation memory excluded) without detectable performance loss.

</details>


### [303] [ActiveFly-Bench: Aligning Embodied Question Answering with Vision-Language-Action for Aerial Embodied Perception](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10180)
*Weichen Zhang,Shiquan Yu,Yinan Zhu,Peizhi Tang,Shilong Ji,Zhiyuan Deng,Tianyi Lyu,Haoyang Wang,Xin Zeng,Chen Gao,Yong Li,Xinlei Chen*

TL;DR: 提出了ActiveFly-Bench基准和ActiveFly无人机智能体，用于连接虚拟空间推理与物理世界交互的无人机具身感知，包含三个层次化任务和闭环控制框架。

Research relevance: 2分——弱相关。论文涉及无人机（UAV）和视觉-语言模型，属于遥感/航空场景，但核心是**具身感知、问答和行为规划**，而非目标检测；且完全不涉及模型轻量化、剪枝、量化、蒸馏、边缘部署等方向。与"遥感卫星在轨目标检测模型轻量化"课题的相关性仅限于"无人机"这一遥感平台，但任务类型和核心方法均不匹配。

Reading priority: 1分——与课题方向弱相关，不建议优先阅读。除非研究方向拓展到无人机具身感知或视觉-语言导航，否则对在轨遥感目标检测轻量化的直接帮助很小。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：具身感知（Embodied Perception），包括Aerial Embodied Question Answering (Air-EQA)、Observation Behavior Planning (OBP)、Fine-grained Language-guided UAV Control (FLUC)；场景：无人机（UAV）室外环境；传感器类型：摘要未说明具体传感器（推测为可见光相机）；目标类别：摘要未说明具体目标类别。

Model architecture: ActiveFly闭环UAV智能体，集成视觉-语言推理（VLM/VLA模型）与细粒度控制。具体网络结构摘要未说明。

Lightweight method: 不涉及。摘要未提及任何轻量化方法（剪枝、量化、蒸馏、NAS、轻量网络等）。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗等部署相关信息。虽然提到部署在物理UAV平台上，但未给出任何量化指标。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：从真实世界和模拟室外环境采集；评价指标：摘要未说明具体指标。

Experiments: 使用代表性VLM和VLA模型进行实验，结果表明当前UAV智能体在行为规划、视角调整和主动感知任务完成方面仍存在困难。具体对比方法和消融实验摘要未说明。

Limitations: 1. 完全不涉及目标检测任务，更不涉及遥感目标检测；2. 完全不涉及模型轻量化或边缘部署优化；3. 未提供任何计算效率指标（参数量、FLOPs、延迟等）；4. 任务设定偏向高层语义理解和控制，与在轨遥感目标检测的实时性、小目标、旋转框等核心问题无关。

Ideas for my research: 借鉴意义有限。可能的间接启发：1）无人机/卫星平台上的视觉-语言闭环控制框架设计思路可参考，但与本课题轻量化目标检测的核心方向差异较大；2）若未来研究方向拓展到"遥感视觉-语言导航/问答"，可参考其层次化任务分解方法；3）对于当前课题（在轨遥感目标检测轻量化），本论文不提供直接可复现或可改进的技术点。

Abstract: We introduce ActiveFly-Bench, the first benchmark to bridge cyberspace reasoning and physical-world interaction for UAV embodied perception. The benchmark decomposes active perception into three hierarchical tasks: Aerial Embodied Question Answering (Air-EQA), Observation Behavior Planning (OBP), and Fine-grained Language-guided UAV Control (FLUC), explicitly connecting high-level task understanding, behavior planning, and low-level control. The datasets are collected from both real-world and simulated outdoor environments for training and evaluation. We further develop ActiveFly, a closed-loop UAV agent that integrates visual-language reasoning with fine-grained control, and deploy it on a physical UAV platform. Experiments with representative VLMs and VLA models show that current UAV agents still struggle with behavior planning, viewpoint adjustment, and robust task completion in active perception. These results establish ActiveFly-Bench as a new testbed for embodied aerial intelligence.

</details>


### [304] [Source-Lifted Flow Matching for Intervenable Multimodal Imitation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10206)
*He Zhang,Ying Sun,Pengteng Li,Ziyang Chen,Yiren Zhao,Ziyang Rao,Weiyu Guo,Yandong Guo,Hui Xiong*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出Source-Lifted Flow Matching (SL-FM)，一种可干预源端点的流匹配策略，用于模仿学习中的多模态动作分布建模。

Research relevance: 1分。该论文与遥感、卫星、目标检测、模型轻量化完全无关。论文研究的是机器人模仿学习中的多模态动作分布建模问题，属于机器人学/强化学习/生成式模仿学习领域，不涉及任何遥感图像、目标检测或模型压缩部署内容。

Reading priority: 1分。与研究方向完全无关，不建议阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：模仿学习（imitation learning）中的多模态动作分布建模；应用场景：机器人控制（robot-control benchmarks）；传感器类型：不涉及；目标类别：不涉及。

Model architecture: 基于Flow Matching的模仿学习策略，提出Orthogonal Source Lifting机制，将不同源端点的动作提升到辅助正交坐标空间，目标动作保持在原始动作子空间，共享速度场（velocity field）。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明任何轻量化方法。不涉及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS、轻量网络等。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗等部署相关信息。该工作面向机器人控制，非星上/边缘部署场景。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：crossing-flow diagnostics（交叉流诊断数据集）和robot-control benchmarks（机器人控制基准）；评价指标：matched-prefix interventions成功率（91.1%）、free-deployment performance等；摘要未说明具体数据集名称。

Experiments: 在交叉流诊断和机器人控制基准上验证，SL-FM能将被动源随机性转化为可干预变量，消除交叉导致的复合轨迹，在91.1%的匹配前缀干预中改变未来路径，在多个基准设置中取得改进。

Limitations: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向完全无关，无任何可借鉴的遥感或轻量化内容。该论文聚焦于模仿学习中多模态动作分布的源端可干预性问题。

Ideas for my research: 基本无可借鉴点。该论文属于机器人模仿学习领域，不涉及遥感图像处理、目标检测或模型轻量化，与"在轨遥感目标检测模型轻量化"课题方向无直接关联。

Abstract: Flow-matching policies are promising for imitation learning because they model complex multimodal action distributions. However, their stochasticity is largely passive: repeated sampling may yield diverse behaviors, but users cannot directly choose among valid continuations from the same state. We propose Source-Lifted Flow Matching (SL-FM), a source-intervenable flow-matching policy that exposes such a handle while keeping the velocity field shared and latent-free. The handle selects only the source endpoint of the conditional flow, not a mode-specific field, preserving the standard formulation while avoiding decomposition into separate mode-conditioned dynamics. The core mechanism is \textbf{Orthogonal Source Lifting}, designed to prevent path-crossing ambiguity. Instead of partitioning target actions by mode, SL-FM lifts handle-specific sources into auxiliary orthogonal coordinates and keeps targets in the original action subspace. This preserves the demonstrated action distribution while allowing one shared field to carry different branches without merging at crossings. To keep handles usable across states, we learn a state-dependent source mixture end to end and use a responsibility floor, giving each handle weak supervision and mitigating dead modes. Experiments on crossing-flow diagnostics and robot-control benchmarks show that SL-FM converts passive source randomness into an actionable intervention variable. It removes crossing-induced composite trajectories, changes future routes in 91.1\% of matched-prefix interventions, and achieves strong free-deployment performance, with improvements in several benchmark settings. Overall, source geometry provides actionable multimodal control without conditioning the velocity field on the selected mode.

</details>


### [305] [Diffusion-Residual Model Predictive Steering Control for Vehicle Stabilization at the Limit of Handling under Model Uncertainty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10243)

Research relevance: 1分，与本研究方向基本无关。论文研究的是地面车辆的稳定性控制（MPC控制器），不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱/多光谱等任何遥感相关领域，也不涉及目标检测或轻量化模型压缩方法。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务：车辆稳定性控制（MPC控制器）；场景：地面车辆动力学控制；传感器类型：不涉及遥感传感器；目标类别：不涉及目标检测。

Model architecture: 条件扩散残差模型（conditional diffusion residual model），用于学习MPC控制器的不确定性，输出残差的均值和预测散布。

Lightweight method: 摘要未涉及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS等传统轻量化方法。但提到了离线制表（tabulated offline）和在线查表（single table lookup）的部署优化策略，将扩散模型推理从在线环节剥离，仅保留查表操作。

Onboard deployability: 部署平台：NVIDIA Jetson AGX Xavier；延迟：最坏情况4.08 ms/步，满足100 Hz实时控制需求；参数量、FLOPs、显存、能耗：摘要未说明。

Datasets and metrics: 仿真环境：7-DOF模型 + 高保真CarMaker联合仿真；覆盖车辆、轮胎、道路、机动多样性；评价指标：峰值侧滑角（peak side-slip）、方向稳定性（directional stability）。

Experiments: D-res相比固定自行车模型（fixed bicycle model）在低精度区域减少峰值侧滑角，在低摩擦机动中恢复方向稳定性。

Limitations: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测完全无关，无法直接借鉴。该论文属于车辆控制领域，不涉及任何遥感图像处理、目标检测或模型压缩技术。

Ideas for my research: 弱相关，但以下思路可间接参考：(1) 离线制表+在线查表的部署策略，将复杂模型推理从在线环节剥离，仅保留轻量查表操作，这种思路可用于星上推理的延迟优化；(2) 在边缘设备（Jetson AGX Xavier）上实现实时推理的延迟数据（4.08 ms）可作为星上部署的参考基线。但整体借鉴价值有限。

Abstract: At the limit of handling, a stabilizing MPC depends on the yaw-rate reference it tracks and the stable-handling envelope it enforces, both operating-point-dependent and unknown a priori, so fixed or worst-case settings are either too conservative or unsafe. We learn this uncertainty with a conditional diffusion residual model and apply it to the controller's reference and constraints rather than its control law. Conditioned on the steering command, the model returns the residual's mean and a predictive spread: the mean re-sizes the tracked yaw reference, while the spread, propagated over the prediction horizon, tightens the stable-handling envelope through a one-sided chance back-off. Together these form the proposed diffusion-residual MPC (D-res), so caution is anticipated ahead of the tracking error rather than corrected after it by a high-gain loop. Because only two moments per command are needed, the generator is tabulated offline and the online controller adds a single table lookup to the baseline MPC, with no in-loop diffusion; it runs within the 100 Hz budget on an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Xavier (worst-case 4.08 ms per step). Across a 7-DOF model and high-fidelity CarMaker co-simulation spanning vehicle, tire, road, and maneuver diversity, D-res reduces peak side-slip where the fixed bicycle model is least accurate and restores directional stability on low-friction maneuvers, where the fixed reference over-commands the available grip.

</details>


### [306] [PIER-Flow: Physics-Informed Efficient Rectified Flow for Real-Time Mobile Robot Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10288)
*Shibo Li,Zhongcheng Wang,Jiahe Cao,Jianhua Yang,Ke Wu*

TL;DR: 提出PIER-Flow，一种面向移动机器人自主导航的轻量级策略，通过蒸馏MPC专家模型为连续时间ODE，实现单步动作生成和低延迟推理。

Research relevance: 1分，与本研究方向基本无关。论文聚焦于地面移动机器人的自主导航和避障，不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱/多光谱等遥感场景，也不涉及目标检测任务。虽然涉及轻量化策略（蒸馏、单步推理）和边缘部署，但应用场景和任务类型与遥感卫星在轨目标检测完全不同。

Reading priority: 1分。与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关，不建议优先阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：自主导航与避障策略；应用场景：密集动态环境下的移动机器人；传感器类型：摘要未说明；目标类别：无（非目标检测任务）。

Model architecture: PIER-Flow：基于Rectified Flow的轻量级导航策略，将MPC专家蒸馏为连续时间ODE，采用并行潜在采样和轻量可行性选择实现单步动作生成，配合异步动作分块架构。

Lightweight method: 知识蒸馏（将MPC专家蒸馏为ODE）、单步推理（替代扩散模型的迭代去噪）、轻量可行性选择、异步动作分块架构。

Onboard deployability: 摘要提及在资源受限的边缘计算机上部署，推理延迟约5.3 ms（稳定），无延迟尖峰和冻结事件。但未提供参数量、FLOPs、显存、能耗等具体部署指标。

Datasets and metrics: 摘要未说明具体数据集名称；评价指标：成功率（98.85%）、碰撞次数（0）、推理延迟（仿真~1.29 ms，实物~5.3 ms）、加速比（相比MPC 37.2×，相比扩散模型800×以上）。

Experiments: 仿真实验：98.85%成功率、零碰撞；实物实验：在边缘计算机上稳定~5.3 ms推理延迟。与MPC和标准扩散模型对比，展示了显著加速。

Limitations: 1. 与遥感/卫星/目标检测完全无关；2. 未提供模型参数量、FLOPs等轻量化核心指标；3. 仅在移动机器人导航场景验证，未在遥感图像或卫星平台上测试；4. 未涉及目标检测任务，无法直接迁移。

Ideas for my research: 尽管场景不相关，但以下思路可借鉴：1）将复杂优化方法（如MPC）蒸馏为轻量ODE的策略，类比可将遥感目标检测中的复杂检测头或后处理蒸馏为轻量网络；2）单步推理替代迭代去噪的思路，可用于轻量化遥感目标检测中的特征细化模块；3）异步动作分块架构对星上流水线部署有参考价值；4）物理信息约束训练（physics-informed）的思路可类比为遥感几何/物理先验约束。但整体借鉴价值有限。

Abstract: Autonomous navigation in dense and highly dynamic environments requires both physically feasible control and low-latency replanning. Optimization-based methods such as Model Predictive Control (MPC) explicitly handle robot kinematics and safety constraints, but repeated nonlinear optimization can limit real-time responsiveness. Deterministic behavior-cloning policies enable efficient inference but may fail to represent multimodal avoidance behaviors, whereas diffusion policies capture multimodality at the cost of time-consuming iterative denoising. We propose PIER-Flow (Physics-Informed Efficient Rectified Flow), a lightweight navigation policy for mobile robots. By distilling an MPC expert into a continuous-time Ordinary Differential Equation (ODE), PIER-Flow achieves single-step action generation through parallel latent sampling and lightweight feasibility selection. We introduce a physics-informed training objective to enforce kinematic consistency, paired with an asynchronous action chunking architecture for robust sim-to-real deployment. Extensive simulations demonstrate that PIER-Flow achieves a 98.85\% success rate and zero collisions, with an average inference of $\sim$1.29 ms, which accelerates planning by 37.2$\times$ compared to MPC and over 800$\times$ against standard diffusion models. Crucially, real-world deployment on a resource-constrained edge computer further achieves an approximately stable inference latency of $\sim$5.3 ms, avoiding the latency spikes and freezing events observed with planning baselines.

</details>

Abstract: Conventional colonoscopy remains limited by patient discomfort and procedural risks, motivating research into compliant robotic alternatives. Eversion robots, which advance via pressure-driven tip growth, eliminate sliding friction against the colon wall and offer a less intrusive approach to traversal. However, no existing design simultaneously satisfies all clinical requirements. This paper benchmarks four recent eversion robot architectures against the key anatomical and clinical constraints of colonoscopy, including colon length, minimum luminal diameter, bending angle, and working-channel needs. We identify the central trade-offs each design reveals, particularly the difficulty of integrating steering and payload delivery without sacrificing the soft, low-friction behaviour that makes eversion robots attractive. We then provide design guidance across material selection, steering strategy, and payload delivery, and highlight open problems for clinical translation.

</details>


### [308] [PrismAD: Decoupled Planning via Semantic Mixture-of-Planners for End-to-End Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10336)
*Kang Ding,Zhigui Lin,Hongsong Wang,Jie Gui,Qi Liu,Zhe Wang,Luqi Tang,Lei He*

TL;DR: 提出PrismAD，一种基于语义混合规划器的解耦端到端自动驾驶框架，通过将场景token划分为交互、几何和意图三组并分配给独立专家，提升运动规划性能。

Abstract: This letter presents PrismAD, a decoupled end-to-end autonomous driving framework based on a Semantic Mixture-of-Planners. Existing planners usually aggregate heterogeneous scene tokens into a coupled representation space, forcing a single planning branch to jointly model agent interaction, road geometry, and driving intention. Such coupling may weaken factor-specific reasoning and obscure the contribution of different planning cues. To address this limitation, PrismAD partitions scene tokens into interaction, geometry, and intent groups, and assigns them to independent planning experts with the same architecture but separate parameters. Each expert learns a specialized motion-planning representation, while a semantics-aware router adaptively aggregates expert predictions with separate routing weights for motion prediction and ego planning. Sparse top-$K$ activation with noisy gating is further introduced to improve routing robustness and reduce unnecessary expert computation. Extensive experiments on the nuScenes open-loop dataset and NeuroNCAP closed-loop benchmark demonstrate that PrismAD exhibits competitive performance. Our code will be released soon.

</details>


### [309] [VINE: Taming Generative Control Policies for Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10369)
*Rushuai Yang,Zhuo Han,Houlin Li,Hecheng Wang,Zhichao Wu,Rui Zhang,Zhaowei Zhang,Zihong Chen,Xiaohan Yan,Chiming Liu,Yi Chen,Wei Shan,Maoqing Yao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出VINE采样方法，解决流匹配策略在值梯度强化学习中的训练不稳定问题，实现端到端优化。

Research relevance: 1分。该论文完全聚焦于机器人操作领域的强化学习策略优化（flow-matching policy + value-gradient RL），与遥感、卫星、目标检测、轻量化部署均无任何关联。属于泛机器人/泛强化学习方法，与本研究方向基本无关。

  <summary>Details</summary>

Lightweight method: 不涉及。论文未讨论任何模型轻量化方法（剪枝、量化、蒸馏、NAS等）。

Limitations: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向完全无关，无任何可借鉴的轻量化或检测方法。论文仅针对机器人RL策略优化问题。

Ideas for my research: 无直接可借鉴点。该论文不涉及遥感、目标检测或模型轻量化，对"在轨遥感目标检测模型轻量化"课题无参考价值。

Abstract: Flow-matching policies have emerged as an effective policy parameterization for robot learning. They iteratively generate actions from noise, enabling highly expressive modeling of complex and multimodal action distributions. However, prior works observed that scaling these policies with value-gradient reinforcement learning (RL) often leads to training instability. Existing methods attribute this instability to iterative generation and therefore avoid end-to-end value-gradient optimization by sacrificing iterative generation, high expressiveness, or value-gradient optimization. Contrary to prior belief, we show the instability does not stem from iterative generation itself, but from the vanilla sampling strategy originally designed for behavior cloning, which becomes brittle under value-gradient RL. Motivated by this insight, we propose VINE, an RL-oriented sampling method that enables stable end-to-end value-gradient optimization for flow-matching policies. Instead of following a single flow trajectory, VINE reconstructs a new interpolation state at every denoising step, creating a stable differentiable path for value-gradient propagation while remaining compatible with the original flow-matching denoising process. As a result, VINE preserves the expressiveness and iterative generation of flow-matching without sacrificing end-to-end value-gradient optimization. Despite performing end-to-end backpropagation through all ten denoising steps, VINE achieves stable policy improvement and consistently outperforms state-of-the-art RL methods on the OGBench offline RL benchmark and real-world robotic manipulation task. Videos are available on our website: https://agibottech.github.io/vine.

</details>

Limitations: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测轻量化方向完全无关。论文面向的是地面移动机器人的人机协作场景，传感器类型、任务目标、部署约束（功耗、算力、实时性要求）与星上遥感场景差异极大。

Ideas for my research: 无直接可借鉴点。该论文属于机器人语义感知与人机交互领域，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测轻量化课题无交叉。

Abstract: The transition of autonomous mobile robots from controlled industrial settings to dynamic, human-centric environments, such as manufacturing, logistics, and healthcare, has made their safe and autonomous operation a critical area of research. These sophisticated machines must be capable of perceiving, understanding, and interacting with their surroundings to navigate freely and perform complex tasks. A significant obstacle to achieving this is the lack of comprehensive contextual awareness, which requires a robot to recognize its spatial environment and identify the objects and actors within it. Without this perceptual knowledge, robots struggle to plan adaptive behaviors or engage in meaningful interaction with humans.
  This thesis presents novel solutions to this challenge by exploring two distinct but complementary research directions. The first direction involves human re-identification and tracking to improve Human-Robot Collaboration. Our developed approach enables a mobile robot to recognize a specific person, facilitating targeted collaboration while ignoring other individuals. The second direction focuses on enhancing the robot's overall perceptual capabilities to understand its environment geometrically and semantically. Geometric information is vital for motion planning and collision avoidance, while semantic knowledge provides the robot with a richer understanding for more advanced interaction. Both solutions are driven by the improvement of the semantical understanding of robots that enhance their knowledge of their surroundings, allowing a smoother and more natural interaction between robots, humans, and the environment. The contributions of this work in human re-identification and environmental understanding represent a significant step toward a future where robots are more contextually aware, enabling safer coexistence and more effective collaboration.

</details>


### [311] [Navigating the Crowd: Non-linear MPC with Social Forces Dynamics for Human-Aware Robot Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10374)
*Stefano Trepella,Andrea Ostuni,Mauro Martini,Pablo Pueyo,Noé Pérez-Higueras,Marcello Chiaberge,Fernando Caballero,Luis Merino*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种基于社会力模型嵌入的非线性模型预测控制框架(SFM-NMPC)，用于机器人在人群环境中的社交合规导航。

Research relevance: 1分，与本研究方向基本无关。该论文聚焦于地面自主机器人的社交导航问题，不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱/多光谱等任何遥感相关领域，也不涉及目标检测或模型轻量化。

Reading priority: 1分。与"遥感卫星在轨目标检测模型轻量化"研究方向完全无关，不建议阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务：社交导航（social navigation）；场景：地面机器人在人群环境中的运动规划；传感器类型：摘要未说明；目标类别：人类（行人）。不涉及遥感目标检测。

Model architecture: SFM-NMPC：基于社会力模型(Social Force Model)的非线性模型预测控制(Non-linear MPC)框架。将社会力模型嵌入到周围智能体的动态模型中，在优化循环内联合预测人类和机器人的轨迹。

Lightweight method: 不涉及。论文未讨论任何模型压缩、剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS或轻量化网络设计。虽然提到实时运行(20 Hz)，但这是通过控制优化方法本身实现的，而非模型轻量化技术。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、显存、能耗等部署相关信息。仅提到实时运行频率为20 Hz，但这是在模拟环境中测试的结果，未涉及星上或边缘部署。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：模拟环境(crowded environments)中测试，未说明具体数据集名称；评价指标：social compliance metrics（社交合规指标）、导航效率与平滑度指标；未涉及遥感数据集或目标检测指标(mAP, F1等)。

Experiments: 在模拟拥挤环境中进行测试，与state-of-the-art基线方法对比，在社交合规指标上表现更优。进行了视觉轨迹分析和消融实验(ablation study)，验证了嵌入的SFM动力学和社会代价项的贡献。

Limitations: 1. 仅在模拟环境中测试，未在真实机器人平台上验证；2. 未讨论对未知/动态环境变化的鲁棒性；3. 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测完全无关，无任何可迁移的技术细节。

Ideas for my research: 无直接可借鉴点。该论文属于机器人导航/控制领域，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测模型轻量化方向无技术交集。不推荐作为参考。

Abstract: Safe and socially compliant navigation remains a fundamental challenge for autonomous robots operating in human-populated environments. Beyond collision avoidance, robots must anticipate human motion and respect personal space to ensure human comfort. Model Predictive Control (MPC) offers a robust alternative to classical and data-driven methods, although its effectiveness strongly depends on accurate human motion prediction and efficient computation. This paper introduces SFM-NMPC, a Social Force Model-based Non-linear Model Predictive Control framework that embeds human motion prediction directly within the optimization loop. By incorporating the Social Force Model into the dynamic model of surrounding agents, the controller jointly predicts the trajectories of humans and robots over the prediction horizon, thereby enabling socially-aware planning. A tailored set of social cost functions guides the optimization toward human-compliant behaviors. Despite the increased model complexity, the proposed formulation runs in real time at 20 Hz. Extensive simulated testing in crowded environments demonstrates that SFM-NMPC outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in social compliance metrics while maintaining efficient and smooth navigation. Visual trajectory analysis and an ablation study further highlight the contribution of the embedded SFM dynamics and social cost terms, confirming the effectiveness of the proposed approach for real-world social navigation.

</details>


### [312] [Interleaved POMDP Planning for Multi-Object Search in Unknown Multi-Room Household Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10437)
*Ruochu Yang,Ziyi Xia,Huibo Zhang,Yatong Han,Yiming Zhao,Yingke Li,Fumin Zhang,Yorai Wardi,Mengxue Hou*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出Inter-POMDP算法，用于未知家庭环境中的多目标搜索，通过分层POMDP规划结合LLM直方图信念和障碍物感知粒子信念，提升搜索效率并减少碰撞。

Research relevance: 1分，与本研究方向基本无关。该论文研究的是家庭环境中的多目标搜索（multi-object search in household environments），属于机器人导航与规划领域，完全不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱、多光谱、空间在轨智能等遥感相关主题，也不涉及目标检测或模型轻量化。

Reading priority: 1分。与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，不建议投入时间阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：未知家庭环境中的多目标搜索（multi-object search）；应用场景：室内家庭环境；传感器类型：摘要未明确说明（可能为RGB相机或激光雷达）；目标类别：家庭环境中的物体（具体类别未说明）。与遥感目标检测无关。

Model architecture: Inter-POMDP：双层交织POMDP规划架构。高层：POUCT规划器，使用LLM（大语言模型）构建的直方图信念（histogram beliefs）推理物体分布；低层：运动规划器，使用障碍物感知粒子信念（obstacle-aware particle beliefs）建模导航不确定性。两层交互设计。

Lightweight method: 不涉及。论文未讨论任何模型轻量化方法（剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS等）。

Onboard deployability: 不涉及。论文未讨论星上/边缘部署、参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗、实时性等部署相关信息。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：仿真环境（具体名称未说明）和真实家庭环境实验；评价指标：碰撞次数（collision counts）、导航步数（navigation steps）、检测次数（detection counts）。与遥感目标检测常用数据集（DOTA、HRSC2016、DIOR、NWPU VHR-10等）和指标（mAP、FPS、参数量、FLOPs）无关。

Experiments: 仿真和真实实验：Inter-POMDP相比基线方法，碰撞次数减少最多63%，导航步数减少最多35%，检测次数减少最多32%。基线方法具体名称摘要未说明。

Limitations: 1. 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化完全无关，无法直接借鉴；2. 依赖LLM构建信念，计算开销可能较大，不适合资源受限场景；3. 仅在家庭环境验证，未涉及遥感场景。

Ideas for my research: 该论文与"在轨遥感目标检测模型轻量化"课题基本无直接可借鉴点。唯一可能间接相关的思路是：其"分层交织规划"（interleaved design）思想或许可以启发遥感在轨任务中的"检测-规划"联合优化，但与本课题核心（轻量化目标检测模型）关联极弱。

Abstract: Multi-object search in unknown household environments requires planning under extensive uncertainty - from unknown object locations to cluttered spaces with unobserved obstacles. POMDPs offer a principled framework for such problems but remain intractable in large domains. We propose Inter-POMDP, a novel interleaved POMDP planning algorithm that decomposes this challenge into two interacting levels: a high-level POUCT planner reasons over object distributions using LLM-informed histogram beliefs, while a low-level motion planner models navigation uncertainty with obstacle-aware particle beliefs as domain knowledge to guide high-level POUCT. This interleaved design balances planning quality and efficiency despite the large search space across unknown multi-room environments. Both simulation and real-world experiments show that our Inter-POMDP algorithm reduces collision counts by up to 63%, navigation steps by up to 35%, and detection counts by up to 32% compared with baseline methods. Full videos are https://sites.google.com/view/inter-pomdp

</details>


### [313] [Large Language Model Enhanced Differentiable Trajectory Planning for IoT-Enabled Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10438)
*Shihao Zhang,Jing Yang,Ziyu Song,Zheng Lin,Sunil Prajapat,Zhaochen Xia,Hemant Ghayvat,Haitao Ding,Lip Yee Por,Ashok Kumar Das*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种LLM增强的可微分轨迹规划框架，用于物联网自动驾驶，通过数据增强、LLM语义增强和可微分优化提升规划性能。

Research relevance: 1分。该论文研究的是自动驾驶轨迹规划（autonomous driving planning），属于智能交通系统（IoT-enabled ITS）领域，与遥感卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱/多光谱、空间在轨智能完全无关。不涉及任何遥感场景理解或卫星目标检测任务。

Reading priority: 1分。与"遥感卫星在轨目标检测模型轻量化"研究方向基本无关，不建议阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务：自动驾驶轨迹规划（trajectory planning）；场景：城市环境（urban environments）；传感器：多源上下文信息（multi-source contextual information），摘要未明确传感器类型；目标类别：无目标检测任务，涉及周围智能体（surrounding agents）。

Model architecture: 框架包含三个模块：(1) 周围智能体中心数据增强模块；(2) 复杂度感知的异步LLM语义增强模块；(3) 可微分优化模块（differentiable optimization module），用于带显式残差惩罚的轨迹精化。

Lightweight method: 摘要未涉及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS等轻量化方法。仅提到"complexity-aware asynchronous LLM-based semantic enhancement module"以控制在线开销（controlled online overhead），但这并非模型轻量化技术。

Onboard deployability: 摘要提到CARLA-ROS测试验证了在线部署（online deployment）和实时闭环执行（real time closed-loop execution）能力，但未给出具体参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗等部署量化指标。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：nuPlan（closed-loop non-reactive和reactive Hard20 benchmarks）、CARLA-ROS仿真测试；评价指标：overall scores（83.63和78.29）。

Experiments: 在nuPlan Hard20基准上取得最佳总体得分83.63（non-reactive）和78.29（reactive），并通过CARLA-ROS验证在线部署和实时闭环执行能力。摘要未提供消融实验或与基线方法的详细对比。

Limitations: (1) 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测完全无关；(2) 未涉及任何轻量化技术；(3) 未提供模型复杂度、参数量、推理速度等关键部署指标；(4) LLM模块在星上资源受限环境下难以部署。

Ideas for my research: 弱相关，借鉴意义有限。可能的间接启发：(1) 复杂度感知的异步模块设计思路可迁移至星上资源调度；(2) 可微分优化与上游规划器联合训练的思想，在检测-跟踪联合优化中可能有参考价值。但整体方向差异过大，不建议深入。

Abstract: Autonomous driving planning is a key component of IoT-enabled intelligent transportation systems, requiring vehicles to generate safe, efficient, and executable trajectories in complex urban environments from multi-source contextual information. While imitation learning (IL) has shown promise on large-scale datasets, IL-based planners still suffer from limited coverage of complex long-tail interactions, weak consistency with downstream constrained refinement, and insufficient use of high level scene semantics under real time constraints. To address these issues, this paper proposes a large language model (LLM) enhanced differentiable trajectory planning framework for IoT-enabled autonomous driving. Specifically, we introduce a surrounding agent centric data augmentation strategy to reorganize sur rounding agent trajectories as additional planning supervision, thereby improving the training distribution without collecting additional raw data. We further design a complexity-aware asyn chronous LLM-based semantic enhancement module to extract scene-related high-level semantic features with controlled online overhead. In addition, a differentiable optimization module is incorporated to refine generated trajectories with explicit residual penalties while backpropagating optimization gradients to the upstream planner. Experiments show that the proposed method achieves the best overall scores of 83.63 and 78.29 on the nuPlan closed-loop nonreactive and reactive Hard20 benchmarks, respectively, and CARLA-ROS tests further verify its online deployment and real time closed-loop execution capability.

</details>


### [314] [SUREFlow: State-space Uncertainty-aware REsidual Flow Matching for Robust Robot Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10504)
*Md Tanvir Islam,Sai Navaneet Peddapalli,Sangmoon Lee,Sangtae Ahn*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出SUREFlow，一种基于状态空间模型（Mamba）的不确定性感知残差流匹配框架，用于机器人操作策略中的动作生成，通过显式建模输入依赖的残差不确定性提升鲁棒性。

Research relevance: 1分。该论文与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关。论文聚焦于机器人操作（robot manipulation）领域的视觉-语言-动作策略，不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱/多光谱等遥感场景，也不涉及目标检测任务。虽然使用了轻量级Mamba骨干（179M参数），但应用场景和任务类型与本研究方向完全不同。

Reading priority: 1分。与"遥感卫星在轨目标检测模型轻量化"研究方向基本无关，不建议深入阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：机器人操作策略（robot manipulation policy）；应用场景：LIBERO基准中的桌面操作任务；传感器类型：视觉（RGB）输入；目标类别：无关。不涉及遥感目标检测。

Model architecture: 基于Mamba（状态空间模型）的骨干网络；SUREFlow框架：不确定性感知残差流匹配（state-space uncertainty-aware residual flow matching）。

Lightweight method: 使用了Mamba作为轻量级骨干，模型参数量179M，相比3-7B参数的大视觉-语言-动作模型（VLAs）具有显著轻量化优势。但未涉及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS等典型轻量化方法。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明星上/边缘部署相关信息。未提供FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗等指标。仅提及参数量179M，但该参数规模对于星上部署仍偏大。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：LIBERO、LIBERO-PRO（机器人操作基准）；评价指标：平均成功率（Average Success Rate, SR）。

Experiments: LIBERO上平均成功率92.5%，优于Mamba-based MaIL 34.2%；LIBERO-PRO上约49% SR，与3-7B参数的大VLA性能相当。

Limitations: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测完全无关，无法直接借鉴。机器人操作与遥感目标检测的任务范式、数据分布、评价指标差异巨大。

Ideas for my research: 弱相关借鉴点：（1）Mamba（状态空间模型）作为轻量骨干在遥感目标检测中的潜在应用值得关注；（2）不确定性建模（uncertainty-aware）的思路可用于遥感检测中的噪声/遮挡鲁棒性提升；（3）残差流匹配（residual flow matching）作为一种生成式动作预测方法，与遥感检测任务关联度低。整体借鉴价值有限。

Abstract: Generative vision-language-action policies have advanced robot manipulation, but they often exhibit instability under noise, partial observability, and stochastic initial conditions. During extended rollouts, small velocity errors accumulate, degrading execution reliability. Existing diffusion and flow-based policies typically assume homoscedastic residuals and lack explicit uncertainty modeling within action generation, limiting robustness during iterative rollout. We propose SUREFlow, a state-space uncertainty-aware residual flow matching framework built on a Mamba backbone. The method jointly predicts action velocities and input-dependent residual uncertainty, enabling selective refinement of unreliable action dimensions without environment feedback while preserving computational efficiency. On LIBERO, SUREFlow achieves 92.5% average success rate (SR), outperforming the Mamba-based MaIL by 34.2%. On LIBERO-PRO, it attains around 49% SR using only 179M parameters, achieving performance comparable to large VLAs with 3-7B parameters. SUREFlow source code is available on: https://github.com/tanvirnwu/SUREFlow

</details>

<details>

Model architecture: SLIDER框架包含：局部滑动地图（local sliding map）、稀疏全局历史信息（sparse global history）、观测质量评估方法（observation quality evaluation）、增量式视点聚类策略（incremental viewpoint clustering）、稀疏全局拓扑地图（sparse global topological map）。

Onboard deployability: 摘要提及了内存使用（memory usage）、决策延迟（decision latency）和搜索效率（search efficiency）的优化，但未给出具体数值（参数量、FLOPs、显存、能耗等均未说明）。适用于机载实时部署场景，但与星上部署无关。

Datasets and metrics: 摘要未说明具体数据集。评价指标：内存使用（memory usage）、决策延迟（decision latency）、搜索效率（search efficiency）。进行了仿真实验和真实世界实验（simulations and real-world experiments）。

Experiments: 摘要仅说明在仿真和真实实验中优于现有方法（outperforms state-of-the-art methods），未给出具体数值对比。

Limitations: 1. 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测完全无关，不涉及遥感图像、目标检测模型、卫星平台约束；2. 轻量化是系统/算法层面的，不是深度学习模型压缩；3. 未提供量化指标（参数量、FLOPs、帧率等）；4. 场景为无人机自主探索，非遥感图像分析。

Ideas for my research: 借鉴意义有限。可能的间接启发：1. "局部滑动地图+稀疏全局信息"的思想可类比于遥感在轨处理中的"局部检测+全局更新"策略，减少星上存储和计算；2. 增量式聚类减少候选目标数量的思路，可类比于遥感目标检测中的候选框筛选或NMS优化；3. 观测质量评估方法可类比于遥感图像质量评估（如云覆盖、光照条件）以决定是否上传或处理。但整体而言，与课题核心方向关联度很低。

Abstract: Efficient exploration and target search in large-scale unknown environments remain challenging for aerial robots due to the demands of broad spatial coverage, fine-grained perception, and real-time decision-making. This paper presents SLIDER, a lightweight and memory-efficient framework that avoids reliance on globally dense maps by combining a local sliding map with sparse global history information. A novel observation quality evaluation method is proposed, leveraging historical poses and sensor models to assess point cloud data in real-time, enabling efficient frontier detection. To support scalable and responsive planning, an incremental viewpoint clustering strategy dynamically adapts to local updates, significantly reducing the number of candidate targets and decreasing computational load. A sparse global topological map is incrementally maintained to assist global planning and cost evaluation. Extensive simulations and real-world experiments demonstrate that the proposed system outperforms state-of-the-art methods in memory usage, decision latency, and search efficiency.

</details>


### [316] [BucketKD: A Safety-Aware Bucket-Based Knowledge Distillation Framework for End-to-End Motion Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10565)
*Md Nahidul Islam,Mohd Hasan Ali,Dipankar Dasgupta,Myounggyu Won*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出BucketKD知识蒸馏框架，用于自动驾驶端到端运动规划模型的轻量化，通过桶式离散化和安全感知注意力机制提升学生模型的安全性与规划精度。

Research relevance: 1分（基本无关）。本文研究的是自动驾驶（autonomous driving）场景下的端到端运动规划模型轻量化，与遥感卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱/多光谱等遥感核心场景完全无关。虽然涉及知识蒸馏这一轻量化技术，但应用领域、传感器模态、任务目标与在轨遥感目标检测差异极大，不具备直接参考价值。

Reading priority: 1分。与"遥感卫星在轨目标检测与模型轻量化"课题方向基本无关，不建议投入时间精读。如果对知识蒸馏的桶式离散化策略有跨领域迁移兴趣，可快速浏览方法部分。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：端到端运动规划（end-to-end motion planning）；应用场景：自动驾驶（autonomous driving）；传感器类型：原始传感器数据（raw sensor data，摘要未明确具体传感器类型）；目标类别：无目标检测任务，涉及障碍物（obstacle）和路径点（waypoint）。

Model architecture: 教师-学生知识蒸馏框架；学生模型为紧凑型端到端规划器；提出安全感知路径点注意力机制（safety-aware waypoint attention mechanism），结合碰撞时间（TTC, time-to-collision）评估每个路径点的风险等级。

Lightweight method: 知识蒸馏（Knowledge Distillation, KD），具体为BucketKD框架；通过桶式离散化（bucket-based discretization）对环境变量进行压缩表示；蒸馏过程中保留安全关键行为。

Onboard deployability: 摘要提到"large model size hinders deployment in resource-constrained platforms"，但未给出具体参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗等部署指标；仅提及"strong compression ratios"（强压缩比），无量化数据。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：Bench2Drive（在CARLA仿真器中）；评价指标：规划精度（planning accuracy）和安全性（safety）；摘要未说明具体数值指标。

Experiments: 在CARLA/Bench2Drive上实验，BucketKD显著优于SOTA方法（state-of-the-art），在规划精度和安全性上均有提升，同时保持强压缩比。摘要未提供消融实验细节。

Limitations: 1. 与遥感/卫星/在轨场景完全无关；2. 仅涉及知识蒸馏，未涉及剪枝、量化、NAS等其他轻量化技术；3. 缺乏具体部署指标（参数量、FLOPs、延迟等）；4. 仅在仿真环境CARLA中验证，未涉及真实道路数据；5. 面向的是连续控制规划任务，而非目标检测任务。

Ideas for my research: 1. 桶式离散化（bucket-based discretization）的思想可借鉴用于遥感目标检测中的特征压缩或锚点设计；2. 安全感知注意力机制中结合TTC的风险评估思路，可类比用于遥感场景中目标碰撞/遮挡风险建模（如卫星编队或多目标跟踪）；3. 知识蒸馏框架本身是轻量化的重要手段，但本文的蒸馏策略针对规划任务设计，直接迁移到遥感目标检测需要重新设计蒸馏损失函数。总体而言，借鉴价值有限。

Abstract: End-to-end motion planning has emerged as a promising paradigm in autonomous driving, directly mapping raw sensor data to control commands via deep neural networks. Despite its advantages, its large model size hinders deployment in resource-constrained platforms. In this paper, we present BucketKD, a bucket-based knowledge distillation framework that yields compact and safety-aware end-to-end planners. Compared to the state-of-the-art approach, which relies on simplified planning state representations, BucketKD discretizes critical environmental variables into adaptive buckets that capture richer scene semantics while preserving efficiency. In addition, we design a safety-aware waypoint attention mechanism that evaluates each waypoint's risk level by accounting for both obstacle proximity and relative motion through a time-to-collision (TTC) formulation widely used in transportation research. This enables the student model to better retain safety-critical behaviors during distillation. Extensive experiments in CARLA using the Bench2Drive dataset show that BucketKD significantly outperforms the state-of-the-art in both planning accuracy and safety while maintaining strong compression ratios.

</details>


### [317] [Underwater Dead Reckoning with Deployable Situation-Triggered Covariance Scheduling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10597)
*Akshay Naik,Ramavarapu S. Sreenivas,Dustin Nottage,Ahmet Soylemezoglu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种基于情景触发的自适应鲁棒扩展卡尔曼滤波方法，用于水下自主导航中的航位推算，通过离线校准的情景感知协方差调度提升定位精度。

Research relevance: 1分，与本研究方向基本无关。论文聚焦水下机器人（BlueROV2）的航位推算（dead reckoning），属于水下自主导航领域，不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱/多光谱等遥感核心要素；不涉及目标检测任务；不涉及模型轻量化方法（剪枝、量化、蒸馏、NAS等）。

Reading priority: 1分，与"遥感卫星在轨目标检测与模型轻量化"研究方向基本无关，不建议投入时间阅读全文。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：水下航位推算（dead reckoning）/状态估计；应用场景：水下机器人自主导航（vision-free场景）；传感器类型：DVL（多普勒速度计）、IMU、AprilTag（离线校准用）；目标类别：不涉及目标检测。

Model architecture: Situation-Triggered Calibrated Adaptive Robust Extended Kalman Filter（情景触发校准自适应鲁棒扩展卡尔曼滤波器），基于EKF框架，包含一个概率触发模块（probabilistic trigger）和多个预校准的噪声协方差矩阵。

Lightweight method: 不涉及。论文未使用剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS、轻量网络等任何模型压缩或加速方法。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗等部署相关信息。仅提及"onboard probabilistic trigger"表明该方法可在BlueROV2上运行，但未给出具体计算资源需求。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：稀疏AprilTag监督的泳池实验数据（pool runs），包含训练集（校准用）、验证集（选择调度策略）、测试集（held-out runs，4次）；评价指标：标签加权平均每趟平移RMSE（label-weighted mean per-run translation RMSE）、方向误差（orientation error）、10秒分段的配对bootstrap差异及95%置信区间。

Experiments: 在4次held-out泳池测试中，方法将平移RMSE从0.488m降至0.471m（相对改进约3.5%）；配对bootstrap给出-0.017m的差异，95% CI为[-0.024, -0.008]m；方向误差基本不变。所有held-out测试均偏好所提调度方法。

Limitations: 1. 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化完全无关；2. 改进幅度较小（~3.5% RMSE降低），且仅在特定泳池场景验证；3. 需要离线AprilTag监督校准，泛化性受限；4. 未讨论计算开销和实时性指标。

Ideas for my research: 借鉴意义极低。唯一可能间接参考的点是"情景触发调度"的思想——在遥感在轨场景中，可根据卫星轨道阶段（如光照条件、云覆盖、目标密度）动态切换不同轻量化模型或推理配置，但论文本身未提供任何与遥感或轻量化直接相关的技术细节。

Abstract: Underwater dead reckoning estimates vehicle position when vision is unavailable and external positioning cannot be assumed. A single set of filter parameters can work well in many situations, but fixed tuning may be poorly matched during turns, motion transitions, or periods when sensor measurements are less reliable. This paper presents the Situation-Triggered Calibrated Adaptive Robust Extended Kalman Filter for a BlueROV2. An onboard probabilistic trigger identifies the current motion situation while one error-state filter runs continuously. When the trigger is confident, the filter changes only to the corresponding pre-calibrated process- and measurement-noise matrices; the state estimate, covariance history, dynamics, and measurement models are not reset or replaced. The trigger, noise profiles, and a one-time Doppler velocity log yaw-alignment correction are calibrated offline using sparse AprilTag-supervised pool runs. A separate validation set selects the scheduling policy, which is then fixed before held-out testing. Across four held-out pool runs, the method reduces label-weighted mean per-run translation root-mean-square error from 0.488 m to 0.471 m relative to the same filter backbone with one global noise profile, and every held-out run favors the scheduled method. A paired bootstrap over 10-second segments gives a candidate-minus-baseline difference of -0.017 m with a 95% confidence interval of [-0.024, -0.008] m, while orientation error remains essentially unchanged. These results indicate that situation-aware covariance scheduling provides a modest but consistent vision-free dead-reckoning improvement without switching estimators or resetting the filter.

</details>


### [318] [Dual-Process Atomic Skill Learning: Decoupling Semantic Reasoning and Real-Time Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10625)
*Jun Chen,Erdent Bao,Wenlong Dong,Jierui Liu,Qi Cai,Hao Wan,Shaopeng Li,Weijun Qin,Jing Liang,Huiping Zhuang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种基于双过程认知理论的异步分层模仿学习框架DASL，用于机器人多步组合任务的语言条件模仿学习。

Research relevance: 1分。该论文与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关。论文聚焦于机器人模仿学习（Imitation Learning）、语言条件任务（Language-conditioned tasks）、组合泛化（Compositional generalization），属于机器人学与认知科学的交叉领域，不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、目标检测或模型轻量化中的任何核心主题。

Reading priority: 1分。与研究方向基本无关，不建议投入时间精读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：语言条件模仿学习（Language-conditioned Imitation Learning）；应用场景：机器人多步组合任务执行；传感器类型：摘要未说明；目标类别：机器人动作技能（atomic skills），非遥感目标。

Model architecture: DASL框架包含两个策略模块：Slow-Frequency Policy（慢频策略，使用Vector Quantization预测离散技能）和High-Frequency Policy（高频策略，使用latent diffusion model + Decision Transformer生成精确动作）。采用异步分层（asynchronous hierarchical）架构，解耦语义推理与运动控制。

Lightweight method: 不涉及。论文未讨论任何模型轻量化方法（剪枝、量化、蒸馏、NAS等）。

Onboard deployability: 不涉及。摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗、实时性等任何部署相关信息。

Datasets and metrics: 摘要未说明具体数据集名称。评价指标：技能获取（skill acquisition）和组合泛化（compositional generalization）性能，具体指标名称未给出。

Experiments: 在仿真基准（simulation benchmarks）和实验（experiment）中评估，DASL显著优于state-of-the-art基线方法。摘要未给出具体数值对比。

Limitations: 摘要未说明局限性。但该论文与遥感在轨目标检测方向完全无关，无法直接借鉴。

Ideas for my research: 弱相关，借鉴价值有限。可能的间接启发：（1）异步分层架构思想——若未来在轨任务涉及多模态（如遥感图像+文本指令）的复杂推理，可参考其解耦语义推理与实时执行的思路；（2）Vector Quantization用于离散特征表示的方法，在遥感模型压缩中或有潜在应用。但整体而言，该论文对"在轨遥感目标检测模型轻量化"课题的直接可借鉴点极少。

Abstract: Language-conditioned Imitation Learning (IL) is essential for enabling robots to perform complex tasks following natural language instructions. However, generalizing to multi-step compositional tasks remains a significant challenge. While hierarchical approaches attempt to address this by decomposing tasks into atomic skills, existing methods often suffer from training instability and codebook collapse due to the tight coupling between high-level skill reasoning and low-level action generation in joint training paradigms. Inspired by the Dual-Process Theory of cognition, we propose Dual-Process Atomic Skill Learning (DASL), a novel asynchronous hierarchical imitation learning framework that decouples slow semantic reasoning from fast, real-time motion control. DASL comprises a Slow-Frequency Policy that predicts interpretable, discrete skills via Vector Quantization, and a High-Frequency Policy that leverages a latent diffusion model and a Decision Transformer to generate precise actions conditioned on these latent skills. By asynchronously coordinating these modules and utilizing diffusion to structure the latent space, our framework mitigates the skill codebook interference problem common in joint training paradigms. Evaluations across simulation benchmarks and experiment demonstrate that DASL significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, excelling in skill acquisition and compositional generalization to unseen instructions. GitHub page: https://github.com/Hatakekaka/DASL

</details>


### [319] [World Models as Adversaries: Multi-Agent Self-Play Fine-Tuning for Robust Motion Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10630)
*Tong Nie,Yuewen Mei,Junlin He,Yihong Tang,Jian Sun,Wei Ma*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出对抗世界模型(AWM)，通过多智能体自博弈微调框架提升自动驾驶规划器在密集交通中的鲁棒性，核心是解耦的min-max博弈求解器。

Research relevance: 1分，与本研究方向基本无关。该论文聚焦自动驾驶(autonomous vehicles)的鲁棒运动规划(motion planning)，不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱/多光谱等遥感核心要素；不涉及目标检测(object detection)或轻量化模型压缩方法；不涉及星上/边缘部署。

Reading priority: 1分。与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关，不建议投入时间精读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务：鲁棒运动规划(robust motion planning)；场景：密集交通中的自动驾驶；传感器类型：摘要未说明；目标类别：车辆(vehicles)、交通参与者；不涉及遥感目标检测。

Model architecture: 基于自回归规划器(autoregressive planners)的对抗世界模型(AWM)，包含角色条件对抗器(role-conditioned adversary)和自车规划器(ego planner)，采用反事实信用分配(counterfactual credit assignment)、尾风险加权(tail-risk weighting)和参考锚定信任区域(reference-anchored trust regions)。

Lightweight method: 未涉及任何轻量化方法。无剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS、轻量网络设计等内容。

Onboard deployability: 未涉及。无参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗、实时性等部署相关信息。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：nuPlan、InterPlan；评价指标：闭环性能(closed-loop performance)、名义场景(nominal)和长尾交互场景(highly interactive long-tail scenarios)下的表现。

Experiments: 在nuPlan和InterPlan基准上，AWM生成可迁移的对抗交互，在名义和长尾场景中均取得有竞争力的闭环性能。理论分析验证了解耦求解器和主要优化组件。

Limitations: 与遥感在轨目标检测完全无关。摘要未说明计算开销、推理速度、模型大小等对部署至关重要的信息。

Ideas for my research: 弱相关，借鉴意义有限。但对抗训练框架(min-max game)的思想可抽象借鉴：若将遥感在轨目标检测中的域偏移(如光照、视角变化)视为对抗扰动，可考虑类似的鲁棒训练策略。然而该论文不涉及检测任务，也不涉及轻量化，直接借鉴价值低。

Abstract: Robust motion planning in dense traffic requires autonomous vehicles to interact in rare and safety-critical scenarios that are underrepresented in naturalistic driving data. Although adversarial training offers a feasible solution, existing methods often rely on external scenario generators, heuristic perturbations, or simulator-heavy rollouts, which makes them difficult to integrate with modern autoregressive planners. Here, we cast adversarially robust planner learning as a constrained min-max game and propose Adversarial World Modeling (AWM), a theoretically grounded multi-agent self-play fine-tuning framework. Since solving the exact game is intractable, AWM introduces a principled decoupled solver. In the inner minimization, the planner's predictive world model is converted into a role-conditioned adversary that learns sparse, scene-adaptive attack coalitions via counterfactual credit assignment. In the outer maximization, the ego planner optimizes a regret-aware robust best response against the frozen AWM, utilizing tail-risk weighting and reference-anchored trust regions to improve hard-case recovery while preserving nominal driving behavior. Experiments on the nuPlan and InterPlan benchmarks demonstrate that our method generates transferable adversarial interactions and yields a robust planner that achieves competitive closed-loop performance in both nominal and highly interactive long-tail scenarios. Theoretical analysis justifies the decoupled solver and the main optimization components.

</details>


### [320] [Coverage Path Planning: Classical Foundations, Recent Advances, and Future Directions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10649)

Onboard deployability: 不涉及。论文未讨论星上/边缘部署、参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗等部署相关信息。

Datasets and metrics: 摘要未说明具体数据集和评价指标。综述覆盖125篇代表性文献(2015-2026)，但未列出实验数据集或指标。

Ideas for my research: 无直接可借鉴点。该论文与"遥感卫星在轨目标检测模型轻量化"课题无任何交集，不涉及遥感图像、目标检测、模型压缩或星上部署。

Abstract: Coverage path planning (CPP) is a fundamental problem in robot motion planning, whose aim is to produce robot trajectories that provide complete coverage of target workspaces while minimizing task-specific objectives such as path length, overlap, number of turns, and energy consumption. CPP has widespread applications in cleaning, inspection, mapping, agriculture, manufacturing, surveillance, demining, and environmental monitoring. Although classical CPP has been extensively studied, recent advances have extended CPP beyond single-robot settings to multi-robot systems, complex 3D environments, constrained platforms, learning-based coverage planning, and visual coverage tasks. This paper presents a comprehensive survey of 125 representative works published primarily between 2015 and 2026, while presenting the evolution of recent developments in light of the classical CPP methods published before 2015. The CPP methods are organized into six main categories: single-robot CPP, multi-robot CPP, 3D CPP, constrained CPP, learning-based CPP, and visual CPP. For each category, the review summarizes the main planning formulations, representative algorithms, strengths, and limitations. In addition, the review analyzes how environmental knowledge, workspace geometry, robot constraints, sensing objectives, and coordination requirements shape the CPP problem. The survey further discusses open challenges in scalable online planning, multi-robot coordination, 3D and visual coverage, unified platform-constrained and resource-aware coverage, and learning-enhanced coverage. Thus, the survey provides a structured overview of recent CPP developments and future research directions.

</details>


### [321] [Artificial Foveated Perception for Mitigating Shortcut Learning in Robotic Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10655)
*Xiatao Sun,Yuan Zhuang,Mateo Sanchez Lopez Negrete,Matei-Victor Coldea,Chen Liang,Haoyang Zhang,Che Liu,Ziyao Zeng,Shawn Li,Qian Wang,Fei Miao,Daniel Rakita*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出人工中央凹感知(AFP)模块，通过任务条件掩码引导机器人基础模型关注因果相关视觉区域，抑制捷径学习，提升泛化能力。

Research relevance: 1分，与本研究方向基本无关。论文聚焦机器人基础模型(robotic foundation models)的捷径学习问题，场景为机器人操控(manipulation/control)，不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱/多光谱等任何遥感相关领域。目标检测仅作为辅助定位手段(mask over relevant objects)，并非核心任务。轻量化方面虽提出"lightweight module"，但未涉及剪枝、量化、蒸馏、NAS、实时推理、边缘/星上部署等轻量化核心方法。

Reading priority: 1分。与"遥感卫星在轨目标检测模型轻量化"方向基本无关，不建议投入时间精读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：机器人策略学习中的捷径学习抑制；应用场景：机器人操控(robotic manipulation)；传感器类型：RGB视觉+语言输入；目标类别：机器人、相关物体、动作关键区域。不涉及遥感目标检测。

Model architecture: AFP(Artificial Foveated Perception)模块：轻量级、策略无关(policy-agnostic)的辅助模块，接收视觉和语言输入，预测任务条件掩码(task-conditioned masks)。微调后策略在原始观测流上执行，推理时无需AFP在控制环路中。

Lightweight method: 摘要仅提及AFP是"lightweight module"，但未给出参数量、FLOPs、延迟等具体轻量化指标。未涉及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS等主流轻量化方法。轻量化在此处更多指模块设计轻量，而非面向部署的模型压缩。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、显存、延迟、能耗等部署相关信息。不涉及星上/边缘部署。推理时AFP不在控制环路中，因此推理开销与原始策略相同。

Datasets and metrics: 摘要未说明具体数据集名称和评价指标。提及评估了state-of-the-art robotic foundation models，在环境扰动(environmental perturbations)下测试泛化能力。

Experiments: 在多种机器人基础模型上评估AFP，结果表明：减少微调时间、抑制过拟合、提升环境扰动下的泛化能力。通过掩码质量和接地损失设计的消融实验验证了收益来源于将策略学习引导至任务相关视觉证据。

Limitations: 1. 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测完全无关；2. 轻量化仅停留在"模块轻量"的定性描述，无定量指标；3. 场景为机器人操控，视觉输入为室内/桌面场景RGB，与遥感图像特性差异巨大；4. 目标检测仅作为辅助手段，非核心任务。

Ideas for my research: 可借鉴点有限，但以下思路可参考：1. "任务条件掩码"的思想可迁移到遥感场景——用语言/任务提示引导检测模型关注特定目标区域，抑制背景杂波干扰；2. 辅助接地信号(auxiliary grounding signal)在微调阶段引导注意力，可类比遥感检测中的注意力引导策略；3. 推理时移除辅助模块、不增加推理开销的设计思路，与轻量化部署中"训练时复杂、推理时精简"的理念一致。但整体借鉴价值较低。

Abstract: Robotic foundation models have recently made substantial progress in multi-task capability, cross-embodiment transfer, and language-conditioned control. Yet robust deployment across diverse real-world settings remains difficult, in part because policies often fail to distinguish causally relevant visual structure from spurious scene-level correlations. We identify this failure mode as shortcut learning: the tendency to exploit predictive but non-causal correlations in the training distribution rather than the task-relevant visual evidence that determines successful action. Although shortcut learning has been extensively studied in computer vision and broader machine learning, its role in robotic foundation models remains comparatively underexplored. We propose Artificial Foveated Perception (AFP), a lightweight, policy-agnostic module that takes the same vision and language inputs as Vision-Language-Action and World Action Model pipelines and predicts task-conditioned masks over relevant objects, the robot, and other action-critical regions. We use these masks primarily as an auxiliary grounding signal during fine-tuning, aligning policy attention with task-relevant regions while leaving the core architecture unchanged. After fine-tuning, the policy executes on the original observation stream without requiring AFP in the control loop. We evaluate AFP across state-of-the-art robotic foundation models and show that foveated perception reduces fine-tuning time, suppresses overfitting, and improves generalization under environmental perturbations. Ablations over mask quality and grounding-loss design further show that these gains arise from directing policy learning toward task-relevant visual evidence. These results suggest that task-conditioned foveated perception is a practical mechanism for making robotic foundation models more robust, data-efficient, and scalable.

</details>


### [322] [SensorPerch: Sense Wherever and Whenever it Matters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10682)
*Zhanxin Wu,Ruofei Tong,Tapomayukh Bhattacharjee*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出SensorPerch——一种将传感器从机器人本体和环境固定设施中解耦的主动感知范式，通过可自主部署的轻量无线传感器平台实现任务最优视角的动态构建。

Research relevance: 1分，与本研究方向基本无关。论文聚焦于机器人主动感知中的传感器部署范式，不涉及遥感卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR/高光谱/多光谱等遥感核心场景，也不涉及目标检测模型或轻量化方法。虽然提到了"lightweight"和"wireless"传感器平台，但这属于硬件层面的轻量设计，与深度学习模型轻量化（剪枝、量化、蒸馏、NAS等）完全无关。

Reading priority: 1分。与"遥感卫星在轨目标检测模型及其轻量化"研究方向基本无关，不建议投入时间精读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：机器人主动感知中的传感器重部署（sensor detachment/re-attachment）；应用场景：机器人操作环境中的物体状态检测和策略耦合感知；传感器类型：轻量无线传感器平台（非遥感卫星传感器）；目标类别：物体状态事件检测（object-state detection），非遥感目标检测中的舰船/飞机/车辆等。

Model architecture: 摘要未说明具体的模型架构。论文核心是传感器部署范式而非检测模型设计。

Lightweight method: 不涉及深度学习模型轻量化方法。文中"lightweight"指传感器硬件平台的轻量化（可附着于多种表面），与剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS等模型压缩技术无关。

Onboard deployability: 不涉及星上/边缘部署。论文讨论的是机器人环境中可自主部署的无线传感器，与遥感卫星在轨推理、FPGA/NPU/TensorRT等边缘部署技术无关。

Datasets and metrics: 摘要未说明具体数据集和评价指标。提及了"event detection"的成功率和与oracle viewpoints对比的成功率，但未给出具体数值。

Experiments: 在两类任务上进行了演示：(i) object-coupled perception——实现超越机器人当前位置的持久物体状态检测；(ii) policy-coupled perception——为不同策略构建策略特定视角，达到与oracle viewpoints相当的成功率。但摘要未给出定量对比结果。

Limitations: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向完全无关，无法提供该方向所需的技术信息。论文聚焦于机器人感知中的传感器物理部署问题，而非遥感图像中的目标检测算法或模型压缩方法。

Ideas for my research: 借鉴意义极低。唯一可能相关的点是"viewpoint selection"的思想——在遥感场景中，多星协同或多视角观测可能受益于类似的任务最优视角选择策略，但论文未涉及遥感场景，且与模型轻量化无直接关系。

Abstract: Existing robotic perception is constrained by sensors that are either robot-mounted or permanently fixed in the environment, locking perception to a limited set of viewpoints. Yet as robots perform increasingly diverse tasks, the most informative viewpoint shifts from one task to the next-often somewhere onboard sensor and static infrastructure can not readily satisfy. To address this gap, we propose SensorPerch, a novel realization of active perception that decouples sensing from both the robot embodiment and the environment by treating sensors as independent physical entities that the robot can autonomously detach and re-attach within the environment. SensorPerch presents one realization of this paradigm: a lightweight, wireless, reconfigurable sensor platform that can perch on diverse surfaces, paired with a viewpoint-selection framework that determines task-optimal sensor placements. Together, these enable robots to construct task-relevant viewpoints on demand, independent of the robot's current position and available fixed infrastructure. We demonstrate the paradigm on two task classes: (i) object-coupled perception, where SensorPerch enables persistent object-state detection beyond the robot's current position, achieving successful event detection even when the robot is not nearby; and (ii) policy-coupled perception, where SensorPerch allows robots to construct diverse, policy-specific viewpoints for various policies, achieving success rates comparable to those obtained using oracle viewpoints.

</details>


### [323] [Action Map Policy: Learning 3D Closed-loop Manipulation via Pixel Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10706)
*Haojie Huang,Zhang Ye,Linfeng Zhao,Boce Hu,Mingxi Jia,Yu Qi,Ahmed Agha,Dian Wang,Robert Platt,Robin Walters*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出Action Map Policy (AMP)，将3D机械臂操作策略学习转化为图像空间中的分类问题，通过将动作投影到相机图像平面并离散化为像素类别，实现高维连续动作的高效建模与快速推理。

Research relevance: 1分，与本研究方向基本无关。该论文聚焦于机器人操作策略学习（robot manipulation policy learning），属于机器人学/具身智能领域，不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱/多光谱等遥感场景，也不涉及目标检测任务，更不涉及模型轻量化方法。

Reading priority: 1分。与"遥感卫星在轨目标检测模型轻量化"研究方向基本无关，不建议投入时间阅读全文。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：3D闭环机械臂操作策略学习（3D closed-loop manipulation policy learning）；应用场景：机器人操作（robot manipulation）；传感器类型：RGB相机（camera image planes）；目标类别：机械臂抓取/操作对象。摘要未说明具体目标类别。

Model architecture: AMP (Action Map Policy)：将3D动作投影到相机图像平面，将每个像素位置视为离散类别，将策略学习转化为图像空间分类问题。支持单次前向传播预测整个动作序列（action chunk），无需噪声调度和迭代去噪。

Lightweight method: 摘要未涉及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS等轻量化方法。但AMP通过将动作学习转化为分类问题，避免了扩散策略的迭代去噪过程，实现了更快的推理速度（faster inference），这属于推理加速而非模型轻量化。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、显存、能耗等部署相关信息。仅提及推理速度比扩散策略（diffusion policies）更快（substantially faster inference），但未给出具体数值。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：摘要未说明具体数据集名称；评价指标：成功率（success rates）、推理速度（faster inference）、空间推理能力（enhanced spatial reasoning）。

Experiments: 在多种操作任务（various manipulation tasks）上，AMP优于强基线方法（strong baselines），取得更高成功率、更快推理速度和更强空间推理能力。摘要未说明具体对比方法和消融实验细节。

Limitations: 与遥感在轨目标检测轻量化方向完全无关。摘要未说明在遥感场景下的适用性、未涉及目标检测任务、未涉及任何模型压缩或边缘部署技术。

Ideas for my research: 弱相关，借鉴意义有限。但AMP将连续动作空间离散化为图像像素分类的思想，在思路上与遥感旋转框检测中的角度离散化或anchor-free检测中的像素级预测有一定形式上的相似性，但应用场景和任务本质完全不同，不建议直接借鉴。

Abstract: The action space poses a major challenge in robot learning, since it is often high-dimensional, can span long time horizons, and frequently admits multi-modal optimal solutions. A good choice of action representation and loss function can help to address these concerns, but there are often trade offs. We propose Action Map Policy (AMP), which casts 3D closed-loop manipulation policy learning as a classification problem in image space. While classification has been an effective formulation in generative language models, applying it to robot action learning is difficult because naively discretizing high-dimensional continuous actions explodes the token vocabulary. Our key idea is to project 3D actions onto the camera image planes and treat each pixel location as a discrete class, thus controlling dimensionality while retaining multi-modality. This method supports millimeter-level precision for high-dimensional actions without requiring a prohibitively large vocabulary, while preserving fine-grained pixel-wise visual signals. Furthermore, it can predict the entire action chunk in a single forward pass, avoiding complex noise scheduling and iterative denoising while achieving substantially faster inference than diffusion policies. Experiments on various manipulation tasks show that AMP outperforms strong baselines, achieving higher success rates, faster inference, and enhanced spatial reasoning.

</details>


### [324] [Learning Roller-Skating Motions of Humanoid Robots Based on Adversarial Motion Priors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10815)
*Yunkang Cheng,Yutong Wu,Menghan Li,Shihe Zhou,Mingguo Zhao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文研究人形机器人轮滑运动，提出基于对抗运动先验(AMP)的强化学习框架，用于两种轮滑步态的学习与控制。

Research relevance: 1分。该论文与遥感、卫星、Earth observation、目标检测、模型轻量化完全无关。研究主题是人形机器人轮滑步态的强化学习控制，属于机器人学与运动控制领域。

Reading priority: 1分。与研究方向完全无关，不建议阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：人形机器人轮滑步态控制（Pump Glide和Push Glide两种步态）；应用场景：机器人运动控制；传感器类型：摘要未说明（可能涉及运动捕捉系统）；目标类别：无。

Model architecture: 基于对抗运动先验(AMP)的强化学习框架，包含独立策略网络、独立奖励架构。

Lightweight method: 不涉及。摘要未提及任何剪枝、量化、蒸馏、NAS或轻量网络设计。

Onboard deployability: 不涉及。摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗等部署相关信息。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：通过运动捕捉(MoCap)采集两种步态数据，经重定向(retargeting)、平滑(smoothing)和重采样(resampling)处理后作为参考运动状态；评价指标：步态质量、速度跟踪、转向能力、步态特定奖励消融。

Limitations: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向完全无关，无任何可借鉴的技术方法或实验设置。

Ideas for my research: 无借鉴点。该论文属于机器人运动控制领域，不涉及遥感图像处理、目标检测或模型轻量化中的任何核心技术。

Abstract: Humanoid roller-skating is difficult because the robot must coordinate whole-body balance, rolling contacts, and velocity-dependent posture regulation. This paper presents an adversarial motion prior based reinforcement learning framework for two humanoid roller-skating gaits: Pump Glide skating and Push Glide skating. The two gait datasets are collected independently through motion capture and retargeted to the humanoid robot separately. The retargeted data are then smoothed and resampled into reference motion states for AMP training. The two gaits are learned by independent AMP training pipelines with separate reference datasets, separate policies, and independent reward architectures. Simulation experiments are designed to evaluate gait quality, velocity tracking, turning, and gait-specific reward ablations.

</details>


### [325] [D-SafeMPC: Diffusion-Driven Safe Model Predictive Control with Discrete-Time Control Barrier Functions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10842)
*Erdi Sayar,Ersin Daş,Joel W. Burdick,Alois Knoll,Erdal Kayacan*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出D-SafeMPC方法，将控制障碍函数(CBF)和控制Lyapunov函数(CLF)融入扩散模型的逆向去噪过程，结合MPC迭代优化，解决机器人规划中扩散模型无法保证安全性和动力学约束的问题。

Research relevance: 1分，与本研究方向基本无关。论文聚焦于机器人运动规划中的安全约束问题，完全不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱/多光谱等遥感领域内容，也不涉及目标检测任务，更不涉及模型轻量化、剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、边缘/星上部署等压缩加速技术。

Reading priority: 1分。与研究方向完全无关，不建议阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：机器人运动规划（motion planning）；应用场景：Franka机械臂操作（含静态障碍和动态障碍场景）；传感器类型：摘要未说明；目标类别：无目标检测相关。

Model architecture: 基于扩散模型（diffusion model）的轨迹生成，结合MPC（模型预测控制）、CBF（控制障碍函数）、CLF（控制Lyapunov函数）进行安全约束引导。非视觉检测模型架构。

Lightweight method: 摘要未涉及任何轻量化方法（无剪枝、量化、蒸馏、NAS、轻量网络设计等）。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、显存、延迟、能耗等部署相关信息。实验在Franka机械臂上进行仿真和真实实验，与星上/边缘部署无关。

Datasets and metrics: 实验场景：Franka机械臂的4个仿真场景（1个静态障碍+3个动态障碍）及1个sim-to-real真实实验；评价指标：安全性（safety）、任务成功率（task success rate）、规划效率（planning efficiency）。无遥感数据集。

Experiments: 在Franka机械臂仿真和真实实验中，D-SafeMPC相比SOTA基线方法在安全性、任务成功率和规划效率上有提升。具体数值摘要未给出。

Limitations: 与遥感在轨目标检测及轻量化方向完全无关，无任何可借鉴的轻量化或目标检测技术。该方法针对机器人安全规划设计，不适用于视觉检测任务。

Ideas for my research: 无直接可借鉴点。该论文属于机器人控制与安全规划领域，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测模型轻量化课题在任务目标、技术路线、应用场景上均无交集。

Abstract: A key limitation on the use of diffusion models in robotic planning is their inability to inherently enforce safety or dynamical constraints, which often results in physically infeasible or unsafe outputs. Hybrid approaches that employ model predictive control (MPC) to address this problem can be unstable, as poor trajectory initializations from the diffusion model prevent the MPC from converging to a safe and feasible solution. To overcome these challenges, we propose D-SafeMPC, which enhances the interaction between diffusion and control. Our method guides the reverse diffusion process with control barrier functions (CBFs) and control Lyapunov functions (CLFs) and employs an iterative-projection scheme where an MPC refines the trajectory at each denoising step. This steers sampling toward safe, goal-directed regions and provides reliable MPC warm starts. In simulations on a Franka manipulator across four scenarios (one static-obstacle and three dynamic-obstacle settings) and in a sim-to-real experiment on a physical Franka robot, D-SafeMPC improves safety, task success rates, and planning efficiency over state-of-the-art baselines. To facilitate reproducibility, our source code and experimental configurations are available in a repository at https://github.com/erdiphd/D-SafeMPC

</details>


### [326] [3D Scene Graph Prediction: Generating Hierarchical Models from Partially Observed Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10879)
*Siyi H,Jared Strade,Hyungtae Lim,Luca Carlone*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种面向机器人探索场景的层级式3D室内场景图生成方法，包含房间层（平面图与可通行性）和物体层（室内物体布局），采用混合域图扩散模型进行生成。

Research relevance: 1分，与本研究方向基本无关。该论文聚焦于室内3D场景生成（indoor scene generation），面向机器人探索和室内设计应用，完全不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱/多光谱等遥感核心要素，也不涉及目标检测或模型轻量化。

Reading priority: 1分。该论文研究室内3D场景生成，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，不建议投入阅读时间。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：3D室内场景图生成（hierarchical 3D scene graph synthesis）；应用场景：机器人环境探索、室内设计；传感器类型：摘要未说明（可能为RGB-D或激光雷达）；目标类别：房间类别、物体类别（如家具）。与遥感目标检测无关。

Model architecture: 提出top-down框架，包含两层：(1) 房间层：混合域图扩散模型（mixed-domain graph diffusion model），联合预测房间类别、楼层边界、房间间可通行性；(2) 物体层：混合离散-连续扩散模型（mixed discrete-continuous diffusion model），联合预测物体类别、位置、尺寸、朝向。支持通过corruption和masking处理部分观测约束。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明任何轻量化方法。不涉及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS、轻量网络设计等模型压缩或加速技术。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗等部署相关信息。该论文面向机器人场景，但未讨论边缘部署或实时推理约束。

Datasets and metrics: 在标准benchmark上与occupancy-based和LLM-based的平面图生成方法进行对比。使用机器人采集的真实场景数据进行评估。具体数据集名称和评价指标摘要未说明。

Experiments: 与occupancy-based学习基线相比，该方法在分布外（out-of-distribution）部分平面图上的泛化能力显著更好。在机器人采集的真实场景上展示了集成预测pipeline，能够预测已探索区域之外的环境。

Limitations: (1) 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化完全无关，无任何可迁移的技术细节；(2) 未讨论模型计算效率、推理速度等部署关键指标；(3) 仅针对室内场景，场景尺度、传感器特性与遥感差异巨大。

Ideas for my research: 该论文与"在轨遥感目标检测模型轻量化"课题基本无直接借鉴点。唯一的间接启发是：扩散模型（diffusion model）在生成任务中的图结构建模思路，但与本课题的检测+轻量化核心方向不相关。

Abstract: Generating realistic 3D indoor scenes is an area of growing interest in computer vision and robotics. Existing methods, often motivated by applications such as interior design, generally focus on object layout generation within a single room. The generation of high-level scene structure, such as room-level layout and traversability, remains underexplored despite its importance for robotics applications. In this paper, we consider the case where a robot has explored part of an environment and needs to predict the unexplored parts to support downstream tasks such as exploration or object search. We propose a top-down framework for synthesizing hierarchical 3D scene graphs, including a room layer -- describing the floor plan and traversability -- and an object layer modeling object layouts within each room. For the room layer, we propose a novel mixed-domain graph diffusion model jointly predicting room categories, floor boundaries, and traversability between rooms. Via corruption and masking, this model supports partial constraints such as incomplete floor plans, avoiding the need for partially observed training data. For the object layer, we integrate an existing mixed discrete-continuous diffusion model for joint prediction of object categories, locations, sizes, and orientations within each room given the floor plan. We compare our method with state-of-the-art occupancy-based and LLM-based floor plan generation methods on a standard benchmark. Compared with an occupancy-based learning baseline, our method generalizes substantially better to out-of-distribution partial floor plans. We also demonstrate our integrated prediction pipeline on real-world scenes from robot-collected data, enabling prediction beyond explored areas.

</details>


### [327] [A Single Diffusion-Policy Controller for Multi-Task Block Pushing with Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Transfer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10892)
*Haitong Ma,Haldun Balim,Yang Hu,Bo Dai,Na Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出用强化学习从零训练扩散策略（diffusion policy）用于多任务机器人推方块操作，不涉及遥感、卫星或轻量化。

Reading priority: 1分。与研究方向基本无关，不建议投入时间阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：机器人多任务操作（multi-task robotic manipulation）；应用场景：推方块（block-pushing）；传感器类型：摘要未说明；目标类别：不同形状的方块（blocks）。与遥感目标检测无关。

Model architecture: 扩散策略（diffusion policy），用于表示和生成机器人动作。具体网络结构摘要未说明。

Lightweight method: 不涉及。论文未讨论任何模型压缩、加速或轻量化方法（如剪枝、量化、蒸馏、NAS等）。

Onboard deployability: 不涉及。摘要未提及参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗、实时性或任何星上/边缘部署相关信息。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：自建仿真环境（sparse-reward simulation setting）及真实世界推方块场景（real-world block-pushing setup）；评价指标：摘要未明确说明具体指标，仅提及零样本迁移（zero-shot transfer）到真实世界的成功率。

Limitations: 1. 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化完全无关，无法提供直接借鉴；2. 仅针对推方块这一简单操作任务，未涉及复杂视觉感知或检测任务；3. 未讨论模型效率或部署约束。

Ideas for my research: 无直接可借鉴点。该论文属于机器人学习领域，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测模型轻量化方向无交叉。

Abstract: Diffusion policies have shown promising empirical performance in representing and learning complex maneuvers for robots using behavior cloning (BC). In this paper, we explore training diffusion policies from scratch using reinforcement learning (RL) for multi-task robotic manipulation. Specifically, we aim to train a single diffusion policy for block-pushing tasks with multiple shapes. The proposed framework features a simple policy loss function, which is a reweighted evidence lower bound used in BC-based diffusion policy training and can seamlessly serve as the policy learning module in RL algorithms. To address the exploration challenges arising from the absence of demonstrations, we incorporate reverse curriculum generation and objective-centric representations. Combined with the expressiveness of diffusion policies, our design supports learning of multi-task block-pushing policies in our sparse-reward simulation setting. We further evaluate whether the trained diffusion policy transfers in zero-shot to real-world tasks under varying environmental conditions including goal positions, block shapes, block weights and surface friction, providing evidence that this pipeline can transfer to our real-world block-pushing setup under the tested variations.

</details>

*Michalis Chatzispyrou,Luke Horgan,Hyunkil Hwang,Harish Sathishchandra,Chinmay Burgul,Monika Roznere,Alberto Quattrini Li,Philippos Mordohai,Ioannis Rekleitis*

Research relevance: 1分，与本研究方向基本无关。该论文聚焦于水下环境建图（underwater mapping），不涉及遥感卫星、航空图像、SAR、高光谱/多光谱等遥感数据，也不涉及目标检测或模型轻量化。属于水下机器人视觉SLAM领域，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化无直接关联。

<details>
