Task and scene: 任务类型：多会话水下环境建图（multi-session underwater mapping）；应用场景：水下沉船测绘；传感器：运动相机（action camera）、惯性测量单元（IMU）、潜水电脑深度记录；目标类别：无目标检测任务，仅涉及场景重建。

Model architecture: SVIn2（VI-SLAM框架）用于轨迹估计和稀疏重建；COLMAP（SfM框架）用于全局优化和稠密重建。未涉及任何深度学习目标检测模型。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明任何轻量化方法。不涉及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS、轻量网络设计等。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗等部署相关信息。不涉及星上/边缘部署。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：自采集的巴巴多斯海域沉船数据（多会话）；评价指标：摘要未说明定量指标，仅定性描述建图效果。

Experiments: 在巴巴多斯海域沉船场景进行了三会话建图实验，其中两个会话分别测绘沉船外部和内部，第三个会话使用两个不同视场角的相机。未提供定量对比实验或消融实验。

Limitations: 1. 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向完全无关；2. 未提供定量评价指标；3. 依赖标定目标进行多会话对齐，通用性受限；4. 仅适用于水下近距场景，无法迁移至遥感领域。

Ideas for my research: 该论文与"在轨遥感目标检测模型轻量化"课题无直接可借鉴点。唯一可能的间接启发是：多传感器融合（视觉+惯性+深度）的思路在星上多模态融合（如可见光+红外+高光谱）中可能有参考价值，但本文未涉及轻量化或检测，借鉴意义极低。

Abstract: This paper presents a framework for multi-session mapping of underwater environments utilizing an affordable action camera. The Visual-Inertial data are augmented by water depth recordings from a dive computer. SVIn2, an open-source VI-SLAM framework, is utilized to generate a trajectory and a sparse reconstruction for each session. Utilizing the keyframes extracted from SVIn2 and the estimated camera poses, a Structure-from-Motion (SfM) framework, COLMAP, is employed for global optimization and to produce a dense reconstruction of the target environment. The presence of calibration targets at fixed locations, when available, is used to estimate the coordinate transformation between different data collection sessions, thus transforming the different sessions into the same coordinate frame. The proposed pipeline is employed for the mapping of a shipwreck off the coast of Barbados. For the first time, both the exterior and the accessible interior parts of the wreck were mapped in two sessions, while a third session employed two cameras with different fields of view.

</details>


### [329] [Real-Time Rulebook-Aware Nonlinear MPC for Autonomous Driving with Priority-Biased Tiered Slacks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10975)
*Hadi Hajieghrary,Benedikt Walter,Chaitanya Shinde,Paul Schmitt,Miguel Hurtado*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出W-SQP加权分层松弛非线性模型预测控制器，用于自动驾驶运动规划中的多规则冲突消解与实时求解。

Research relevance: 1分。该论文与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关。论文研究的是自动驾驶运动规划中的非线性模型预测控制(NMPC)，涉及交通规则约束、实时求解器(CasADi/IPOPT)和Waymo数据集，不涉及遥感图像、目标检测、卫星或任何轻量化模型压缩技术。

Reading priority: 1分。与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，不建议投入时间阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务：自动驾驶运动规划（motion planning）；场景：城市道路驾驶；传感器类型：摘要未说明（基于Waymo数据集，可能包含LiDAR/相机）；目标类别：无目标检测任务。

Model architecture: W-SQP：加权分层松弛非线性模型预测控制器（weighted tiered-slack NMPC），将9类驾驶规则编译为4层共享松弛非线性规划，使用CasADi和IPOPT求解器在线求解。

Lightweight method: 不涉及。论文未使用剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS等任何模型压缩或加速方法。其"轻量"体现在求解器限时90ms返回任意迭代解，但这属于实时控制中的anytime算法策略，而非模型轻量化。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明星上部署相关信息。仅提供计算延迟：控制频率10Hz，求解器限时90ms，中位求解时间28ms，最大104ms。未提供参数量、FLOPs、显存、能耗等指标。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：Waymo Open Motion Dataset（150个场景）；评价指标：基于日志无关的(log-independent)安全与合规规则评估，分离安全/合规性与人类轨迹相似度；对比基线：reactive和proposal-and-select方法。

Experiments: 在Waymo 150场景闭环评估，W-SQP在日志无关的安全与合规规则上无系统性群体级缺陷，但在最难、分歧最大的场景中存在局部退化。

Limitations: 论文明确自述为可审计、优先级偏置、anytime能力的NMPC原型，而非硬实时或形式化安全控制器。与遥感卫星在轨目标检测完全无关，无任何可迁移的技术方法。

Ideas for my research: 弱相关，借鉴价值极低。唯一可参考的是其"anytime算法"思想——在有限时间内返回当前最优解，这对星上推理的实时性约束有一定启发，但方法本身（NMPC+非线性规划求解）与目标检测模型轻量化无直接关系。

Abstract: Autonomous-vehicle motion planners must resolve conflicts among safety, regulation, comfort, and efficiency in real time while exposing those decisions for audit. We present W-SQP, a weighted tiered-slack nonlinear model predictive controller (NMPC) that compiles nine driving-rule families into a four-tier shared-slack nonlinear program solved online with CasADi and IPOPT; the name denotes the weighted quadratic slack penalty, not a sequential-quadratic-programming solver. Strongly separated tier penalties bias residual violations toward lower-priority rules while leaving actuation bounds hard. The controller replans from its executed state at $10$\,Hz and records per-rule residuals on every cycle. A $90$\,ms solver-time limit returns an anytime iterate that is projected through the vehicle dynamics before execution; median and maximum observed wall-clock solve times were $28$ and $104$\,ms. We evaluate W-SQP in closed loop on 150 Waymo Open Motion Dataset scenarios in Waymax against reactive and proposal-and-select baselines, and introduce a log-independent protocol that separates safety and regulatory compliance from resemblance to the recorded human trajectory. Under this protocol, W-SQP shows no systematic group-level deficit relative to expert replay on the log-independent safety and regulatory rules, with several localized regressions in the hardest, highest-divergence scenarios. The results characterize W-SQP as an auditable, priority-biased, anytime-capable NMPC prototype rather than a hard-real-time or formally safe controller.

</details>


### [330] [Think When It Matters: Conditional VLM Reasoning for Social Navigation with RL Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10991)
*Ali Ahmadi,Hamed Rahimi,Adrien Jacquet Cretides,Marie Samson,Mahdi Khoramshahi,Mohamed Chetouani*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种混合架构HUMA，将强化学习导航策略与视觉语言模型结合，用于社交机器人导航，在保证实时性的同时提升语义推理能力。

Research relevance: 1分，与本研究方向基本无关。论文聚焦于地面移动机器人的社交导航（social robot navigation），不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱/多光谱等任何遥感相关场景；不涉及目标检测任务；不涉及模型轻量化方法（剪枝、量化、蒸馏、NAS等）。虽然提到了实时部署和计算效率问题，但场景和任务与"遥感卫星在轨目标检测模型轻量化"完全无关。

Reading priority: 1分，与"遥感卫星在轨目标检测模型轻量化"研究方向基本无关，不建议投入时间精读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务：社交机器人导航（social robot navigation）；场景：地面移动机器人在人类环境中的导航；传感器：摘要未说明具体传感器类型；目标类别：人类（行人）。

Model architecture: 混合架构HUMA：由反应式RL策略（低密度常规导航任务）和高级VLM（人类进入敏感区域时触发）组成，动态平衡计算效率与语义理解。

Lightweight method: 摘要未涉及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS等轻量化方法。仅提到通过混合架构（RL+VLM动态切换）来缓解VLM的高计算成本和慢推理问题，而非对模型本身进行轻量化。

Onboard deployability: 摘要提到在Mirokaï移动机器人上进行了真实部署，但未给出参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗等具体部署指标。仅定性说明RL策略具有fast inference和reactive behavior，VLM存在high computational cost和slow inference。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：Social-MP3D和Social-HM3D；评价指标：任务成功率（task success improvement 20%和3%）、个人空间侵犯减少、人类碰撞减少。

Experiments: 在Social-MP3D和Social-HM3D上分别提升20%和3%的任务成功率，显著减少个人空间侵犯和人类碰撞；进行了消融实验验证各组件有效性；在Mirokaï机器人上进行了真实世界部署验证。

Limitations: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测完全无关，无法提供任何遥感场景下的借鉴。摘要本身未说明VLM部分的推理延迟具体数值、混合切换的延迟开销、以及极端密集人群场景下的性能边界。

Ideas for my research: 弱相关，借鉴意义有限。唯一可参考的思路是"混合架构"思想——在遥感在轨场景中，或许可以设计一种轻量模型与重模型动态切换的策略：常规场景使用轻量检测模型，复杂/高价值场景触发更重的模型。但该论文的RL+VLM切换逻辑（基于人与机器人的距离）无法直接迁移到遥感卫星场景。

Abstract: As mobile robots become more integrated into everyday human environments, social robot navigation is becoming essential for ensuring human comfort, safety, and trust. While reinforcement learning (RL) navigation policies provide the fast inference and reactive behavior necessary for real-time deployment, they still lack flexible semantic reasoning capabilities and often fail to generalize to complex social scenarios. Recent approaches have increasingly turned to vision-language models (VLMs) in place of RL policies to improve semantic and social reasoning in robot navigation. Nevertheless, their high computational cost and slow inference remain major barriers to real-time deployment. To overcome these limitations, we introduce HUMA (Hybrid Understanding for Multi-modal social Navigation), a hybrid architecture that dynamically balances the computational efficiency of RL policies with the deep semantic understanding of VLMs. Our approach uses a reactive RL policy to handle low-density, routine navigation tasks, while conditioning it on a post-trained high-level VLM when a human enters sensitive situations, such as the robot's proximity zone. We evaluate HUMA on the Social-MP3D and Social-HM3D benchmarks, where it achieves task success improvements of 20% and 3%, respectively, while significantly reducing personal space violations and human collisions against state-of-the-art baselines. Extensive ablation studies validate each architectural component, and real-world deployment on the Mirokaï mobile robot further demonstrates the practical viability of our approach.

</details>


### [331] [Wearing A Coat: Dual-Arm Robot-Assisted Dressing with Differentiable Clothing Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10999)
*Yiming Liu,Lijun Han,Hesheng Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种结合可微布料仿真的机器人穿衣控制算法，通过高阶扰动迭代求解和约束局部模型优化，实现实时穿衣辅助。

Research relevance: 1分。该论文与遥感、卫星、目标检测、模型轻量化完全无关，属于机器人穿衣辅助控制领域，涉及可微物理仿真和实时控制优化。

Reading priority: 1分。与"遥感卫星在轨目标检测模型轻量化"研究方向基本无关，不建议阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Model architecture: 可微布料仿真（differentiable clothing simulation）+ 全局控制器（global controller）+ 约束局部模型（constrained local model）用于高频补偿。

Lightweight method: 摘要未涉及剪枝、量化、蒸馏、NAS等典型轻量化方法。文中提到通过高阶扰动迭代提升计算效率、引入约束局部模型提升实时性，但这些属于物理仿真加速，非深度学习模型压缩。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、显存、能耗等部署指标。仅提及"实时性能提升"（real-time performance），但未给出具体延迟数据。

Datasets and metrics: 摘要未说明具体数据集名称和定量评价指标。仅提到通过仿真场景和物理场景（simulated and physical dressing scenarios）验证可行性。

Experiments: 摘要未提供与基线方法的定量对比结果或消融实验数据。

Limitations: 与遥感在轨目标检测轻量化方向完全无关，无任何可借鉴的遥感/检测/轻量化内容。

Ideas for my research: 无借鉴意义。该论文属于机器人控制与物理仿真交叉领域，不涉及遥感图像处理、目标检测或模型压缩。

Abstract: The development of assistive robots for dressing tasks serves to augment human convenience and improve the quality of life for individuals with physical impairments. However, due to the intricate contact interactions between garments and the human limbs during dressing, most robot-assisted dressing algorithms treat clothing as an assembly of discrete segments, thereby struggling to manage the partial worn garments under contact constraints. To overcome this challenge, we propose a novel robotic dressing control algorithm that integrates realtime differentiable clothing simulation. The simulation algorithm employs explicit iterative scheme with intentionally introduced higher-order perturbations to enhance computational efficiency while maintaining stability under large time-step conditions. Through simulation, we resolve the garment state under contact constraints, which then enables a multi-phase control strategy for successful coat dressing assistance. To further improve real-time performance, we introduce a constrained local model along with its corresponding optimization solver, permitting high-frequency local compensation for the differentiable simulation based global controller. Finally, we experimentally validate our approach through both simulated and physical dressing scenarios, conclusively demonstrating its feasibility and efficacy

</details>


### [332] [Affordance-Based Manipulation Planning with Text Goals and Sim-to-Real Generalisation via Real-to-Sim Image Conversion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11004)
*Solvi Arnold,Rin Karashima,Tadashi Adachi,Takafumi Mochizuki,Kimitoshi Yamazaki*

TL;DR: 提出一种基于可供性识别和动作效果预测的机械臂操作规划系统，通过视觉推理和多模态目标匹配生成动作计划。

Abstract: We present a manipulation planning system based on affordance recognition and action effect prediction. The system reasons through possible futures in visual form, and evaluates candidate plans by agreement of predicted outcomes with text-based goals set at run-time, using a multi-modal goal-matching module. Positions of objects named in the goal text are tracked through predictions even when occluded, making it possible to generate action plans even when objects become occluded, or when their initial descriptors cease to identify them in future states. We further expand the system with an image conversion module for translating real-world state images with objects of varied shapes and visual appearances into a consistent visual appearance, to facilitate manipulation planning in a physical robot setup. We evaluate performance of the system's modules in isolation and demonstrate the integrated system's manipulation planning capabilities on a set of challenging tasks in both simulation and on hardware.

</details>


### [333] [Whole-Body Semantic-to-Actuation Grounding of Elephant-Inspired Soft-Trunk Motion via Lightweight Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11018)
*Tingcong Liu,Tongshun Chen,Siyi Ma,Yuhao Wang,Aye Phyu Phyu Aung,Ibrahim Alsarraj,J. Senthilnath,Bo An,Ke Wu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种基于轻量流匹配的大象软躯干机器人全身语义到驱动映射框架，用于人机交互中的全身表达。

Research relevance: 1分，与本研究方向基本无关。论文研究的是人机交互（HRI）中的软体机器人控制，不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱/多光谱等任何遥感相关领域，也不涉及目标检测任务。

Reading priority: 1分。该论文与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，不建议投入时间精读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务：人机交互（HRI）中的软体机器人全身运动生成；场景：close-contact HRI；传感器类型：不适用；目标类别：不适用。

Model architecture: 基于rectified-flow（整流流）的生成模型，结合多模态大语言模型（MLLM）和Catmull-Rom样条控制参数化。

Lightweight method: 摘要提到"lightweight flow matching"，但未说明具体轻量化手段（如剪枝、量化、蒸馏等）。仅提及推理时间从7.86ms降至4.87ms，但未给出参数量、FLOPs等指标。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明星上/边缘部署相关信息。推理时间4.87ms，但这是在地面机器人控制场景下，与遥感卫星在轨部署无关。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：摘要未说明具体数据集名称；评价指标：grounding correctness（正确率）、inference time（推理时间）、motion diversity（运动多样性）、overall-satisfaction rating（满意度评分）。

Experiments: held-out grounding correctness从25.0%（dense-regression基线）提升至77.2%；相比denoising-diffusion基线，正确率从71.9%提升至77.2%，推理时间从7.86ms降至4.87ms；100人物理HRI实验显示满意度从46%提升至82%。

Limitations: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向完全无关，无法直接借鉴。摘要未说明模型参数量、FLOPs、显存占用等部署关键指标。

Ideas for my research: 弱相关，可借鉴点有限：1）"lightweight flow matching"作为一种生成式轻量方法，若未来遥感领域需要生成式数据增强或运动预测，可参考其整流流设计思路；2）Catmull-Rom样条参数化控制点的思路，在遥感模型轻量化中可用于曲线边界框的参数化表示。但整体而言，与在轨遥感目标检测轻量化课题关联度极低。

Abstract: For close-contact human-robot interaction (HRI), trunk-like continuum manipulators provide a physical channel for diverse whole-body expression, but grounding open-vocabulary responses into such robots is difficult: end-effector motion underspecifies body shape, whereas direct whole-body commands are high-dimensional and hard to keep feasible. We propose a whole-body semantic-to-actuation grounding framework for elephant-inspired soft-trunk HRI based on lightweight flow matching. The framework converts responses from a multimodal large language model into bounded, morphology-aligned intent-intensity tuples, parameterizes tendon-actuation trajectories with compact Catmull-Rom spline controls, and uses a rectified-flow generator to sample feasible whole-body trunk motions. Experiments show that the proposed framework improves held-out grounding correctness from 25.0% to 77.2% over a raw-response dense-regression baseline. Compared with a denoising-diffusion baseline, it improves correctness from 71.9% to 77.2% and reduces inference time from 7.86 ms to 4.87 ms while preserving motion diversity. A 100-participant physical HRI study further shows that adding the generated soft-trunk motion channel increases the positive overall-satisfaction rating from 46% to 82% over the audiovisual-only baseline.

</details>


### [334] [SegDiff: Segmented Trajectory Diffusion for Consistent and Adaptive Robot Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11027)
*Haidong Cao,Wenjun Cao,Quanhao Li,Sicheng Xie,Zhiying Du,Jiaqi Leng,Zuxuan Wu,Yu-Gang Jiang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出SegDiff，一种结合关键姿态与连续轨迹预测的闭环视觉运动策略，用于机器人模仿学习。

Research relevance: 1分，与本研究方向基本无关。该论文聚焦于机器人模仿学习中的visuomotor policy，不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱/多光谱等遥感领域，也不涉及目标检测或模型轻量化。

Reading priority: 1分。论文主题为机器人模仿学习，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测模型轻量化研究方向基本无关，不建议投入时间阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：机器人模仿学习（imitation learning）、visuomotor policy。应用场景：机器人操作技能获取（manipulation skills）。传感器类型：视觉观测（observations）。目标类别：机器人动作轨迹。与遥感目标检测完全无关。

Model architecture: SegDiff，基于扩散模型（diffusion models）和DDIM inversion的闭环策略网络。包含Dynamic Temporal Ensembling机制。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明任何轻量化方法。不涉及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS、轻量网络设计等。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗等部署相关信息。虽然提及"real-time applicability"和"real-time refinement"，但未给出具体数值指标，且场景为机器人而非星上/边缘部署。

Datasets and metrics: 摘要未说明具体数据集名称和评价指标。仅提及在simulated and real-world scenarios上进行了实验。

Experiments: 摘要未提供具体实验结果数值。仅声称"significant performance gains over existing approaches"。

Limitations: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向完全无关，无任何可借鉴的遥感或轻量化信息。摘要未讨论模型效率、计算资源约束等关键问题。

Ideas for my research: 弱相关，借鉴价值极低。唯一可能间接相关的点是：扩散模型（diffusion models）在轨迹预测中的应用思路，但与本课题（遥感目标检测轻量化）方向差异过大，不建议深入阅读。

Abstract: Imitation learning enables robots to acquire manipulation skills from demonstrations by mapping observations to actions. Existing approaches predict either short-horizon continuous action sequences or discrete keyposes. However, continuous prediction methods suffer from compounding errors due to short prediction horizons and struggle with multi-modal action distributions, whereas keypose-based methods necessitate an external planner, constraining real-time applicability. To address these challenges, we introduce SegDiff, a closed-loop visuomotor policy that integrates the strengths of both paradigms. SegDiff decomposes demonstrations into motion segments between keyposes and learns to predict the continuous trajectory from the current state to the next keypose, enabling long-horizon prediction with real-time refinement. Furthermore, we leverage the capability of diffusion models and DDIM inversion to propose a Dynamic Temporal Ensembling mechanism, which allows the policy to efficiently respond to dynamic environments and mitigate discontinuities caused by inconsistent multi-modal sampling. SegDiff demonstrates significant performance gains over existing approaches across various simulated and real-world scenarios, indicating its strong ability to reason over extended temporal dependencies while maintaining real-time adaptability and control stability.

</details>


### [335] [Learning to Navigate Efficiently with Only 0.58M Trainable Parameters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11029)
*Edward Beng Wai Tan,Siew-Kei Lam*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种分解式视觉导航模型，将投影几何、占据网格、坐标变换等已知闭式结构作为可学习模块之间的接口，仅用0.58M可训练参数（总22.7M）在44k帧数据上训练不到1 GPU小时，即接近SOTA导航性能，推理速度达50Hz。

Research relevance: 1分，与本研究方向基本无关。论文聚焦于室内/仿真环境下的视觉导航（visual navigation），不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱/多光谱等遥感场景；不涉及目标检测（object detection）、小目标检测、旋转框检测、舰船/飞机/车辆检测等遥感检测任务；不涉及轻量化中的剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS等通用模型压缩方法，虽然模型本身参数少，但这是通过任务分解（decomposed architecture）实现的，而非轻量化技术。

Reading priority: 1分。与"遥感卫星在轨目标检测模型轻量化"方向基本无关，不建议深入阅读。除非对"用先验知识替代网络学习以减少参数量"这一通用思路感兴趣，可作为跨领域启发参考。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：视觉导航（visual navigation），包括point-goal navigation和no-goal exploration。应用场景：室内环境（60 environments），非遥感/卫星场景。传感器类型：视觉（RGB），摘要未提及遥感传感器。目标类别：导航目标点（goal），非遥感目标。

Model architecture: 分解式导航模型（decomposed navigation model），包含三个小规模可学习模块：(1) egress predictor——将episode目标映射为当前视图中的局部子目标；(2) navigation predictor——估计目标条件化的轨迹后验分布；(3) endpoint-pinned residual diffusion generator——从后验中采样轨迹形状。模块之间通过已知闭式结构（projective geometry, occupancy, coordinate transforms）作为接口连接。总参数量22.7M，但仅0.58M可训练。

Lightweight method: 非传统轻量化方法。模型参数少是通过"任务分解+已知闭式结构替代学习"实现的，而非剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS等通用模型压缩技术。可训练参数仅占总参数的2.55%（0.58M/22.7M）。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未涉及星上/边缘部署。推理速度50 Hz（实时性较好），可训练参数仅0.58M，但总参数22.7M。未报告FLOPs、显存、能耗等部署关键指标。未涉及FPGA/NPU/TensorRT等硬件适配。

Datasets and metrics: 训练数据：44k帧（frames）。测试：6060个point-goal episodes，60个环境。评价指标：与SOTA模型对比性能（接近SOTA）、可训练参数减少233x、碰撞率最低（lowest collision rate）、推理速度50 Hz。摘要未说明具体数据集名称。

Experiments: 在6060个point-goal episodes和60个环境上接近SOTA导航性能；可训练参数减少233倍；碰撞率在所有评估方法中最低；推理速度50 Hz；分解方法可迁移至无目标探索（仅重训练123k参数的egress head）；在传感器损坏情况下的失效模式透明且可解析修正。

Limitations: 1. 与遥感/卫星/目标检测完全无关；2. 未涉及任何遥感数据集或遥感场景；3. 未涉及目标检测任务；4. 轻量化思路（任务分解+闭式结构替代）是领域特定的导航方法，难以直接迁移到遥感目标检测；5. 未报告FLOPs、能耗、显存等部署指标；6. 仅在室内仿真环境验证，未在真实遥感数据上测试。

Ideas for my research: 借鉴意义有限，但有以下思路可参考：1. "已知先验结构替代部分网络学习"的思想——在遥感目标检测中，是否可以将几何先验（如卫星成像模型、地物空间分布先验）以解析形式嵌入网络，减少可学习参数？2. 模块化分解思路——将遥感在轨检测分解为"粗定位+精识别"等子任务，每个子任务用小网络完成，中间用可解析的几何/坐标变换连接；3. 极低数据量下训练（44k帧）的思路对在轨场景中标注数据稀缺有启发，但需验证在遥感数据上的有效性。

Abstract: Recent progress in visual navigation has largely been driven by scale: end-to-end policies with hundreds of millions of parameters trained on billions of frames or large-scale simulated data. We ask how much of this scale a single task family actually requires, and what structure can substitute for it. We propose a decomposed navigation model in which operations with known closed-form structure, such as projective geometry, occupancy, and coordinate transforms, are computed analytically and serve as interfaces between three small learned modules: an egress predictor that grounds the episode goal as a local subgoal in the current view, a navigation predictor that estimates a goal-conditioned posterior over where trajectories travel, and an endpoint-pinned residual diffusion generator that samples trajectory shapes from this posterior. The system trains only 0.58M out of a total of 22.7M parameters, on 44k frames in under one GPU-hour, yet approaches the performance of state-of-the-art models on navigation tasks across 6060 point-goal episodes and 60 environments, while having 233x fewer trainable parameters, the lowest collision rate among all evaluated methods, and 50 Hz inference speed. The decomposition further transfers to no-goal exploration by retraining only the 123k-parameter egress head, and its failure modes under sensor corruption are transparent and analytically correctable.

</details>


### [336] [GraspGraphNet: Graph-Structured Multi-Embodiment Dexterous Grasp Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11031)
*Yeonseo Lee,Taeyeop Lee,Hyosup Shin,Guebin Hwang,Sungho Jo*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出GraspGraphNet，一种基于运动学图结构的跨机器人手型灵巧抓取生成框架，利用条件流匹配直接生成可执行抓取姿态。

Research relevance: 1分，与本研究方向基本无关。论文研究的是机器人灵巧手抓取生成（dexterous grasp generation），不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱/多光谱等任何遥感相关领域，也不涉及目标检测或模型轻量化。

Reading priority: 1分。与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化研究方向基本无关，不建议投入时间阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：灵巧抓取生成（dexterous grasp generation）；应用场景：机器人操作（robot manipulation）；传感器类型：摘要未说明；目标类别：机器人手（Barrett Hand, Allegro Hand, Shadow Hand）的抓取姿态。

Model architecture: GraspGraphNet：基于URDF运动学图（kinematic graph）的图神经网络框架，包含层次化物体表面编码（hierarchical object surface encoding）、可微正向运动学（differentiable forward kinematics）、动态世界边消息传递（dynamic world-edge message passing）。

Lightweight method: 摘要未涉及任何轻量化方法（剪枝、量化、蒸馏、NAS、轻量网络等）。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未涉及星上/边缘部署。仅提到推理时间40ms per grasp，但未说明硬件平台、参数量、FLOPs、显存、能耗等信息。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：40-object benchmark（具体数据集名称摘要未说明）；评价指标：平均成功率（average success rate, 83.48%）；推理时间：40ms per grasp。

Experiments: 在Barrett Hand、Allegro Hand、Shadow Hand上训练共享模型，平均成功率83.48%；在受控手指移除变体上无需重训达到72.70%成功率，验证了对不同手型拓扑的鲁棒性。

Limitations: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向完全无关，无任何可借鉴的遥感或轻量化内容。摘要未说明模型参数量、计算复杂度、部署硬件等信息。

Ideas for my research: 该论文与"在轨遥感目标检测模型轻量化"课题无直接可借鉴点。唯一可能间接参考的是其图结构表示（graph-structured representation）的思想，但应用场景差异过大，不建议深入阅读。

Abstract: Dexterous grasp generation across robot hands is challenging because hands differ in kinematic topology, actuation dimensions, and native command spaces. We introduce GraspGraphNet, a topology-aware grasp generation framework that represents each hand as a URDF-derived kinematic graph and directly generates executable palm poses and joint configurations. GraspGraphNet combines hierarchical object surface encoding, differentiable forward kinematics, and dynamic world-edge message passing to model evolving robot-object interactions. It applies conditional flow matching directly in executable palm-pose and joint-state space, avoiding post-processing optimization, inverse kinematics, and retargeting. Using a shared model trained on Barrett Hand, Allegro Hand, and Shadow Hand, GraspGraphNet achieves an average success rate of 83.48% with 40ms inference time per grasp on a 40-object benchmark. Without retraining, the same model achieves 72.70% success on controlled finger-removal variants, demonstrating robustness to hand-topology variations. These results suggest that graph-structured hand representations can effectively support dexterous grasp generation across robot hands with different kinematic structures. Project: https://lysees.github.io/graspgraphnet-page

</details>


### [337] [PAKE: Learning Whole-Body Loco-Manipulation with Partial Kinematic Embeddings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11041)
*Zhengmao He,Moonkyu Jung,Hyeongjun Kim,Jiseong Lee,Hui Zhang,Jemin Hwangbo,Jie Song*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种基于运动学归一化流（KNF）的全身控制框架，用于四足机器人+机械臂的移动操作任务，通过分解为参考运动生成和底层模仿控制实现高精度控制。

Research relevance: 1分，与本研究方向基本无关。论文研究的是四足机器人移动操作（loco-manipulation）的全身控制问题，完全不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱/多光谱、空间在轨智能等遥感领域内容，也不涉及目标检测或模型轻量化。

Reading priority: 1分。与"遥感卫星在轨目标检测模型轻量化"研究方向完全无关，不建议阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：四足机器人全身移动操作控制；应用场景：机器人操作；传感器类型：摘要未说明；目标类别：无目标检测任务。

Model architecture: Kinematic Normalizing Flow (KNF) 模型 + 高层控制器（high-level controller）+ 低层控制器（low-level controller）的两级控制框架。

Lightweight method: 摘要未涉及任何轻量化方法（剪枝、量化、蒸馏、NAS、轻量网络等均未提及）。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、显存、能耗等部署相关信息。仅在硬件部署实验中提及在真实四足机器人上运行24个episode，但未给出模型计算开销指标。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：大规模运动学数据集（large-scale kinematic dataset，具体名称未说明）；评价指标：末端执行器位姿跟踪误差（4.5 cm, 0.14 rad）、线速度误差（0.1 m/s）、角速度误差（0.01 rad/s）、跟踪精度、可行工作空间覆盖率。

Experiments: 仿真实验：在四足机器人+六自由度机械臂平台上，优于SOTA方法的跟踪精度和可行工作空间覆盖率；硬件实验：24个episode覆盖8种移动操作任务，末端执行器误差4.5 cm/0.14 rad， locomotion跟踪误差0.1 m/s/0.01 rad/s。

Limitations: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向完全无关，无任何可借鉴的检测或轻量化技术内容。

Ideas for my research: 无借鉴点。该论文属于机器人控制领域，与遥感目标检测和模型轻量化没有交集。

Abstract: Loco-manipulation has recently shown promising capabilities; however, achieving high-precision control, managing the high-dimensional action space induced by many degrees of freedom (DoFs), and fully exploiting the inherent redundancy of whole-body systems remain challenging. In this paper, we propose a novel whole-body control framework that effectively addresses these challenges by decomposing the complex loco-manipulation problem into partial reference motion generation and low-level imitation control. We introduce a new Kinematic Normalizing Flow (KNF) model, trained on a large-scale kinematic dataset, that generates diverse yet feasible partial reference motions. A high-level controller is then trained to navigate the KNF's latent space to exploit redundant solutions, while a low-level controller ensures physically feasible and accurate motion execution. We validate our approach on the quadrupedal robot equipped with a six-DoF robotic arm. In simulation, experimental results show that our approach significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods in terms of tracking accuracy and feasible workspace coverage. For hardware deployment, we evaluate the system over 24 episodes across 8 different mobile loco-manipulation tasks. The system achieves end-effector pose-tracking errors of 4.5 cm and 0.14 rad, while maintaining accurate locomotion tracking with linear and angular velocity errors of 0.1 m/s and 0.01 rad/s, respectively, outperforming competitive baselines. Our method represents a practical and powerful solution for accurate and generalized whole-body loco-manipulation in high-DoF robotic systems, with promising potential for diverse downstream robotic tasks.

</details>


### [338] [Desc++: Efficient Descriptor Enhancement for Data Association in Existing Visual SLAM Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11099)
*Ting-Wei Ou,Huang-Ting Lin,Kuu-Young Young*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出Desc++，一种轻量级描述符增强模块，通过混合全局注意力与几何感知序列建模提升V-SLAM数据关联质量，保持原始描述符维度和接口，可无缝集成到现有实时V-SLAM系统。

Research relevance: 1分，与本研究方向基本无关。论文聚焦于视觉SLAM（V-SLAM）中的描述符增强问题，不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱/多光谱等遥感场景，也不涉及目标检测任务，更不涉及在轨部署或星上智能。虽然提到了"lightweight"和"efficiency"，但这是针对V-SLAM前端计算效率的优化，与遥感在轨目标检测模型轻量化无直接关联。

Reading priority: 1分。与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关，不建议优先阅读。除非对轻量级注意力机制设计有泛化兴趣，否则可忽略。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：视觉SLAM中的描述符匹配/数据关联；应用场景：实时V-SLAM系统（如相机位姿估计、地图构建）；传感器类型：视觉相机；目标类别：不涉及目标检测，关注的是特征点匹配。

Model architecture: Desc++模块：混合架构，结合order-agnostic global attention（无序全局注意力）与geometry-aware sequential modeling（几何感知序列建模），在linear time（线性时间）内完成。输入为描述符表示+关键点几何信息，输出为增强后的描述符，保持原始维度。

Lightweight method: 轻量级描述符增强模块设计，通过混合注意力架构在上下文表达力与计算效率之间取得平衡。但未涉及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS等典型模型压缩方法。摘要未说明具体参数量、FLOPs等轻量化指标。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、显存、能耗等部署相关指标。仅提及"lightweight"和"favorable balance between accuracy and efficiency"，但缺乏量化数据。不涉及星上/边缘部署、FPGA/NPU/TensorRT等硬件适配。

Datasets and metrics: 实验涉及：descriptor matching（描述符匹配）、correspondence analysis（对应点分析）、system-level benchmarks（系统级基准测试），使用四种不同的V-SLAM系统进行评估。摘要未说明具体数据集名称和指标名称。

Experiments: 与state-of-the-art enhancement method对比，Desc++提升了匹配精度，并转化为更准确稳定的轨迹估计。在准确性与效率之间取得了有利平衡。摘要未提供具体数值对比。

Limitations: 1. 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测完全无关，无法直接借鉴；2. 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、延迟等量化效率指标；3. 仅针对V-SLAM描述符增强，不涉及目标检测任务；4. 未讨论在资源受限平台（如星上）的部署可行性。

Ideas for my research: 1. 其"混合全局注意力+几何感知序列建模"的轻量架构设计思路，可尝试迁移到遥感目标检测的轻量骨干网络设计中；2. "保持原始维度与接口，无需修改pipeline即可集成"的设计哲学，对在轨模型升级/替换场景有参考价值；3. 但整体而言，该论文与遥感在轨目标检测轻量化方向弱相关，借鉴价值有限。

Abstract: Reliable visual data association is fundamental to visual SLAM (V-SLAM), as it directly determines the quality of the camera pose estimation and map consistency. However, the handcrafted descriptors used by most mature real-time systems degrade under illumination and viewpoint changes, while learning-based front-ends that address this weakness typically require replacing the extraction-and-matching pipeline and introduce substantial computational overhead. Descriptor enhancement offers a compromise by refining existing descriptors within their original format, yet current methods rely on simplified attention mechanisms whose limited contextual modeling constrains the achievable matching quality. To resolve this trade-off between contextual expressiveness and efficiency, we propose Desc++, a lightweight enhancement module that jointly encodes descriptor representations and keypoint geometry and aggregates spatial context through a hybrid architecture that combines order-agnostic global attention with geometry-aware sequential modeling in linear time. The enhanced descriptors retain their original dimensionality and matching interface, enabling integration into deployed V-SLAM systems without modifying the pipeline. Experiments across descriptor matching, correspondence analysis, and system-level benchmarks with four different V-SLAM systems demonstrate that Desc++ improves matching accuracy over the state-of-the-art enhancement method, translates these gains into more accurate and stable trajectory estimation, and achieves a favorable balance between accuracy and efficiency for practical integration into existing real-time V-SLAM pipelines.

</details>


### [339] [VIA: Visual Interface Agent for Robot Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11119)
*Hengyuan Hu,Priya Sundaresan,Jensen Gao,Dorsa Sadigh*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出VIA框架，将机器人操控任务转化为基于浏览器3D界面的智能体任务，利用现成的基础模型（如Claude Code、Codex）通过截图、指令、观察、调整的闭环方式零样本控制机械臂，无需机器人专用微调。

Research relevance: 1分，与本研究方向基本无关。论文聚焦机器人操控（robot manipulation），不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱/多光谱等任何遥感相关场景；不涉及目标检测任务；不涉及轻量化、剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS、边缘/星上部署等任何模型压缩或加速方法。

Reading priority: 1分。与研究方向基本无关，不建议阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：机器人操控（robot manipulation）、视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型、智能体（agent）控制。应用场景：桌面操控任务（tabletop manipulation）。传感器类型：视觉截图（screenshots）。目标类别：无目标检测相关。

Model architecture: VIA框架基于现成的基础模型（Foundation Models, FMs），如Claude Code和Codex，通过浏览器3D界面进行截图、命令、观察、调整的闭环控制。未设计专用轻量网络结构。

Lightweight method: 不涉及任何轻量化方法。论文未使用剪枝、量化、蒸馏、NAS、轻量网络设计等技术。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗等部署相关信息。且论文面向桌面机器人操控，与星上/边缘部署无关。

Datasets and metrics: 任务：LIBERO-Goal（三个任务）和长时序rainbow assembly任务。指标：成功率（success rate）。LIBERO-Goal上达96.7%，rainbow assembly上达100%。

Experiments: 零样本（zero-shot）测试，使用Claude Code和Codex两种FM作为底层模型。最强模型Fable 5在LIBERO-Goal上达96.7%，在rainbow assembly上达100%。性能随底层模型规模增强而提升。

Limitations: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向完全无关。摘要未讨论遥感场景、目标检测、模型压缩、边缘部署等任何相关话题。

Ideas for my research: 无直接可借鉴点。该论文属于机器人操控领域，与遥感在轨目标检测轻量化课题无交叉。

Abstract: Robot manipulation is a complex task that requires visual understanding, physical reasoning, planning, and closed-loop control. General-purpose foundation models (FMs) have grown remarkably capable of some of these, especially vision and reasoning. To leverage this for generalist robot policies, current methods typically involve converting existing FMs into vision-language-action (VLA) models by fine-tuning on robot data to output low-level actions. However, VLAs are often orders of magnitude smaller than frontier FMs given the limited data and compute available for fine-tuning, which in turn limits their general capability. Inspired by the growing ability of FMs to operate software through visual interfaces, we ask whether that same competence suffices to control a robot. We present VIA (Visual Interface Agent for robot control), a framework that recasts robot control as an agentic task: an off-the-shelf FM-powered agent drives a manipulator through a browser-based 3D interface by taking screenshots, issuing intuitive commands, observing the outcome, and adjusting. The agent receives no robot-specific fine-tuning and no access to privileged state information: it perceives visual input and acts through a small set of general tools. VIA inherits the agent's general reasoning, closed-loop error recovery, and ability to plan and re-plan from what it observes. It solves a diverse suite of tabletop manipulation tasks zero-shot with both Claude Code and Codex. With the strongest model (Fable 5) it achieves 96.7% success on three LIBERO-Goal tasks and 100% on a long-horizon rainbow assembly task. Performance improves with the scale and strength of the underlying model. These results suggest that frontier agents already possess skills that transfer directly to robot control given the right interface: your coding or computer-use agent is, in a sense, secretly a robot-control agent.

</details>


### [340] [Comparison-Based Ordinal Learning for Proactive Driving Risk Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11128)
*Zhuoren Li,Yi Zhong,Weiqi Zhang,Xinrui Zhang,Lu Xiong,Chongfeng Wei,Bo Leng*

Research relevance: 1分，与本研究方向基本无关。论文聚焦于自动驾驶/自然驾驶场景下的**driving risk assessment**（驾驶风险评估），完全不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱/多光谱等遥感领域内容，也不涉及目标检测或模型轻量化。

Reading priority: 1分。与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关，不建议投入阅读时间。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务：实时驾驶风险评估（real-time driving risk assessment）；场景：自然驾驶场景（naturalistic driving）；传感器类型：摘要未说明（推测为车载摄像头/雷达等，但与遥感无关）；目标类别：无目标检测任务。

Model architecture: 提出comparison-based ordinal risk learning框架，包含三种成对比较来源（时序进展、事件级对比、物理反事实扰动），三种风险评分函数参数化方式（直接学习、对齐单代理模型、对齐多代理模型）。具体网络结构摘要未说明。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、显存、延迟、能耗等任何部署相关信息。虽然任务名为"real-time"，但未给出具体推理速度或硬件部署细节。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：100-Car和SHRP2自然驾驶数据集（naturalistic driving datasets）；评价指标：high-recall risk discrimination、warning precision、warning lead time（预警提前时间）；实验设置：分布内（in-distribution）和分布外（out-of-distribution）评估。

Experiments: 在proactive collision warning任务上，所提框架在high-recall风险判别、预警精度和预警提前时间上均优于基于代理模型的基线方法。

Limitations: 1. 完全不涉及遥感/卫星/目标检测/轻量化，与本研究方向无交集；2. 摘要未说明模型复杂度、推理速度等部署关键指标；3. 仅在驾驶场景验证，遥感场景的迁移性未知。

Ideas for my research: 弱相关，借鉴价值有限。可能的间接启发：其"ordinal risk learning"中利用成对比较进行排序学习的思路，如果未来在遥感目标检测中涉及风险排序或异常检测场景（如灾害检测中的危险等级排序），可参考其对比学习框架设计。但与本课题核心方向（遥感在轨目标检测模型轻量化）无直接关联。

Abstract: Real-time driving risk assessment provides an essential basis for proactive safety by identifying and quantifying the danger of ongoing road interactions before adverse outcomes occur. However, due to the scarcity of collision data and frame-level risk labels, existing driving risk assessment methods often rely on surrogate objectives, which may imperfectly align with true collision risk and not faithfully reflect the relative danger of driving interaction. This paper proposes a comparison-based ordinal risk learning framework that learns collision-relevant risk scores from pairwise supervision in driving data, directly modeling relative risk ordering without requiring numerical frame-level risk labels. We derive pairwise comparisons from three sources of event-structured driving data for such ordinal risk learning: temporal progression within safety-critical sequences, event-level contrast between dangerous and normal interactions, and physics-based counterfactual perturbations. On this basis, instantiations with three risk-scoring function parameterizations are implemented, including directly learning risk scores from comparison data, and aligning existing single or multiple surrogate-based risk models. The proposed framework is evaluated on the 100-Car and SHRP2 naturalistic driving datasets using a proactive collision warning task. Results show that the proposed framework improves high-recall risk discrimination, warning precision, and warning lead time over representative surrogate-based baselines across both in-distribution and out-of-distribution evaluations. These results suggest that the proposed framework can contribute to proactive safety research by providing more reliable risk assessment for automated driving systems and safety-critical driving interactions.

</details>


### [341] [Pix2Act: Image-Space Manipulation Policies with Equivariant Augmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11167)
*Haojie Huang,Linfeng Zhao,Haotian Liu,Zhang Ye,Si-Yuan Huang,Mingxi Jia,Boce Hu,Fangzhou Lin,Yu Qi,Dian Wang,Robin Walters,Robert Platt*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: Pix2Act是一种模仿学习方法，通过将3D操作策略表示为相机平面的2D轨迹，并利用三角测量恢复末端执行器位姿，实现多视角融合与旋转等变增强，提升操作任务的泛化能力。

Research relevance: 1分。该论文与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关。论文聚焦于机器人操作（manipulation）领域的模仿学习，涉及2D轨迹预测、三角测量、多视角融合、等变增强等，不涉及遥感图像、卫星、目标检测或模型轻量化。

Reading priority: 1分。与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化研究方向基本无关，不建议优先阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：机器人操作策略的模仿学习（imitation learning）；应用场景：模拟和真实世界的机械臂操作任务；传感器类型：多视角相机（multiple camera views）；目标类别：末端执行器位姿（end-effector poses），非遥感目标。

Model architecture: 摘要未详细说明完整网络架构，但提及设计了一种能够融合多个相机视角并尊重各视角旋转的网络结构（network architecture that can fuse multiple camera views while respecting their per-view rotations），利用等变变换（equivariant transformations）实现数据增强。

Lightweight method: 不涉及。论文未讨论任何轻量化方法（剪枝、量化、蒸馏、NAS、轻量网络等）。

Onboard deployability: 不涉及。摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗等部署相关信息。

Datasets and metrics: 摘要未说明具体数据集名称和评价指标，仅提及在多种模拟和真实世界的操作任务（diverse simulated and real-world manipulation tasks）中进行评估。

Experiments: 在多种模拟和真实操作任务上，Pix2Act优于最先进的基线方法（outperforms state-of-the-art baselines），并且在相机扰动下保持鲁棒（remains robust under camera perturbations）。

Limitations: 摘要未说明局限性。从方向相关性角度看，该论文与遥感卫星在轨目标检测轻量化完全无关，无直接可借鉴的局限性信息。

Ideas for my research: 弱相关，借鉴意义有限。可能的间接启发：1）将高维控制问题降维到2D空间的思想，类比于将遥感高维特征映射到更紧凑的表征空间；2）多视角融合与等变增强策略，在遥感多角度/多时相图像融合中可能有参考价值。但整体上与本课题方向差异较大。

Abstract: Representing manipulation actions as 2D trajectories in the camera plane provides a compact and interpretable basis for learning complex 3D manipulation policies. However, it also creates challenges from out-of-frame trajectories and limited precision. We propose Pix2Act, an imitation learning method that addresses these challenges by generating continuous image-space keypoint trajectories in each camera plane and losslessly recovering end-effector poses via triangulation. This reformulates high-dimensional 3D control as a simpler, more learnable 2D prediction problem. Crucially, it aligns observations and actions in the same coordinate space, enabling equivariant transformations to jointly rotate individual camera images together with their image-space actions. We analyze the symmetry properties of this augmentation and design a network architecture that can fuse multiple camera views while respecting their per-view rotations. As a result, Pix2Act implicitly enlarges the support of the data distribution and learns invariant action structures across transformations, yielding improved generalization and overall performance. Across diverse simulated and real-world manipulation tasks, Pix2Act outperforms state-of-the-art baselines and remains robust under camera perturbations.

</details>

Experiments: 与SOTA方法对比，在渲染质量和跟踪精度上取得更优结果，同时保持在线实时性能。具体对比方法和数值摘要未说明。

Limitations: 1. 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测方向完全无关；2. 未涉及任何目标检测任务；3. 未涉及模型轻量化或边缘/星上部署；4. 需要前馈视觉几何模型提供先验，可能增加计算负担；5. 未说明在资源受限平台上的性能。

Ideas for my research: 借鉴意义极低。唯一可能间接参考的点：3DGS作为一种场景表示方法，若未来研究遥感三维重建或遥感场景理解中的目标检测，可关注其表示效率。但对于"在轨遥感目标检测模型轻量化"这一课题，本文无直接可借鉴内容。

Abstract: SLAM methods based on 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) have demonstrated impressive tracking and mapping performance, but typically require additional geometric information from external depth sensors. Meanwhile, recent SLAM systems that leverage geometric priors from pre-trained feed-forward models enable real-time dense reconstruction, yet often discard original RGB information during optimization, thus degrading overall reconstruction quality. We present GeoGS-SLAM, an online monocular dense reconstruction system that combines the 3DGS-based map representation with learned geometric priors. Given uncalibrated RGB input, we first employ a feed-forward visual geometry model to predict camera and scene priors. The Gaussian scene map is then expanded by directly sampling Gaussian primitives from both RGB input and geometric priors. Camera poses and the scene map are jointly optimized through a coarse-to-fine strategy that minimizes both photometric and geometric losses. To ensure global consistency, we further incorporate online loop closure detection and pose graph optimization. Extensive experiments across indoor and outdoor benchmarks demonstrate that GeoGS-SLAM achieves superior rendering quality and tracking accuracy compared to state-of-the-art methods while maintaining online real-time performance. Project page: https://rlgao.github.io/geogs_slam.

</details>


### [343] [Stop to Decide: Latency-Aware Proprioceptive Navigation Primitives for Mapping-Free Quadruped Inspection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11204)
*Hanting Suo,Haonan Yan,Liang Wang,Aiguo Song*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文研究四足机器人在计算资源受限（Jetson Orin）条件下，因视觉管线导致导航循环速率降低（约15 Hz）而引发的楼梯攀爬检测失败问题，提出一种无地图、无学习的全板载感知堆栈来解决该问题。

Research relevance: 1分。与本研究方向基本无关。论文研究对象是四足机器人（quadruped）的楼梯攀爬导航，不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱/多光谱等任何遥感相关场景；不涉及目标检测、小目标检测、旋转框检测、舰船/飞机/车辆检测等遥感目标检测任务；不涉及轻量化、剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS等模型压缩方法。虽然涉及Jetson Orin板载部署和计算资源受限场景，但这是机器人导航领域的边缘计算问题，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测模型轻量化方向无直接关联。

Reading priority: 1分。与"遥感卫星在轨目标检测与模型轻量化"研究方向基本无关，不建议阅读全文。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务：四足机器人楼梯攀爬导航与检测；场景：室内楼梯、走廊；传感器：IMU、足部力传感器、1D测距传感器、线阵相机；目标：楼梯台阶顶边检测、走廊转角导航。不涉及遥感场景。

Model architecture: 摘要未说明具体模型架构。感知堆栈为全板载、无地图、无学习（learning-free）的管线，包含线跟随（line-following）、三段式机动（three-segment maneuver）等模块。

Lightweight method: 不涉及轻量化方法。虽然运行在Jetson Orin上且面临计算资源受限问题，但本文未采用剪枝、量化、蒸馏、NAS等模型压缩技术，而是通过无学习的传统感知管线来规避深度学习模型的计算开销。

Onboard deployability: 部署平台：Unitree Go2四足机器人，板载Jetson Orin；导航循环速率约15 Hz（受视觉管线拖累）；控制器设计速率高于实际运行速率。但未提供参数量、FLOPs、显存、能耗等量化指标。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：单一课程几何（single course geometry）的实验场景，非公开遥感数据集。评价指标：楼梯顶边检测的过冲概率（overshoot probability）、Fisher精确检验p值、出口航向误差（exit-heading error）、任务完成率（18/20 trials, 90%）。

Experiments: 实验对比了不同循环速率（约30/20/15 Hz）下的过冲概率，爬升-稳定节奏（climb-settle cadence）在15 Hz下过冲接近零（0/15），而运动中检测（in-motion detection）过冲概率为7/15；Fisher p≈2.4e-7。40 Hz离样本测试验证了logistic剂量-响应模型。走廊转角测试中，三段式机动20/20无接触，原地偏航仅14/20成功且有12次墙接触。

Limitations: 1. 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测完全无关；2. 实验仅在单一课程几何、单一平台、单一操作者条件下进行，泛化性未知；3. 未涉及任何深度学习模型或轻量化技术；4. 无公开数据集和代码。

Ideas for my research: 借鉴意义有限。唯一可参考的点是：本文在Jetson Orin上因计算资源受限导致推理速率下降（15 Hz）而引发检测失败，这间接说明了在边缘/星上部署中，推理速度对任务成功率的决定性影响——在轨遥感目标检测同样需要保证足够的推理帧率以避免漏检。但本文未提供任何模型轻量化的具体方法，仅通过传统非学习方法规避深度学习开销，与轻量化模型压缩方向不相关。

Abstract: Compute-constrained quadrupeds often run their navigation loop far below the controller's design rate: sharing the onboard Jetson Orin with the vision pipeline slows our stair loop to about 15 Hz. This latency breaks a standard proprioceptive pattern: declaring stair-summit arrival from the body-pitch signal while still climbing. On a stepped platform whose 50 cm top is shorter than the robot (Unitree Go2, about 75 cm), in-motion detection overshoots the top edge with probability rising with the per-period advance v/f (the slowest about 15 Hz cell partly diluted by a separate non-arrival mode), whereas a climb-settle cadence holds overshoot near zero at every loop rate (pooled 22/45 vs 1/45 over about 30/20/15 Hz; Fisher p about 2.4e-7; 7/15 vs 0/15 at the deployed about 15 Hz). A logistic dose-response model in v/f captures the failure; a pre-specified 40 Hz out-of-sample test favours the protocol-clean fit (33% observed vs 43%/22% predicted), giving a deployment rule (critical loop rate about 19 Hz at 0.30 m/s). The detector sits in a fully onboard, mapping-free and learning-free stack: built-in inertial measurement unit, four foot-force channels, three 1-D ranges, one line camera, chaining line-following, a three-segment maneuver for 90-degree corners in a 55 cm corridor (20/20 contact-free vs 14/20 with 12 wall contacts for in-place yaw; exit-heading error 1.56 degrees vs 5.64 degrees), and stair traversal, completing the inspection course in 18/20 trials (90%). Results are from a single course geometry, platform, and operator.

</details>


### [344] [Towards Predictive, Aligned, and Scalable Robot Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11270)
*Peijun Tang,Shangjin Xie,Baifu Huang,Binyan Sun,Haotian Yang,Kuncheng Luo,Weiqi Jin,Shilin Fang,Jianan Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出Lumo-2潜在世界-动作模型，通过潜空间推理和跨模态对齐提升具身智能控制性能，不涉及遥感或目标检测。

Research relevance: 1分，与本研究方向基本无关。论文聚焦具身智能（embodied intelligence）、机器人操控（manipulation）、潜空间推理（latent world-action model），完全不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱/多光谱等遥感场景，也不涉及目标检测或模型轻量化部署。

Reading priority: 1分，与"遥感卫星在轨目标检测与模型轻量化"方向基本无关，不建议投入时间精读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：具身智能控制、机器人操控（manipulation）；应用场景：long-horizon and dexterous manipulation（长时序和灵巧操控）；传感器类型：摘要未说明；目标类别：摘要未说明。

Model architecture: Lumo-2：latent world-action model（潜在世界-动作模型），包含latent world dynamics（潜在世界动力学）、cross-modal alignment（跨模态对齐）、multi-stage modality pre-alignment strategy（多阶段模态预对齐策略）。

Lightweight method: 摘要中仅提到"lightweight and focused on physical dynamics relevant to control"，但未给出具体轻量化方法（如剪枝、量化、蒸馏、NAS等），也未给出参数量、FLOPs等量化指标。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗等部署相关信息。虽然提到"lightweight"，但缺乏具体数据支撑，且面向的是机器人控制而非星上部署。

Datasets and metrics: 摘要未说明具体数据集名称；评价指标：downstream control performance（下游控制性能）、out-of-distribution generalization（分布外泛化能力）。

Experiments: 与VLA（vision-language-action）和WAM（world-action model）基线对比，在长时序和灵巧操控等复杂任务上取得更优性能。分析了scaling laws和out-of-distribution generalization。

Limitations: 1. 完全不涉及遥感/卫星场景；2. 不涉及目标检测任务；3. 轻量化仅停留在定性描述，无量化指标；4. 面向机器人操控，与在轨遥感目标检测的领域差距极大。

Ideas for my research: 弱相关，借鉴意义有限。潜在可参考点：跨模态对齐策略（multi-stage modality pre-alignment）的思路或许可迁移到遥感多模态（光学-SAR融合）特征对齐中，但需要大量改造；潜空间推理（latent space reasoning）的思想对遥感目标检测中的特征表示学习有一定启发，但非直接相关。

Abstract: Learning, at its core, extends beyond memorization to the ability to reason and solve novel problems by navigating a space of possibilities. We introduce Lumo-2, a latent world-action model that generates actions by reasoning over world dynamics in latent space. The learned latent world dynamics capture physically grounded visual transitions, naturally encoding future possibilities and providing a unified substrate for cross-modal alignment. This formulation enables predictive reasoning akin to world modelling while remaining lightweight and focused on physical dynamics relevant to control. Central to our approach is the hypothesis that action generation quality is governed by the geometry of the latent space. We observe that standard reconstruction-based action tokenization objectives induce representations biased toward low-level signal fidelity, leading to misalignment between reconstruction quality and downstream control performance. To address this limitation, we propose a multi-stage modality pre-alignment strategy in which action representations are progressively aligned with latent world dynamics, vision, and language. This process enforces cross-modal consistency, promotes abstraction, and induces a structured latent space for predictive reasoning. We provide a systematic empirical study of latent world modelling and modality alignment, analyzing their roles in scaling laws and out-of-distribution generalization. Results show that Lumo-2 consistently outperforms strong vision-language-action (VLA) and world-action model (WAM) baselines, with gains on challenging real-world tasks requiring temporal reasoning, physical understanding, or high control complexity, including long-horizon and dexterous manipulation. These findings suggest that structured multimodal alignment and predictive reasoning are fundamental principles for advancing embodied intelligence.

</details>


### [345] [CR-Solver: GPU-Accelerated Kinematics Solver for Tendon-driven Continuum Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11340)
*Heqing Yang,Yang Yi,Linqing Zhong,Linjiang Huang,Si Liu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出了一种面向连续体机器人的两阶段优化求解器CR-Solver，利用GPU加速并行优化实现运动生成，在纯Python中实现毫米级精度和95%以上成功率。

Research relevance: 1分，与本研究方向基本无关。该论文研究连续体机器人（continuum robots）的运动规划与优化求解，完全不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、目标检测或模型轻量化等核心主题。

Reading priority: 1分。与研究方向完全无关，不建议阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：连续体机器人运动生成（逆运动学、路径跟踪、轨迹规划）；应用场景：受限和非结构化环境中的导航与操作；传感器类型：摘要未说明；目标类别：不涉及目标检测。

Model architecture: 两阶段优化求解器CR-Solver，基于约束非线性优化框架，GPU加速并行优化，纯Python实现。

Lightweight method: 不涉及轻量化方法。虽然使用了GPU加速，但这是针对机器人运动规划的计算加速，与模型剪枝、量化、蒸馏、NAS等轻量化技术无关。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、显存、延迟、能耗等部署信息。虽然提到GPU加速和纯Python实现，但这是针对地面机器人系统的计算加速，与星上/边缘部署无关。

Datasets and metrics: 在三个任务上验证；评价指标：成功率（>95%）、毫米级精度、速度提升（相比传统CPU求解器）。

Experiments: 在三个任务上验证，相比传统CPU求解器有显著加速，成功率>95%，毫米级精度。

Limitations: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向完全无关，无任何可借鉴的轻量化或目标检测方法。

Ideas for my research: 无借鉴点。该论文属于机器人运动规划领域，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测模型轻量化课题无任何交集。

Abstract: Continuum robots provide intrinsic compliance, high dexterity, and safe physical interaction, enabling navigation and manipulation in confined and unstructured environments. Despite recent advances in sensing and control, heightening the need for precise motion generation, most widely used planning libraries are grounded in rigid-body assumptions, creating a critical gap for fast and practical tools for continuum robots. To address this, we present CR-Solver, a two-stage, optimization-based solver for the motion generation of tendon-driven continuum robots. Our method unifies inverse kinematics, path following, and trajectory planning within a single constrained nonlinear optimization framework. Leveraging GPU-accelerated parallel optimization, CR-Solver delivers fast, accurate, and constraint-aware solutions. We validate our approach on three tasks, demonstrating significant speedups over traditional CPU-based solvers while achieving a consistently high success rate above 95% and millimeter-level accuracy. The solver is implemented in pure Python, reducing the barrier to adoption and offering a practical, extensible foundation for continuum robots' high-performance motion planning.

</details>


### [346] [A Glimpse into Long-term Physical Coexistence with Intelligent Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11377)
*Weiqi Jin,Peijun Tang,Kuncheng Luo,Baifu Huang,Binyan Sun,Haotian Yang,Shangjin Xie,Jianan Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出PHILIA，一个基于机器人网关抽象的多机器人智能体系统，专注于人机交互、长期记忆和多机器人协调，与遥感卫星目标检测及轻量化完全无关。

Research relevance: 1分。该论文完全不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱、多光谱、空间在轨智能等任何遥感相关主题；不涉及目标检测、小目标检测、旋转框检测、遥感场景理解；不涉及轻量化、剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS、实时推理、边缘部署、星上部署、FPGA/NPU/TensorRT等任何模型压缩或部署技术。论文聚焦于家用服务机器人场景下的多机器人智能体系统架构设计，属于人机交互与机器人学领域。

Reading priority: 1分。与研究方向完全无关，不建议阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：多机器人智能体系统架构设计；应用场景：家庭服务机器人（如整理物品、打包背包、提垃圾袋等）；传感器类型：摘要未说明；目标类别：无目标检测任务。

Model architecture: PHILIA系统基于机器人网关（robot gateway）抽象，将低频高语义的智能体推理与高频低层的机器人执行解耦，支持用户界面、机器人本体和策略后端的即插即用集成。

Lightweight method: 不涉及任何模型轻量化方法。

Onboard deployability: 不涉及星上/边缘部署。摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗、实时性等部署相关信息。

Datasets and metrics: 摘要未说明具体数据集和评价指标。在Astribot S1机器人上验证，展示代表性用例（整理、打包背包、提垃圾袋等）。

Experiments: 在Astribot S1机器人上验证架构，展示多场景人机交互用例，但未提供定量实验结果或对比方法。

Limitations: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向完全无关，无任何可借鉴的技术细节。摘要未说明模型推理效率、参数量、计算量等关键信息。

Ideas for my research: 无借鉴点。该论文属于机器人系统架构设计，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测模型轻量化课题的研究范畴（遥感图像目标检测、模型压缩、星上部署）无任何交集。

Abstract: Long-term physical coexistence with intelligent robots requires more than capable robot policies. A persistent robotic assistant must support diverse user-facing interfaces, maintain long-horizon memory of people and preferences, coordinate across robot embodiments, and translate human intent into safe physical execution. We introduce PHILIA, a multi-robot agent built around a robot gateway abstraction. PHILIA retains the rich interaction and tool ecosystem of OpenClaw while exposing robot-local runtimes, onboard perception, navigation, speaker, and robot policies through a unified capability interface. This design decouples low-frequency, high-semantic agent reasoning from high-frequency, low-level robot execution, enabling plug-and-play integration of user interfaces, robot embodiments, and policy backends. As a result, the user experience becomes compositional: advances in user interfaces, robot embodiments, robot policies, navigation, or interaction algorithms can improve the overall experience without redesigning the system. We validate the architecture on Astribot S1 robots while designing the robot gateway contract to support future heterogeneous robot platforms through a shared capability interface for observation, task execution, navigation, speech playback, status monitoring, and task cancellation. We present representative use cases in which agent memory and scene understanding are grounded in robot actions. These span interactive household scenarios, ranging from simple organization to challenging long-horizon and dexterous service tasks, such as packing a backpack and lifting a garbage bag. We highlight the human-robot interaction flow, where contextual understanding of user intent and preferences, together with human-in-the-loop confirmation or adjustment during execution, is essential for effective assistance.

</details>


### [347] [From Sketch Prior to Trajectories: A Mission-Oriented Coordinated Navigation Framework for Indoor UAV Swarm](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11386)
*Xinhang Xu,Ruiyang Liu,Haotian Jin,Yi Wang,Hongming Shen,Jianping Li,Lihua Xie*

Experiments: 在结构化多室内环境中验证了所提框架的有效性；在通信可用和通信丢失条件下均验证了协同导航能力；多楼层仿真结果展示了系统对分层室内结构的可扩展性。

Limitations: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向完全无关，无法提供该方向上的技术参考。论文本身局限性：仅适用于结构化室内环境，依赖预部署草图先验，未讨论未知环境或动态障碍物场景。

Ideas for my research: 该论文与"在轨遥感目标检测模型轻量化"课题无直接可借鉴点。不涉及遥感图像处理、目标检测、模型压缩或星上部署等核心内容。

Abstract: UAV swarm for applications, such as indoor inspection, security patrol, and logistics delivery, are often mission-oriented rather than exploration-oriented. In these tasks, UAVs are required to visit task-relevant regions in a prescribed sequence, and such region-level mission information can often be obtained from pre-deployment sketch-map priors, such as floor plans, CAD layouts, or evacuation diagrams. Although these tasks are executed in three-dimensional space, UAVs usually fly within a specific altitude layer or a nearly fixed altitude range on each floor, making mission-level region transitions mainly governed by planar connectivity. Based on these observations, this paper proposes a mission-oriented coordinated navigation framework that exploits sketch-map priors for multi-UAV indoor operations. Onboard observations are used to perform topological alignment, and the aligned prior is fused with online observations to construct a mission-oriented traversability representation. A layered 2D--3D coordinated navigation framework is further developed, where 2D guided path planning generates mission-oriented guide paths and guide-driven 3D trajectory optimization produces dynamically feasible and collision-free trajectories. Simulation and real-world experiments validate the effectiveness of the proposed framework in structured multi-room indoor environments and further demonstrate its coordinated navigation capability under both communication-available and communication-loss conditions. Multi-floor simulation results show the scalability of the system to layered indoor structures.

</details>


### [348] [WALA Learning Executable Latent Actions from Action-Labeled Demonstrations and Action-Free Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11397)
*Jiahao Liu,Zhongpu Xia,Shuai Tian,Huangrui Li,Yuhang Zheng,Ning Ma,Xin Fu,Xiaotian Liu,Jing Li,Yixian Li,ShangQing Zhou,Zebin Xing,Linbo Wang,Chaoyue Li,Haoran Li,Dongbin Zhao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出WALA框架，利用人类/机器人视频中的语义-几何潜在动作模型，通过DINOv3特征空间和深度空间预测未来变化，实现从无动作标签视频中学习可执行动作策略。

Research relevance: 1分，与本研究方向基本无关。该论文聚焦于机器人操作策略的通用化学习，涉及human/robot videos、manipulation tasks、latent action model，完全不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱/多光谱等遥感场景，也不涉及目标检测或轻量化部署。

Reading priority: 1分。与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向完全无关，不建议阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：机器人操作策略学习（robot policy learning）；应用场景：RoboTwin、RoboCasa、真实世界操作任务；传感器类型：RGB相机、深度相机；目标类别：机器人操作物体（非遥感目标）。

Model architecture: WALA框架包含：语义-几何潜在动作模型（semantic-geometric latent action model），基于DINOv3特征空间和密集深度空间预测未来变化；编码器提供潜在动作目标，解码器作为可训练的潜在世界模型；视觉-语言骨干网络生成潜在动作。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明任何轻量化方法（无剪枝、量化、蒸馏、NAS、轻量网络设计等）。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗、实时性等部署相关信息。该工作面向机器人策略学习，非星上/边缘部署场景。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：RoboTwin、RoboCasa、真实世界操作任务；评价指标：平均成功率（average success），在RoboCasa上达到75.2%。

Experiments: 在RoboTwin上表现强劲，在RoboCasa上达到75.2%平均成功率，在真实世界操作任务中提升了策略性能和泛化能力。

Limitations: 摘要未说明局限性。与遥感在轨目标检测完全无关，无任何可迁移的遥感相关技术点。

Ideas for my research: 弱相关，借鉴价值极低。唯一可能的技术启发是：DINOv3特征空间用于预测未来变化的思想，在遥感视频时序目标检测中可能有潜在借鉴意义，但论文本身未涉及遥感场景，且核心是机器人操作策略而非检测任务。

Abstract: Generalizable robot policies typically rely on action-labeled robot demonstrations, which are expensive to collect and difficult to scale. In contrast, large-scale human and robot videos contain rich physical interactions but often lack executable robot action labels. We present WALA, a framework for learning executable latent actions from both action-labeled demonstrations and action-free videos. WALA first pretrains a semantic-geometric latent action model from videos by modeling the evolution between current observations and sparsely sampled future observations. Instead of reconstructing raw pixels, WALA predicts future deltas in the DINOv3 feature space and dense depth space, preserving task-relevant semantic and geometric structure while reducing sensitivity to appearance details. During policy training, the pretrained encoder provides stable latent action targets, and the decoder serves as a trainable latent world model. The latent actions generated by the vision-language backbone are jointly supervised by robot action prediction, latent action target matching, and future dynamics prediction. This enables action-labeled demonstrations to provide executable control supervision, while action-free videos contribute dynamics supervision without requiring robot action annotations. Experiments show that WALA achieves strong performance on RoboTwin, sets a new state-of-the-art result on RoboCasa with 75.2% average success, and improves both policy performance and generalization in real-world manipulation tasks.

</details>


### [349] [EDAR: Learning Environment-Dependent Action Representations for Robotic Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11427)
*Yuecheng Xu,Tong Yang,Jingkai Jia,Chi Zhang,Xuelong Li,Wenqiang Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种环境依赖的动作表示方法EDAR，将动作令牌与可执行控制结构和预期视觉后果耦合，用于机器人操作策略学习。

Research relevance: 1分，与本研究方向基本无关。该论文聚焦于机器人操作（robotic manipulation）中的动作表示学习，不涉及遥感、卫星、目标检测或模型轻量化中的任何一个核心要素。

Reading priority: 1分，与研究方向基本无关，不建议阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：机器人操作策略学习（robotic manipulation policy learning）；应用场景：模拟和真实机器人操作；传感器类型：摘要未说明；目标类别：机器人动作段（action segments），非遥感目标。

Model architecture: EDAR（Environment-Dependent Action Representation），将动作令牌（action tokens）与可执行控制结构（executable control structure）和环境条件视觉变化（environment-conditioned visual change）耦合。

Lightweight method: 摘要未涉及任何轻量化方法（剪枝、量化、蒸馏、NAS、轻量网络等均未提及）。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗、实时性等任何部署相关信息。

Datasets and metrics: 模拟和真实机器人操作基准（simulated and real-robot manipulation benchmarks）；评价指标：下游策略学习性能（downstream policy learning improvement），尤其在长时域操作（long-horizon manipulation）上。

Experiments: 在模拟和真实机器人操作基准上验证，EDAR改进了下游策略学习，尤其在长时域操作任务中表现突出。摘要未提供具体数值对比或消融实验细节。

Limitations: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化完全无关，无任何可迁移的技术细节。摘要未讨论计算效率、模型大小、推理速度等关键部署指标。

Ideas for my research: 无直接借鉴点。该论文属于机器人学/具身智能领域，与遥感在轨目标检测轻量化在问题设定、数据模态、评价指标、部署约束上均无交集。

Abstract: Learning effective action representations is critical for robotic manipulation, where raw control trajectories are often noisy, redundant, and difficult to model directly. Existing methods mainly encode the structure of the action stream itself, treating the role of actions in the environment as implicit. Yet manipulation is about changing the world: the same action segment can induce different outcomes under different scene contexts, making action semantics inherently environment-dependent. We propose EDAR, an Environment-Dependent Action Representation that grounds action tokens in both executable control structure and expected visual consequences. By coupling motor commands with their environment-conditioned effects, EDAR encourages the learned action space to capture interaction semantics rather than merely command-level patterns. Experiments on simulated and real-robot manipulation benchmarks demonstrate that EDAR improves downstream policy learning, especially in long-horizon manipulation. These results highlight the importance of grounding action representations in executable control structure and environment-conditioned visual change.

</details>


### [350] [Towards Human-level Dexterous Teleoperation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11481)
*Puhao Li,Zeyuan Chen,Yingying Wu,Pengkun Wei,Yuyang Li,Tianyu Wang,Jiaxiao Shi,Mingrui Yu,Baoxiong Jia,Song-chun Zhu,Tengyu Liu,Siyuan Huang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出TeleDexter手-物协同跟踪控制器，通过单阶段强化学习实现灵巧手遥操作，在7项灵巧操作任务上达到75%平均成功率。

Research relevance: 1分，与本研究方向基本无关。论文聚焦机器人灵巧手遥操作（dexterous teleoperation），不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱/多光谱等遥感领域，也不涉及目标检测或模型轻量化。

Reading priority: 1分。与研究方向基本无关，不建议阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：灵巧手遥操作（dexterous teleoperation）；应用场景：机器人操作；传感器类型：未说明；目标类别：物体重定向、工具使用。与遥感目标检测无关。

Model architecture: 手-物协同跟踪控制器（hand-object co-tracking controller），采用单阶段强化学习（single-stage RL），随机动作掩码（random action masking）和域随机化（domain randomization）。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明任何轻量化方法（无剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS、轻量网络等）。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗等部署相关信息。仅提到zero-shot迁移到真实机器人，但未涉及星上/边缘部署。

Datasets and metrics: 评估任务：7项灵巧遥操作任务（物体重定向、长时序工具使用）；评价指标：平均成功率（average success rate），达到75%；对比基线：所有基线均失败（all baselines consistently fail）。

Experiments: 在两种灵巧手上评估7项任务，平均成功率75%；收集的演示通过行为克隆（behavioral cloning）成功训练自主策略。

Limitations: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向完全无关，无任何可借鉴的检测方法、轻量化技术或部署方案。

Ideas for my research: 无借鉴点。该论文属于机器人灵巧操作领域，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测模型轻量化课题无任何交集。

Abstract: Humans routinely wield tools, swap grasps, and reposition objects within a single hand, seamlessly orchestrating contact transitions that span translation, reorientation, and finger gaiting. Endowing robot dexterous hands with this level of in-hand dexterity through teleoperation requires precise control of object motion via dynamic hand-object contact, yet current teleoperation systems remain far from this capability. To bridge this gap, we take a major step towards human-level dexterous teleoperation by introducing TeleDexter, a hand-object co-tracking controller that maps operator intent into learned, low-level contact execution. The controller is trained on consecutive co-tracking subgoals derived from human reference motions, utilizing a hybrid reward that couples sparse subgoal objectives with dense tracking rewards to enable learning across diverse interaction modalities rather than frame-wise trajectory imitation. The entire pipeline requires only single-stage RL and, with random action masking and domain randomization, transfers zero-shot to the real robot. We evaluate TeleDexter on seven challenging dexterous teleoperation tasks spanning object reorientation and long-horizon tool use across two dexterous hands, achieving a 75% average success rate where all baselines consistently fail. Furthermore, the collected demonstrations successfully train autonomous policies via behavioral cloning, marking a concrete step towards human-level dexterous teleoperation.

</details>


### [351] [See like a Robot: Robot-Centric Pointmaps for Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11498)
*Byungkun Lee,Dongyoon Hwang,Dongjin Kim,Hojoon Lee,Minho Park,Jaegul Choo*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出robot-centric pointmaps，将3D机器人坐标系坐标编码到图像像素中，解决VLA模型观测视角与动作坐标系不匹配的问题，提升跨视角泛化能力。

Research relevance: 1分。该论文聚焦于机器人操控领域的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，解决的是机器人坐标系与相机坐标系之间的视角不匹配问题，与遥感卫星、Earth observation、目标检测、模型轻量化完全无关。

Reading priority: 1分。与"遥感卫星在轨目标检测模型轻量化"研究方向基本无关，不建议阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：机器人动作预测（VLA模型）；应用场景：机器人操控（RoboCasa仿真+真实机器人实验）；传感器类型：RGB相机；目标类别：无目标检测任务。

Model architecture: 基于pi0.5和SmolVLA等预训练2D VLA模型，引入robot-centric pointmaps作为额外输入通道，将3D坐标编码为H×W图像格式，保持与预训练2D架构兼容。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明任何轻量化方法（剪枝、量化、蒸馏、NAS等均未涉及）。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗等部署相关信息。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：RoboCasa（仿真）；评价指标：摘要未明确说明具体指标名称；实验设置：仿真实验+真实机器人实验。

Experiments: 在RoboCasa上，pointmaps提升了pi0.5和SmolVLA的性能，优于代表性相机视角方法和3D感知基线方法。真实机器人实验中，当相机移动到训练时未见过的位置时，pointmaps相比纯RGB策略优势更明显。

Limitations: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向完全无关，无任何可借鉴的遥感相关技术点。

Ideas for my research: 弱相关，基本无可借鉴点。唯一可能的技术思路是"将3D坐标编码为图像格式以兼容预训练2D架构"这一思想，但遥感目标检测通常不需要机器人坐标系转换，且该论文未涉及轻量化。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models predict robot actions from visual observations and language instructions. These actions are defined in the robot's own 3D coordinate frame, yet most VLAs observe the scene in the camera frame, creating a frame mismatch between where the scene is observed and where actions are defined. The mismatch is benign under a fixed viewpoint, where the policy can memorize a single observation-to-action mapping, but grows harder as large-scale datasets aggregate demonstrations across diverse camera setups and the policy must generalize this mapping across viewpoints. We address this mismatch with robot-centric pointmaps, images whose pixels store the 3D coordinates of scene points in the robot frame. Pointmaps provide robot-frame 3D geometry while preserving the dense H x W grid expected by pretrained 2D VLAs, so they integrate into existing VLAs with minimal architectural change. On RoboCasa, pointmaps improve both pi0.5 and SmolVLA and outperform representative camera-viewpoint and 3D-aware baselines. In real-robot experiments, their advantage over an RGB-only policy widens when the camera is moved to a placement unseen during training.

</details>


### [352] [ERR@HRI 3.0 Challenge: Multimodal Detection of Errors and Anticipation in Human-Robot Interactions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11570)
*Maria Teresa Parreira,Micol Spitale,Maia Stiber,Shiye Cao,Amama Mahmood,Chien-Ming Huang,Hatice Gunes,Wendy Ju*

TL;DR: 本文介绍第三届人机交互错误检测挑战赛(ERR@HRI 3.0)的数据集、任务、基线方法和结果，聚焦于人类-机器人交互中的错误检测与预防。

Research relevance: 1分，与本研究方向基本无关。论文完全不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱、多光谱等遥感领域内容；不涉及目标检测任务；不涉及模型轻量化方法。属于人机交互(HRI)领域的错误检测挑战赛，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测模型轻量化方向无直接关联。

Reading priority: 1分。与遥感卫星在轨目标检测模型轻量化研究方向基本无关，不建议阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：人机交互中的错误检测与预防（bystander reaction detection, anticipatory outcome prediction）；应用场景：人类-机器人交互；传感器类型：webcam视频数据；目标类别：人类面部反应、行为预测。与遥感目标检测无关。

Model architecture: 摘要未说明具体模型架构，仅提及参赛团队使用了multimodal machine learning models，且所有模型超过了convolutional neural network baselines。

Lightweight method: 摘要未涉及任何轻量化方法（剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS、轻量网络等）。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗、实时性等部署相关信息。且应用场景为地面人机交互，非星上/边缘部署。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：Bystander Affect Detection (BAD) dataset（45名参与者webcam录制）、Bad Idea dataset（29名参与者面部反应）；评价指标：摘要未说明具体指标；实验设置：三个赛道（Track 1: bystander reaction detection, Track 2: anticipatory outcome prediction, Track 3: cross-dataset generalization）。

Experiments: 三支队伍提交了有效模型，均超过了CNN基线。摘要未提供具体数值结果。

Limitations: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测轻量化方向完全无关，无任何可借鉴的技术细节。数据集规模小（45/29人），且为webcam视频数据，与遥感图像特性差异巨大。

Ideas for my research: 无直接可借鉴点。该论文属于人机交互领域，不涉及遥感图像处理、目标检测或模型轻量化技术。

Abstract: As robots become increasingly integrated into human environments, their ability to detect and respond to errors remains critical for maintaining user trust and interaction quality. While recent advances in machine learning have improved error detection capabilities, most approaches are limited to specific contexts, controlled settings, or pre-extracted features, limiting their generalizability and applicability to real-world conditions. To address this challenge, the third edition of the ERR@HRI Challenge (ERR@HRI 3.0) provided researchers with two complementary datasets that enable end-to-end innovation in methods for both detecting and preventing errors in human-robot interaction. The challenge offered raw, non-anonymized video data from naturalistic settings: (1) the Bystander Affect Detection (BAD) dataset, containing webcam recordings of 45 participants' spontaneous reactions to robot and human failure scenarios; and (2) the Bad Idea dataset, featuring 29 participants' anticipatory facial responses while predicting action outcomes before failures occur. Both datasets were collected via crowdsourcing, capturing the inherent variability of real-world conditions. This naturalistic variability, while challenging, provides an authentic testbed for developing robust error detection systems. Participants developed multimodal machine learning models for bystander reaction detection (Track 1) and anticipatory outcome prediction (Track 2), with an optional cross-dataset generalization track (Track 3). Three teams submitted valid models, all of which surpassed our convolutional neural network baselines. This paper describes the datasets, tasks, baselines, and results of ERR@HRI 3.0, and discusses implications for building generalizable, context-aware, and anticipatory error detection systems for human-robot interaction.

</details>


### [353] [WarpMPC: Large-Batch MPC on GPU via ADMM with Unrolled $LDL^\top$ Factorization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11603)

Datasets and metrics: 基准测试：非线性cartpole、quadrotor、humanoid机器人控制问题；指标：SQP迭代吞吐量（iterations/second），与基线方法对比加速比（3×-25×）。

Experiments: 在三个机器人控制基准上验证，吞吐量达8,000-250,000 SQP迭代/秒，优于基线3-25倍。还展示了在4分钟内合成数据集并训练神经网络近似MPC，用于纳米四旋翼硬件实验。

Limitations: 与遥感在轨目标检测完全无关。论文未涉及任何视觉任务、遥感场景理解或模型压缩技术。其数值优化方法对深度学习模型轻量化无直接参考价值。

Ideas for my research: 弱相关。唯一可能的间接借鉴点是：论文使用JAX框架进行GPU加速计算，JAX的自动微分和XLA编译能力在遥感模型训练加速中可能有参考价值，但与本课题核心方向（目标检测模型轻量化）关联极弱。

Abstract: This paper introduces numerical optimizations for maximizing throughput on GPU when solving large batches (10,000 to over 100,000) of sequential quadratic programming (SQP) iterations, where all problems have the same structure. The optimizations are implemented in a toolbox WarpMPC for model-predictive control (MPC) in JAX and Warp. Based on the insight that all MPC problem instances in a batch share the same sparsity in time, cost, and constraints, we propose unrolling sparse linear factorizations and solves, which dominate alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) solver runtime. We avoid memory access bottlenecks and wasting computations via optimized memory layout, padding-reducing segmentation of the unrolled factorization, and dependency level scheduled backsolves, additionally accelerating sensitivity computation. We achieve throughputs of 8,000 to 250,000 SQP iterations per second on nonlinear cartpole, quadrotor, and humanoid robot benchmarks, outperforming baselines by 3$\times$ to 25$\times$. We illustrate practical usefulness by synthesizing a dataset and training a neural network approximation of an MPC in under 4 minutes that stabilizes a nano quadrotor in hardware experiments.

</details>


### [354] [SKooP: Symmetric Koopman Predictions for Faster and More Generalizable Legged Robot Locomotion with Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11624)
*Evelyn D'Elia,Weishu Zhan,Giulio Turrisi,Giulio Romualdi,Giuseppe L'Erario,Raffaello Camoriano,Wei Pan,Daniele Pucci*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出SKooP方法，结合形态对称性与Koopman模型（通过自编码器学习）来提升强化学习策略的样本效率，在四足机器人双足运动任务上验证。

Research relevance: 1分。与本研究方向基本无关。论文聚焦机器人运动控制的强化学习样本效率问题，完全不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、目标检测或模型轻量化。

Reading priority: 1分。与研究方向基本无关，不建议投入时间阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：强化学习策略学习（机器人运动控制）；应用场景：四足机器人双足运动；传感器类型：不涉及遥感传感器；目标类别：不涉及目标检测。摘要未说明任何遥感相关场景。

Model architecture: SKooP框架：Koopman模型（通过自编码器学习系统动力学）+ 策略网络（actor-critic架构）；在actor、critic、encoder、decoder网络中均引入群对称性（group symmetries）以实现等变策略（equivariant policy）。

Lightweight method: 摘要未涉及任何轻量化方法（剪枝、量化、蒸馏、NAS、轻量网络等）。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗等部署相关信息。不涉及星上/边缘部署。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：四足机器人双足运动仿真环境（具体名称摘要未说明）；评价指标：收敛时间（convergence time）、累计奖励（learned reward）。

Experiments: 在多个具有挑战性的四足机器人双足运动任务上验证，SKooP一致地减少了收敛时间并提高了奖励。还验证了学到的策略可迁移到不同仿真环境。对学到的Koopman模型和对称策略进行了深入分析。

Limitations: 与遥感在轨目标检测及轻量化方向完全无关，无任何可参考的轻量化或目标检测技术。仅在机器人仿真环境验证，未涉及真实硬件部署。

Ideas for my research: 无直接可借鉴点。该论文属于机器人强化学习领域，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测模型轻量化课题无交叉。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms classically suffer from poor sample efficiency. In robotics, a recent line of work has emerged addressing this problem by encoding physics priors in the learning process. However, most of these approaches are validated on well-defined, low-dimensional benchmark systems rather than high-dimensional robots with complex nonlinear dynamics. In this paper, we introduce \textit{SKooP (Symmetric Koopman Predictions)}, an approach combining the advantages of morphological symmetries with those of a Koopman model learned via autoencoder to enhance policy learning. SKooP learns a Koopman model of the system dynamics alongside the policy. The resulting Koopman predictions are used as privileged observations for the critic, allowing the agent to learn based on smoother, more informative features. We also incorporate group symmetries into the actor, critic, encoder and decoder networks to produce a highly equivariant policy. The SKooP approach is validated via in-depth analysis of the learned Koopman models and symmetric policies to showcase how each of these influences the agent's performance. We also show that the learned policies are transferable to different simulation environments. Our results show that SKooP consistently reduces convergence time and increases the learned reward for multiple challenging bipedal locomotion tasks on a quadruped robot. Project page: https://evelyd.github.io/SymmetricKoopmanPredictions/

</details>

*Yuga Yano,Yuki Okafuji,Ryo Miyoshi,Sanae Yamashita,Yoshiki Ohira*

Limitations: 与遥感在轨目标检测轻量化方向完全无关，无任何可借鉴的技术细节。摘要未说明模型效率、参数量、推理速度等关键信息。

Ideas for my research: 弱相关，基本无可借鉴点。唯一可能的泛化思路是：多模态融合（视觉+语言）在资源受限场景下的协同设计思路，但论文本身未涉及轻量化，且场景差异过大。

Abstract: Service robots in retail stores increasingly rely on cascaded speech pipelines (STT-LLM-TTS), yet many customer-robot interactions are initiated or guided by nonverbal behaviors such as approaching, waving, pointing, or showing items. This paper studies such cues in a real-world store deployment with a teleoperated humanoid robot and shows that a non-negligible portion of robot turns are triggered by nonverbal behaviors rather than spoken input, revealing a limitation of audio-only dialogue systems. In a 6-day in-the-wild deployment, 15.3\% of robot utterances were initiated by users' nonverbal behaviors rather than spoken input. Based on an analysis of observed customer behaviors, we define a set of frequent, service-relevant nonverbal cues and develop a real-time multi-person, multi-label recognizer that runs online from video. We then propose a dialogue framework that conditions LLM-based utterance generation on recognized nonverbal cue tokens, and optionally leverages a vision-language model when items are shown, enabling proactive robot responses without hand-crafted rules. We evaluate the approach offline on nonverbal-triggered turns and demonstrate an online prototype that reacts to users' nonverbal cues in real time.

</details>


### [356] [DA-Nav: Direction-Aware City-Scale Vision-Language Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11638)
*Ye Yuan,Kehan Chen,Xinqiang Yu,Wentao Xu,Heng Wang,Libo Huang,Chuanguang Yang,Yan Huang,Jiawei He,Zhulin An*

TL;DR: 提出DA-Nav，一种利用商业导航方向指令的视觉-语言导航框架，通过链式推理实现城市级户外导航与轨迹恢复，在CARLA仿真和真实机器人上验证。

Research relevance: 1分，与本研究方向基本无关。论文聚焦于城市级户外机器人导航（vision-language navigation），不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱/多光谱等遥感核心要素；不涉及目标检测任务；不涉及模型轻量化、剪枝、量化、蒸馏、边缘部署等压缩加速方法。

Reading priority: 1分。与"遥感卫星在轨目标检测模型轻量化"课题方向基本无关，不建议投入时间精读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：视觉-语言导航（Vision-Language Navigation）；应用场景：城市级户外机器人导航；传感器类型：RGB相机（egocentric 2D图像）；目标类别：无目标检测任务。摘要未说明遥感相关场景。

Model architecture: DA-Nav框架：基于方向感知的视觉-语言导航，将导航重构为离散空间定位问题；采用Chain-of-Thought（CoT）推理过程，包含偏差评估、动作预测、目标网格选择三个步骤。摘要未说明具体网络结构、backbone、参数量等细节。

Lightweight method: 摘要未涉及任何轻量化方法（剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS、轻量网络设计等均未提及）。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗、实时性等部署相关信息。仅在真实机器人（四足/人形）上验证了可行性，但未给出计算资源需求。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：ReDA（自建方向感知指令与恢复轨迹数据集）；仿真环境：CARLA；真实环境：复杂户外真实场景（四足机器人、人形机器人）。评价指标：Success Rate（成功率，56.16%）。

Experiments: 在CARLA仿真中，DA-Nav在未见过的城市环境中达到56.16%成功率，优于现有SoTA方法，且具备更强的轨迹恢复能力。无需微调即可迁移至四足和人形机器人，实现公里级闭环户外导航。

Limitations: 1. 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化完全无关；2. 未涉及任何目标检测任务；3. 未提供模型计算复杂度、参数量、推理速度等部署关键指标；4. 依赖商业导航工具（Google Maps）的方向指令，泛化性受限。

Ideas for my research: 弱相关，借鉴价值有限。如果硬要提取：1. Chain-of-Thought推理思路或可用于遥感在轨检测中的多阶段推理（如先粗检测再精调）；2. 在真实机器人上的零微调迁移策略对星上模型跨场景泛化有一定启发。但整体与课题方向关联度极低。

Abstract: City-scale outdoor navigation is currently hindered by the heavy reliance on dense maps or costly navigation supervision. In this work, we introduce a novel paradigm for leveraging directional instructions from commercial navigation tools (e.g., Google Maps). To bridge the gap between commercial instructions and executable navigation actions, while mitigating long-horizon error accumulation through robust trajectory recovery, we propose DA-Nav, a Direction-Aware vision-language Navigation framework that reformulates navigation as a discrete spatial grounding problem on the egocentric 2D image plane. To achieve trajectory recovery, DA-Nav employs a Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning process encompassing deviation assessment, action prediction, and target grid selection. We further introduce ReDA, a dataset that provides direction-aware instructions and recovery trajectories to enhance spatial grounding and support CoT recovery reasoning. Extensive experiments in CARLA demonstrate that DA-Nav achieves a high success rate of 56.16% in unseen urban environments, outperforming existing State-of-The-Art (SoTA) methods while maintaining a substantially stronger recovery capability. Furthermore, without fine-tuning, DA-Nav seamlessly adapts to both quadruped and humanoid robots, enabling stable kilometer-scale closed-loop outdoor navigation in complex real world environments.

</details>


### [357] [Xiaomi-Robotics-U0: Unified Embodied Synthesis with World Foundation Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11643)
*Xinghang Li,Jun Guo,Qiwei Li,Long Qian,Hang Lai,Yueze Wang,Hongyu Yan,Jiahang Cao,Xi Chen,Jingen Qu,Jiaxi Song,Nan Sun,Hanye Zhao,Futeng Liu,Wanli Peng,Heyun Wang,Yunhong Wang,Caoyu Xia,Jack Zhao,Diyun Xiang,Hangjun Ye,Heng Qu,Huaping Liu,Jason Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一个380亿参数的多模态自回归模型Xiaomi-Robotics-U0，用于统一具身合成（embodied synthesis），涵盖文本到图像生成、图像编辑、具身场景生成、具身迁移和具身视频生成等任务。

Research relevance: 1分，与本研究方向基本无关。该论文聚焦于具身智能（embodied AI）和机器人领域的多模态生成任务，不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱/多光谱等遥感场景，也不涉及目标检测或轻量化部署。

Reading priority: 1分。与研究方向基本无关，不建议投入时间阅读。
